job.description:

  • Pay Rate: $30-34/hr
  • ONSITE in Austin
  • FIRST SHIFT

  • Paperwork refresher on systems that have been sitting in FGI but are approaching their ship date,

Required:
  • 2+ years of manufacturing experience in a production environment
  • 2+ years of project management experience
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred

job.description:
I AM LOOKING FOR THE BEST OF THE BEST... AND YOU ARE ONE OF THEM!
Material Handler
Applied Materials | Gloucester, MA | Long-Term 18 Month Contract
First, Second & Fourth Shift Opportunities Available
PAY RANGE: $20.00 - $21.50 PER HOUR Why This Opportunity? Applied Materials is a global leader in semiconductor manufacturing technology. This is an opportunity to join an industry-leading company that helps produce the technology powering today’s world while building valuable manufacturing and supply chain experience. Why Applied Materials?
  • World-renowned semiconductor technology company.
  • Strong history of converting successful contractors into permanent employees.
  • Outstanding work environment focused on safety, quality, and teamwork.
  • Career growth opportunities within manufacturing and operations.
  • Work alongside talented engineers, technicians, and manufacturing professionals.
  • Excellent reputation in Gloucester and Newburyport for developing talent.
Position Highlights Location: Gloucester, Massachusetts
Contract Length: 18 Months
Pay: $20.00 - $26.00 per hour
First Shift: Monday-Friday, 6:30 AM - 3:00 PM
Second Shift: Monday-Friday, 3:30 PM - 12:00 AM (+10% Shift Differential)
Fourth Shift: Friday, Saturday, Sunday, 6:00 AM - 6:30 PM (+11% Shift Differential) What You Will Be Doing
  • Receive, store, move, and control materials in and out of company facilities.
  • Maintain stock balances and coordinate shortage resolution.
  • Load and unload materials, equipment, and supplies.
  • Track and communicate material status across departments.
  • Support manufacturing operations through inventory management and material movement.
  • Operate material handling equipment and small hand tools safely.
What You Need to Bring
  • Experience loading and unloading materials from trucks or vehicles.
  • Ability to use hand tools and material handling equipment.
  • Understanding of inventory control, stock balances, and shortage management.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

patty.vogel@yoh.com

job.title: US Capital Markets / Developer - Specialty - 4
job.description:
Software Developer / Technical Support Engineer

Location: Dallas TX (Hybrid 2-3 days onsite per week)
Duration: 12 months Contract with potential extension
Pay Rate: $60/hr W2


We are seeking an experienced Software Developer / Technical Support Engineer to support a business-critical platform and its integration with upstream and downstream enterprise systems. This is a hands-on development role that combines application development, production support, system integrations, and collaboration with both technical and business stakeholders.


Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, deploy, and maintain enterprise-scale applications and integrations
  • Build and support backend services, APIs, and web services
  • Develop and enhance UI components using modern front-end technologies
  • Support production incidents, troubleshooting, and deployment activities
  • Work with messaging, monitoring, and integration frameworks
  • Collaborate with developers, IT leadership, and business teams to gather and refine requirements
  • Create and maintain SQL scripts and work with large datasets
  • Participate in CI/CD processes and build automation initiatives
  • Contribute to test automation, monitoring, and application reliability efforts
Required Qualifications
  • 9+ years of software development experience designing, building, and supporting large-scale applications
  • Strong experience with Java and/or Python
  • Experience developing and consuming APIs and web services
  • 7+ years of experience with databases and data technologies such as:
    • PostgreSQL
    • Microsoft SQL Server
    • Oracle
    • Apache Kafka
    • Apache NiFi
    • Elasticsearch
  • Strong SQL development and scripting skills
  • 2+ years of front-end development experience with Angular, React, and JavaScript
  • 5+ years of experience with CI/CD and build tools including Maven, Gradle, and Jenkins
  • 4+ years of cloud experience, preferably with GCP and Kubernetes
  • 4+ years of experience with test automation, SRE monitoring, and synthetic monitoring
  • 2+ years of experience with SSRS Reporting and Power BI
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting large-scale financial services or enterprise platforms
  • Experience with job scheduling/orchestration tools such as Airflow or Tidal
  • Experience using Dynatrace or similar monitoring platforms
  • Agile development experience
  • Knowledge of Test-Driven Development (TDD)

job.title: Semiconductor Engineering Technician $1000 sign-on bonus after 100 days
job.description:
Semiconductor Engineering Technicians Intermediate/Advanced are needed for an 18 month contract opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Austin, Texas. Candidates must take direction from management staff (Physicists and Engineers) and be able to independently provide expertise to accomplish assigned tasks.  The successful candidate(s) must have the ability to communicate effectively and interact with a diverse project team to collect, compile, maintain and interpret data and test results accurately.

Experience Required: Minimum of 2 years experience testing on electro-mechanical equipment

 
Pay Rate: $23 to $26 per hour



Bonus payout structure:

Semiconductor Engineering Technician $1000 sign-on bonus after 100 days 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Performs moderately complex electro-mechanical technical functions and activities such as design, test, checkout, fabrication, modification, troubleshooting and assembly of electronics and electro-mechanical systems, experimental design circuitry, prototype models, specialized test equipment, tools and test fixtures.
  • Tests and troubleshoots system level and component level problems in electrical and mechanical systems and sub-systems. May perform new system and NPI installations and field upgrades.
  • Works from schematics, diagrams, written and verbal descriptions, layouts or plans to perform moderate testing and troubleshooting.
  • Compiles logbooks and test procedures documentation utilizing good writing skills. Assists in revising, developing and implementing department procedures.

Promptly reports accidents, injuries, safety hazards, or emergencies to supervisor or Safety dept. Follows operating instructions, uses protective equipment when required, and uses equipment and materials properly. Actively strives to prevent accidents and injuries.
  • Becomes familiar with current manufacturing and/or engineering processes and stays informed of any changes in procedures. Assists in the correction of problems.
  • Performs necessary rework and assists in determining remedies for malfunctions and generates Quality Notifications.
 

What You Need to Bring to the Table:

 

  • Positive Attitude
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Good Communication Skills
  • Problem-Solving Skills
  • Team Player
  • Ability to Accept and Learn from Criticism
  • Flexibility/Adaptability

job.title: Sr. Engineer - Process Development
job.description:
Sr. Engineer - Process Development
Primary Duties: The Sr. Engineer reports to Principal Engineer and is an integral part of mRNA Drug Substance Process Development team. This position offers opportunities to focus on mRNA drug substance process development, manufacturing, regulatory and analytical support, validation, and data review for drug substances and drug products. The Engineer is responsible for leading and assisting the development and execution of scalable and robust processes for drug substance. This position will act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for process knowledge transfer for drug substance to support current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) manufacturing.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
40%
    • Provide technical support for scale-up and manufacturing issues, and develop solutions to improve process efficiency and product quality
    • Scale-up:
      • Lead/Perform process scale-up and Pilot batches
      • Generate and execute scale down models for GMP manufacturing
      • Generate scale-down models to assist with process scale-up
40%
    • Lead and assist implementation of Digital Tools
      • Lead implementation of digital tools for process data acquisition (Electronic lab notebooks and Electronic Batch Records.)
10%
    • Lead project activities for the design of mRNA manufacturing processes by contributing and reviewing of Batch Records/Master Production Records (MBR) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
    • Document Generation
      • Author and review MBRs
      • Author and review SOPs
      • Effectively communicate with cross functional teams like Manufacturing Analytical
5%
    • Development, R&D, Process Development, Quality Assuance (QA), Project Management, Regulatory Affairs and Legal teams.
    • Work with internal and external manufacturing on harmonization of electronic batch records.
    • Work with Digital team withing PD and CMC on the implementation of eBRs and data capture strategy.
    • Obtain processes from R&D and PD and implement at-scale.
    • Generate procedures (SOPs, MBRs, Protocols) and work with QA on review and approval
    • Review and follow QA procedures.
5%
    • Assist in the preparation of technical reports and presentations that support scale-up activities and process improvements
    • Technical reports (2.5%)
      • Generate/review Technical reports such as batch summaries, process descriptions, Tech transfer, etc.
    • Presentations (2.5%)
    • Present on batch performance, technical issues, etc.

Education and Experience Requirements:
    • 6+ (Masters) or 8+ (Bachelors) years of relevant experience is required.
    • A Bachelor’s degree and/or Master’s degree in Chemical engineering, Biomedical engineering or related field.

Key Skills, Abilities, and Competencies:
    • Demonstrated experience in process development, tech transfer, and/or scale-up to support the manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals is required.
    • Experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, MSAT, and/or Process Development (PD) is required (4+ years).
    • Experience with mRNA Drug Substance is strongly preferred. 
    • Experience implementing and maintaining electronic batch records (eBRs) is required (1+ years).  Experience using Tempo Apprentice strongly preferred.

job.description:
Buyer (ONSITE) needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Santa Clara, CA.

  • Pay Rate: $30-35/hr
  • ONSITE
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Negotiates pricing and other terms of purchase under supervision. Manage none strategic suppliers (none QFM) $5M.
  • Quotes materials; procures materials, components, equipment and services at the lowest cost consistent with consideration of quality, reliability of source and urgency of need.

job.title: Remote Temporary Sports Editor
job.description:
Remote Temporary Sports Editor
Duration: 8-12 Week Contract
Schedule: 40 Hours per Week (Saturdays needed)
Flexible on the other 2 days off 
Flexible to work 4 or 5 days per week.
Reports To: Senior Managing Editor
Compensation: $30/Hr. to $40/Hr.

Position Overview
We have an immediate opportunity for a Temporary Sports Editor to support daily editorial operations during a parental leave coverage assignment. This role will be responsible for editing, publishing, and optimizing sports content across multiple verticals while helping drive timely, engaging coverage for sports fans. The ideal candidate has a strong background in sports journalism, excellent editing skills, and in-depth knowledge of College Football, the NFL, and MLB. If familiar with College Football but not the other Sports, that will be seriously considered. This individual should be comfortable working in a fast-paced digital publishing environment, collaborating with writers, and leveraging audience insights to identify trending topics.

Key Responsibilities
  • Edit, review, and publish sports content across multiple Sports.
  • Ensure articles are accurate, well-written, formatted, and ready for publication.
  • Write and optimize compelling headlines to maximize audience engagement.
  • Pitch timely and relevant story ideas based on breaking news and trending topics.
  • Collaborate with staff writers, contributors, and editors to support daily content.
  • Utilize traffic data, audience insights, and analytics to identify content opportunities
  • Maintain standards while meeting daily deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Qualifications
  • 2-4 years of experience in sports journalism, content editing, or digital publishing.
  • Strong knowledge of college football, with the ability to confidently edit NFL, MLB, and other major sports content.
  • Excellent editing, proofreading, and headline-writing skills.
  • Experience working within a Content Management System (CMS), such as WordPress or similar publishing platforms.
  • Familiarity with SEO best practices and audience analytics tools.
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to quickly prioritize coverage opportunities.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet tight deadlines.

Schedule Requirements
  • Availability to work every Saturday is required, except during approved PTO.
  • The remaining four workdays each week are flexible and will be determined based on coverage needs and business requirements.

job.description:
I AM LOOKING FOR THE BEST OF THE BEST... AND YOU ARE ONE OF THEM!

Engineering Technician – Semiconductor Manufacturing
Applied Materials | Gloucester, Massachusetts
PAY RANGE: $28.00 - $32.00 PER HOUR (Depending on Experience)
Plus Applicable Shift Differentials

Available Shifts:  1rst Shift:  5:30 pm – 4:00 pm (Monday through Thursday)
2nd Shift: 3:45 PM – 2:15 AM | +10% Differential (Monday through Thursday)
3rd Shift: 7:30 PM – 6:00 AM + 13% Differential (Monday through Thursday)
4th Shift: 5:45 AM – 6:15 PM | +11% Differential (Friday, Saturday and Sunday)

Why This Opportunity?Are you a hands-on Engineering Technician who thrives in a fast-paced semiconductor production environment? Do you enjoy building, testing, and troubleshooting complex electro-mechanical systems? This is an opportunity to work on advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment and support cutting-edge technology.
Why Applied Materials?
  • Global leader in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and technology.
  • Technology that powers AI, smartphones, automotive systems, medical devices and next-generation innovation.
  • Strong history of contractor-to-permanent employee conversions.
  • Work directly with advanced semiconductor manufacturing systems.
  • Excellent career growth and advancement opportunities.
What You Will Do
  • Perform electro-mechanical testing, checkout, fabrication, modification, troubleshooting and assembly.
  • Build and support electronics, electro-mechanical systems, prototype models and specialized test equipment.
  • Troubleshoot component-level and system-level electrical and mechanical issues.
  • Support new system installs, NPI activities and field upgrades.
  • Work from schematics, diagrams, layouts and technical instructions.
  • Maintain logbooks, technical documentation and test procedures.
  • Perform electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, vacuum and process testing.
  • Generate quality notifications and complete rework based on test results.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives and engineering activities.
Required Technical Skills
  • Hands-on manufacturing or production experience.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, vacuum and process systems.
  • Experience with hand tools and power tools.
  • Ability to read schematics, assembly drawings and engineering documentation.
  • Experience with electrical test equipment, meters and diagnostic tools.
  • Knowledge of fiber-optic communications.
  • Ability to write technical reports and procedures.
  • Semiconductor manufacturing experience preferred.
Mechanical Skills Required
  • Strong build, assembly and fabrication skills with experience using precision measuring devices.
Nice To Have
  • Experience with PMAC motion control systems.
Why You Will Want This Role
  • Hands-on work with advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technology and complex systems.
  • Opportunity to support engineering innovation and NPI efforts.
  • A role where your technical skills truly make an impact.
Why Work Through Yoh?
  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Life and Disability Insurance
  • Weekly Direct Deposit and ePayroll
  • Employee Discount Programs
  • Dedicated Yoh Support Team
A Personal Note From Patty Vogel
I have recruited for Applied Materials for many years and have watched talented Engineering Technicians build exceptional careers. Many contractors have converted to permanent employees and advanced into technical and leadership positions. If you enjoy solving complex problems and working on high-tech equipment, I would love to speak with you.

Apply Today!Patty Vogel
Senior Principal Recruiter | Yoh Staffing

job.title: Production & Assembly Technician
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Production & Assembly Technician in Austin, TX.

This is a hands-on technical manufacturing role supporting the assembly, testing, and quality of analytical instrumentation and equipment used in industrial and energy applications. The technician will work with electrical control panels, wiring and cabling, flow cells, fiber-optic components, and other electromechanical assemblies.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience assembling and testing electrical or electromechanical equipment, can read electrical schematics and technical drawings, is comfortable using a multimeter, and has experience troubleshooting and testing completed assemblies.

Title: Production & Assembly Technician
Location: Austin, TX 78758
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM (schedule may vary)
Pay: $24–$26/hr
Employment Type: Temp-to-Hire

Key Responsibilities:
  • Assemble NIR analyzer control panels, flow cells, fiber-optic cables, and other electromechanical products according to production procedures, technical drawings, and customer specifications.
  • Perform electrical assembly, wiring, cabling, component installation, and mechanical assembly using hand and power tools.
  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, engineering drawings, and work instructions.
  • Perform electrical acceptance testing and functional testing of components and completed assemblies.
  • Perform optical testing of fiber-optic cables and related assemblies and approve completed products for shipment.
  • Use a multimeter to perform electrical measurements and troubleshooting.
  • Work safely with 120VAC electrical systems.
  • Troubleshoot assembly and testing issues and identify the source of electrical, mechanical, or component-related problems.
  • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot production equipment and tools.
  • Perform quality inspections and document test results, non-conformances, and other required QC information.
  • Create, maintain, and archive production and quality documentation.
  • Follow all applicable safety, quality, and production procedures while maintaining a clean and organized work environment.

Required Qualifications:
  • Associate degree in Electrical or Mechanical Technology, or equivalent hands-on technical experience.
  • Minimum 4 years of relevant hands-on experience assembling and testing electrical, electromechanical, mechanical, or fluid-handling systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to read and understand electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, technical drawings, and work instructions.
  • Hands-on experience using a multimeter for electrical testing and troubleshooting.
  • Comfortable working with 120VAC electrical systems.
  • Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot problems rather than simply identify them.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to follow written, verbal, and diagrammed instructions accurately.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to document production and QC results.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, technical manufacturing environment.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience building electrical control panels or industrial equipment.
  • Experience with wire harnesses, cable assemblies, connectors, crimping, or electrical terminations.
  • Experience with fiber-optic cables, optical testing, or instrumentation.
  • Experience assembling or testing analytical instrumentation, industrial equipment, or fluid-handling systems.
  • Experience troubleshooting electrical and mechanical equipment in a production environment.

#IND-SPG

job.title: Nurse Practitioner/Physicians Assistant -Occupational Health
job.description:
Part-time Nurse Practitioner/Physician Assistant-Occupational Health (1st shift) needed for an opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Moraine, OH.

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Nurse Practitioner/Physician Assistant
  • Occupational Health/Employee Health/Urgent Care/Emergency Medicine

Hours: 24 hours/week-flexible-6am-2:30 pm

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Performs emergency care for occupational and non-occupational injuries and illnesses for employees.
  • Renders on site medical care for non-emergency occupational injuries and illnesses, including assessment, diagnosis, and appropriate treatment
  • Performs assessments and dispositions for employee Surveillance Physicals, taking into consideration the pre-physical test results.
  • Recommends patient specific over the counter and prescription medications and treatments for administration and distribution by nurses.
  • Prepares concise and timely documentation of all patient medical assessment and treatments in the corporate electronic medical recordkeeping system.
  • Provides accurate and consistent OSHA Recordkeeping (OSHA 300 Log & 301’s).
  • Job-site evaluations for ergonomic assessments.
  • Perform Fitness for Duty evaluations.
  • Evaluates, validates, and tracks restrictions.
  • Serves as a resource for ADAPT job placement in the absence of plant physician.
  • Works with the Emergency Response Team.
  • Supports wellness initiatives – Health Education and counseling, disease prevention, health promotion.
  • Assigned medical services will be under the supervision and within the scope of practice of the plant Medical Director.
  • Completes other assignments as requested and assigned.
  • May have access to personal health information (“PHI”) necessary to fulfill the above duties and responsibilities.
  • Access to use and ability to disclose PHI is further defined by each organization/department.
 
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Advanced Degree from an Accredited Physician Assistant Program of Study. Active and unrestricted Physician Assistant license in the appropriate state.
  • Valid DEA certification.
  • Current CPR certification.
  • Minimum two (2) years of experience as a Physician Assistant in an occupational health environment or related field.
  • Knowledgeable of State and Federal OSHA rules and regulations.
  • Demonstrates effective oral and communication skills.
  • Adept with basic computer systems and documentation.
  • Able to work flexible hours, if necessary, to meet the customers’ requirements.
 
Physical Effort:
  • Work is performed in various health care settings and not limited to clinics, schools, hospitals, nursing homes, doctor’s offices or occupational settings.
  • Work environment involves occasional exposure to communicable diseases, blood borne pathogens and/or potentially infectious or hazardous materials and situations that require following extensive safety precautions and may include the use of protective equipment (e.g. face masks, goggles, latex or non latex gloves).
  • Work environment may involve occasional exposure to potential electrical shock, and to x-ray/electromagnetic energy.
  • Able to spend varying amounts of time sitting, standing, and walking. Able to frequently bend, stoop, squat, kneel and reach freely.
  • Sufficient endurance to perform the required physical and mental tasks over extended periods of time.
  • Requires normal, correctable vision and hearing and the ability to identify and distinguish colors. Requires excellent hand-eye coordination and fine motor function necessary to operate equipment safely and calculate/prepare medications and other procedures.
  • Able to successfully work in areas that are confined and/or crowded. Medium physical activity may require frequent lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling up to 50 lbs.

job.title: MANUFACTURING TECHNICIAN - GLOUCESTER, MA
job.description:
ELECTRO MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER OR Manufacturing Technician
Gloucester, MA

Schedule: 
  • Competitive pay ranging from $23.00 to $28.00 per hour, plus shift differentials
  • First Shift:  from 5 am to 3:30 pm Monday through Thursday
  • Second Shift:  from 3 on to 11:30 pm Monday through Thursday has an additional 10% differential 
  • Mid Shift:  from 11 am to 7 pm 
  • Third Shift:  from 7:30 pm to  6 am Monday through Thursday has an additional 13% differential 
  • Fourth Shift:  from 6 am to 6:30 pm Friday, Saturday, and Sunday with an additional 11% differential 
Are you a hands-on Manufacturing Technician who enjoys building, troubleshooting, and working with cutting-edge technology? Join a team where your skills directly support advanced semiconductor manufacturing—an industry driving innovation in everything from AI to electric vehicles.
This is an excellent opportunity for technicians who thrive in electro-mechanical environments, enjoy problem-solving, and want long-term career growth in a high-tech manufacturing setting.

What You’ll Be Doing
In this role, you will support the production, testing, and repair of complex semiconductor equipment by:
Building, repairing, and testing electrical, electro-mechanical, pneumatic, and vacuum assemblies and subassemblies
Working from work orders, schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and verbal or written instructions
Performing electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, and repair, while identifying and correcting errors
Using test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors, and vacuum pumps to validate assemblies
Entering production data, labor details, and work progress into computer systems
Receiving and auditing parts to ensure build readiness; inspecting components for defects
Troubleshooting issues and contributing to process improvements
Documenting completed work clearly and accurately
Safety & Work Environment
Properly use PPE, tools, equipment, and materials
Proactively report hazards, incidents, or injuries
This position may involve working in a cleanroom environment, requiring PPE such as coveralls, hoods, booties, gloves, safety glasses, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

Physical & Environmental Requirements
This is an active, hands-on role that may include:
Standing for extended periods, walking, bending, squatting, kneeling, twisting, climbing stairs or ladders, and working in tight spaces
Lifting and handling components and tools
Operating hand and power tools
Working in environments with moderate to high noise levels
Driving or operating heavy machinery, including forklifts
Ability to distinguish between colors

What We’re Looking For
Experience in manufacturing, assembly, or production environments
Strong ability to follow technical instructions and schematics
Hands-on skills with electro-mechanical assemblies and tools
Comfort working in structured, process-driven environments
Interest in or experience within semiconductor or high-tech manufacturing (highly valued)

Why Join Us
4 day workweek with Fridays off
Day shift schedule for better work-life balance
Entry point or growth opportunity into the semiconductor industry
Work with advanced manufacturing technology
A role where your technical skills truly matter

Working With Yoh
Benefits
Medical, dental, vision insurance
401(k), life & disability coverage
Weekly pay, employee discounts
Ready to Build the Future

If you’re a driven Manufacturing Technician who enjoys hands-on work and wants to be part of a high-impact industry, we want to hear from you.
Apply today and take your next step in semiconductor manufacturing!

Patty Vogel]
patty.vogel@yoh.com

job.title: Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability
job.description:
Job Title: Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability
Type: Full Time
Location: Holmdel, NJ
Salary: $180000 + bonus



Position Summary The Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability is responsible for defining and executing the enterprise observability strategy, operating model, and platform roadmap that enable proactive, predictive, and resilient technology operations.

This leader owns the enterprise capabilities for monitoring, telemetry, event intelligence, operational analytics, and observability engineering, ensuring technology services are observable, measurable, actionable, and continuously improving.
The role serves as the operational intelligence leader across Enterprise Technology, providing the platforms, standards, insights, and governance required to improve service reliability, accelerate issue detection and resolution, and support modern operational practices.
This leader partners closely with infrastructure, cloud, middleware, application, security, resiliency, and service management teams to build a unified enterprise-wide observability capability.

Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Observability Strategy
  • Define and execute the enterprise observability vision, strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap.
  • Establish standards and governance for monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, telemetry, alerting, and service observability.
  • Lead the evolution of observability capabilities from reactive monitoring toward proactive, predictive, and automated operations.
  • Drive enterprise adoption of modern observability practices, frameworks, and engineering standards.

Observability Platform Ownership
  • Own the strategy, architecture, lifecycle, and operation of enterprise monitoring and observability platforms.
  • Lead platform modernization, tool rationalization, capability expansion, and service offering improvements.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, platform investments, and cost optimization efforts.
  • Ensure scalability, availability, resilience, and ongoing enhancement of observability tooling and services.

Monitoring and Telemetry Services
  • Establish enterprise monitoring and instrumentation standards across infrastructure, cloud, middleware, applications, databases, and digital services.
  • Improve monitoring coverage, telemetry quality, alert effectiveness, signal quality, and operational visibility.
  • Drive adoption of distributed tracing, service dependency mapping, and end-to-end transaction monitoring.
  • Ensure service health and operational data are consistently available across the technology landscape.

Operational Intelligence and AIOps
  • Lead implementation of operational analytics, event intelligence, anomaly detection, predictive insights, and AIOps capabilities.
  • Develop dashboards, scorecards, and reporting that provide actionable operational intelligence to technology leadership.
  • Enable intelligent event correlation, noise reduction, automated diagnostics, and automated operational workflows.
  • Partner with engineering and operations teams to use observability data for continuous improvement and outage prevention.

Reliability and Incident Enablement
  • Partner with technology teams to improve detection, response, recovery, and root cause analysis capabilities.
  • Establish observability practices that improve service reliability, operational resilience, and customer experience.
  • Drive post-incident learning and identification of automation opportunities.
  • Provide enterprise visibility into technology health, performance trends, capacity risks, and reliability risks.

Leadership and Talent Development
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of observability engineers, platform engineers, and operational intelligence specialists.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, operational excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional partnership.
  • Lead organizational adoption of observability best practices through enablement, coaching, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Establish strong partnerships across technology, cybersecurity, architecture, engineering, operations, resiliency, and service management functions.

Qualifications
  • 10+ years of experience in infrastructure operations, platform engineering, observability, reliability engineering, or related technology disciplines.
  • 5+ years of experience leading enterprise-scale engineering or operational teams.
  • Deep expertise in observability platforms, monitoring technologies, telemetry pipelines, logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and operational analytics.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing enterprise monitoring strategies and improving operational reliability at scale.
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms, hybrid infrastructure, automation, DevOps practices, and modern operational architectures.
  • Experience leading organizational transformation and driving adoption of new operational capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills.

Success Measures
  • Increased enterprise monitoring and observability coverage.
  • Reduced mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR).
  • Improved signal quality and reduced alert fatigue.
  • Increased adoption of observability standards and platform capabilities.
  • Improved service reliability, operational resilience, and operational efficiency.
  • Expansion of predictive analytics, automation, and AIOps capabilities across Enterprise Technology.

job.title: Manufacturing Engineer
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is seeking an experienced Manufacturing Engineer to join a pharmaceutical manufacturing organization in Rosenberg, TX. This is a hands-on, floor-oriented engineering position supporting day-to-day pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.

The Manufacturing Engineer will work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Maintenance, Packaging, Validation, and R&D to troubleshoot equipment and process issues, improve manufacturing performance, support new product and equipment initiatives, and ensure compliance with FDA and cGMP requirements.

The ideal candidate will have direct pharmaceutical manufacturing engineering experience, particularly with liquid and/or semi-solid products, and be comfortable spending significant time on the manufacturing floor.


Title: Manufacturing Engineer 
Location: Rosenberg, TX
Employment Type: Direct Hire
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
Salary: $80,000 - 100,000 annually
 
Key Responsibilities:
  • Provide hands-on engineering support to pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.
  • Troubleshoot manufacturing and packaging equipment issues to minimize downtime and improve equipment reliability.
  • Support equipment installation, commissioning, startup, qualification, and validation activities.
  • Develop and execute engineering and validation documentation, including IQ/OQ/PQ.
  • Support process validation and cleaning validation activities.
  • Investigate manufacturing deviations and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Develop and implement CAPA and change controls.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve throughput, productivity, labor efficiency, equipment reliability, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
  • Support manufacturing process improvements and cost-reduction initiatives.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality, Maintenance, Packaging, Validation, and R&D teams.
  • Develop and revise SOPs, manufacturing procedures, and work instructions.
  • Support regulatory, customer, and internal audits.
  • Ensure engineering and manufacturing activities comply with applicable FDA, cGMP, safety, and quality requirements.
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Industrial, Manufacturing, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 3–5+ years of pharmaceutical manufacturing engineering experience, with preference for candidates with 5+ years.
  • Strong knowledge of FDA requirements, cGMP, and regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing practices.
  • Direct experience manufacturing semi-solid products, such as creams, ointments, and suppositories, and/or liquid products, including solutions and suspensions.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting manufacturing and packaging equipment.
  • Experience with equipment installation, commissioning, startup, qualification, and validation.
  • Working knowledge of IQ/OQ/PQ, process validation, and cleaning validation.
  • Experience with deviations, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), CAPA, and change control.
  • Ability and willingness to spend significant time on the manufacturing floor supporting daily operations.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with New Product Introduction (NPI), process scale-up, and technology transfer.
  • Experience developing User Requirement Specifications (URS).
  • Experience with Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).
  • Proven success improving throughput, productivity, labor efficiency, equipment reliability, and OEE.
  • Demonstrated ability to reduce downtime and optimize manufacturing costs.
  • Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, Six Sigma, and 5S methodologies.
  • Experience developing and revising SOPs and manufacturing work instructions.
  • Experience supporting regulatory, customer, and internal audits.
  • Experience using SAP or a comparable ERP system.

#IND-SPG

job.title: Software QA & Test Data Coordinator- Biomedical- EST Remote
job.description:
Yoh has an immediate, 10 month contract opportunity, as a Software QA & Test Data Coordinator- Biomedical/Life Sciences within the non-profit, humanitarian industry to join our client, EST Remote, to report from their office based in Tallahassee, FL
  • $65hr. max hourly rate
  • Seeking a QA professional with expertise in software validation, test data management (JSON/XML), and FDA-regulated environments to support testing and deployment of a mission-critical blood management system
***Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship. Due to the client-site nature of this role, we are unable to support OPT or STEM OPT employment, including completion of Form I-983***

** To be considered, your current city and state must be clearly listed on your resume. Applications with incomplete location information may not be considered **

What You Will Be Doing
  • Create and manage test data (seed data) to support software testing, user validation, and system readiness activities.
  • Analyze seed data requests, determine the appropriate creation method, and build accurate test records using JSON, XML, and other data structures.
  • Investigate testing issues, perform root cause analysis, and resolve data-related problems before escalating to software vendors or project teams.
  • Support software validation, regression testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) activities within a complex, FDA-regulated environment.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to understand business processes, maintain test environments, and ensure timely delivery of critical testing support.
*This is NOT a complete list of responsibilities or requirements. Full client job description will be provided upon submittal to end client*

Who You Are
  • Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience considered.
  • 5+ years of software QA and testing experience supporting complex enterprise applications and end-to-end testing efforts.
  • Strong experience working with JSON and XML data structures, including the ability to understand objects, variables, relationships, and data syntax.
  • Proven troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills, with the ability to identify whether issues stem from application functionality, configuration, or data quality.
  • Experience in an FDA-regulated, GMP, or other highly regulated environment, with an understanding of validation, compliance, and documentation requirements.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced project environment, managing multiple priorities and meeting aggressive deadlines with minimal supervision.
If This Sounds Like You, Apply Now! Yoh makes finding and applying for jobs simple. Partner with Yoh to find the right opportunities across multiple industries in the US and UK.

job.title: Thin Film Process Engineer
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Thin Film Process Engineer in Longmont, CO for a leading diagnostic company. The Process Engineer will support transfer and development of new products and processes.  You will support manufacturing, while maintaining and improving upon existing equipment as well as ensuring product quality and yield. 

Position:  Process Engineer II
Pay: $84,000-105,000 DOE 
Location: Longmont, CO 
Duration: FTE

Ideally like to have 1 in each of the following backgrounds –
  • Automation process engineer
  • Surface chemistry that will introduce new equipment and focus on developing new standards and processes
  • 5-7 years of experience, no more than 8 years.
Automation Process Engineer
  • Must have experience with relevant equipment for automation assembly,
  • Experience with auto assembly, laser welding, pouching, Thin Film, microarray printing.
Surface Chemistry
  • The individual needs to have experience with thin films and etching.
  • Must have strong GDP experience and produce quality documents.
  • 5-7 years in manufacturing as a process engineer, does not need to be from med device or diagnostics just relevant to the automation equipment and auto line machines, IQ/OQ/PQ.
  • Experience with new equipment introduction, qualifying, process improvement and cost savings
  • Would like to know what type of cost saving methods you've introduced

Responsibilities

  • Lead efforts to provide sustaining support to operations utilizing continuous improvement principles and technical support to operations utilizing root cause analysis to implement corrective actions.

  • Enables company growth by ensuring on-time equipment milestone deliveries.

  • Recommends and implements equipment and process modifications to improve production efficiencies, manufacturing techniques and production yields for existing products.

  • Assists in developing high level capital equipment integration protocols and procedures for manufacturing. 

  • Develops and conducts statistical analysis such as Design of Experiments (DOE) and Statistical Process Control (SPC) targeting physical cause of failure for yield loss and improving quality. Active database and data management allowing for process performance assessment via GR&R, Yield Tracking and Cpk analysis.

  • Accurately documents all work products to ensure equipment qualifications and in line with and follow IQ, OQ, PQ requirements.

  • Interacts with design staff to ensure that processes and designs are compatible with existing equipment.

  • Translate design requirements into production by defining, designing and/or communicating efficient and capable process tooling.

  • Utilizing GDP, author documents including but not limited to manufacturing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and detailed work instructions.

  • Trains manufacturing staff on proper processes to follow when operating equipment, including wave-guide instrument(s).

  • Ensures that team and staff members follow safety rules and protocol.
Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field required; master’s degree preferred.

  • Five to seven (5-7) years prior experience in an R&D or production environment with proven success of process improvement and scale-up projects.

  • Experience in a regulated environment (FDA, ISO, etc.), preferred.

  • Experience in project management preferred.

  • Experience in the medical device field, specifically invitro diagnostics, preferred.

  • Licenses or certifications such as ISO, PMP, LEAN, IFMA, MPS, Six Sigma, cGMP, preferred.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical staff to ensure understanding.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate in problem solving.

  • Excellent data gathering and analysis skills.

  • Excellent electro-mechanical equipment development and troubleshooting skills.

  • Knowledge of QMS, including experience with deviation, CAPA, and other quality related objectives and requirements.

  • Software use and knowledge: Windows, MS Office products, SolidWorks (or similar).

The Material Handler is responsible for controlling and maintaining the accurate transfer of parts and materials in and out of the stockroom. This role supports manufacturing operations by ensuring inventory accuracy, maintaining stock levels, expediting materials, and coordinating shortages to keep production moving efficiently.
Key Responsibilities
• Receive, store, move, and control materials throughout company facilities.
• Ensure accurate transfer of parts and materials in and out of stockrooms.
• Verify inventory levels and maintain stock balances.
• Monitor and communicate material shortages.
• Locate, expedite, and deliver critical materials to support manufacturing operations.
• Load and unload materials, equipment, and supplies.
• Utilize material handling equipment including pallet handlers, skids, and hand trucks.
• Work closely with manufacturing, planning, logistics, and warehouse teams regarding material availability and status.
• Maintain a safe and organized work environment.
Qualifications
• Experience loading and unloading materials, supplies, or equipment.
• Warehouse, stockroom, inventory, shipping, receiving, or logistics experience preferred.
• Experience operating pallet jacks, hand trucks, skids, or similar material handling equipment.
• Forklift/Fork Truck experience is a plus.
• Basic computer and inventory tracking skills.
• Ability to follow work instructions and safety procedures.
• Strong attention to detail and inventory accuracy.
• Experience communicating material status and coordinating shortages with multiple departments.
 Physical Requirements
• Approximately 80% standing and walking throughout the shift
• Regular lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling of materials
• Must be able to lift and move up to 35 pounds
• Ability to work in warehouse and manufacturing environments
Why Work for Applied Materials?
Applied Materials is at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. Every day, our technology helps manufacture the chips that power the world's most advanced technologies. Joining Applied Materials means becoming part of a global organization known for innovation, quality, and career growth opportunities. Why Work for Yoh as a contractor?
Benefits of Working with Yoh:
- Health, dental, and vision insurance
- 401(k) retirement savings plan
- Weekly pay with direct deposit
- Employee discount programs
- Dedicated recruiter support and career guidance
- Opportunities for experience with leading companies and potential conversion
What You’ll Gain:
- Real-world experience in inventory and materials management
- Exposure to ERP systems and supply chain operations
- Skill development in data analysis and process improvement
- A strong foundation for long-term career growth in operations or manufacturing Please apply

on behalf of Applied Materials

job.title: NE Administrative Operations & Support Manager
job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-term Administrative Operations & Support Manager opportunity with a trusted client located in Waltham, MA. 

If you don't wish to receive these mails, just turn off "Job expiry email alerts" inside the user profile or system settings.

Position Overview
This individual will be responsible for supporting Yoh and Client project initiatives. It is expected that this individual will have a 90% onsite presence.
The Admin Operations & Support Assoc. will function in the capacity of an onsite Yoh representative, to include assistance with resources, employees, and to ensure daily continuity of business and operation. Initial training and instruction will be provided by existing Yoh management and Yoh Sr. Management.
It is expected that the Admin Operation & Support Assoc. will support the current Yoh Manager, and while gaining, fostering the client relationship become familiar with the Yoh onboarding process, site training requirements, and the daily operations of the Yoh staff.

Administrative & Operational ResponsibilitiesThis individual will be responsible for:
  • Maintaining Yoh email distribution list(s).
  • Updating and enhancing the Yoh open positions spreadsheet.
  • Updating the monthly changes spreadsheet.
  • Maintaining the Yoh Recognition Awards program at our client site.
  • The AO & S Mgr. will be responsible for maintaining the absence (Discretionary Leave, FMLA, and absence Spreadsheet).
Client & Organizational Communications
The AO & S Mgr. will be responsible for communications within the organizational structure of our client, and have some limited responsibility to other sites and departments which contain Yoh employees.
This individual will have the responsibility to liaison between Yoh D&Z and our employees as it relates to creating BetterNet Tickets, & Yoh Portal Issues, and working out employee concerns with Yoh PA office management.
This individual will be responsible for informing Yoh Management of any escalatory situations within the Yoh organization and our it’s employees.

Candidates & Open Positions
The Yoh AO & S Mgr. will function as liaison to all departments in respect to Yoh candidates and open positions. This requires keeping spreadsheets up to date and potentially in a state of presentation ready as requested by the client.
The goal of this presentation is to provide a weekly (as necessary & dependent upon openings) but on a proactive basis.
In theory, we should keep the client up to date so that they don’t need to ask for information because we proactively provide it to them.

Work Ethic & Communication
This individual will have a strong and collaborative work ethic, be results oriented and demonstrate a focus on achieving (business) results.
The AO & S Mgr. will have strong written and oral communication skills, with demonstrated experience managing multiple communications. Progressively onsite and presenting / representing the Yoh business function.

Financial & Confidential Information
Financial responsibility will be minimal within this position; however, they may have exposure to sensitive information and understand that the information is to remain confidential.

Meeting Coordination
Facilitate meetings through issuance of meeting agendas. Track and follow up on action items and determine what action items need to be addressed.

Microsoft Office Skills
The AO & S Mgr. will have excellent knowledge in all aspects of MS Office including MS Project, Excel, Sharepoint and MS Teams.

New Yoh Employee Program & Onboarding
This individual supports and within time take over the new Yoh employee program:
  • Setting up and scheduling new candidates for Meet and Greet sessions.
  • Providing feedback to the Yoh recruiters.
  • Liaison information between our team and the client.
This individual will be the come to person for onboarding new employees, from ensuring they are enrolled in NHO and are met upon release from NHO.

Benefits, Timekeeping & HR
This individual will be required to learn about the Yoh benefits, programs, and functionality of the Yoh time keeping system.
They will be required to assist in making sure that Yoh employees enter their time as required.
Have knowledge of HR process and procedures and work with Yoh HR and Employee Relations.

job.description:

  • Pay Rate: $70-79/hr
  • HYBRID
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • DIBI is seeking a Senior Project Manager to lead execution of a high-priority Additive Manufacturing Sprint supporting the U.S. Navy.
  • This is a hands-on project leadership role responsible for coordinating a complex, fast-moving, cross-functional team and keeping the project on track across scope, schedule, budget, deliverables, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
  • The primary responsibilities will include owning day-to-day project execution, coordinating the cross-functional team, translating the technical scope into an executable project plan, managing milestones and deliverables, tracking risks and issues, coordinating with the Navy and other stakeholders, and providing clear status reporting and escalation to DIBI leadership.

Required:
  • We are looking for a senior, hands-on project manager with 5+ years of experience managing complex technical programs, ideally in a defense, federal, aerospace, engineering, advanced manufacturing, or similarly complex environment.
  • Exceptional project scheduling and organization skills, including developing and maintaining detailed project plans, tracking milestones and dependencies, coordinating deliverables, and keeping work on schedule.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including coordinating with and keeping stakeholders informed.
  • Responsive to direction with strong initiative and follow-through, able to take direction and priorities from the project lead while independently anticipating needs, identifying gaps, solving problems, and taking action to keep the project moving.
  • Experience managing large, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
  • Experience working directly with federal/government customers, preferably DoD or Navy
  • The ability to take an ambiguous or evolving objective and turn it into a clear execution plan with owners, milestones, and accountability
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to work with senior leaders, technical experts, government stakeholders, and external partners
  • Strong project controls experience, including schedules, deliverables, risks/issues, dependencies, resources, and budget
  • Experience with project management tools such as Smartsheet, Salesforce, MS Project, Jira, Monday.com, or similar platforms
  • PMP certification strongly preferred; Agile/Scrum experience is a plus
  • The ability to operate independently, identify and resolve issues, facilitate decisions, and keep a fast-moving project on track

  • Additive manufacturing experience would be a plus, but it is not required. We are more focused on finding a strong project leader who has experience managing technically complex work in a federal/defense or similar environment.

job.title: Business Intelligence (BI) / Data Analytics- OnSite
job.description:
Yoh has an immediate, 12 month contract opportunity, as a Business/Intelligence (BI)/Data Analyst within the consumer electronics and entertainment industry to join our client, Onsite, to report from their office based in San Diego, CA

***Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship. Due to the client-site nature of this role, we are unable to support OPT or STEM OPT employment, including completion of Form I-983***
  • $45.63/hr. max hourly rate
  • 1-3 years of experience using SQL to analyze data, build business logic, define KPIs, and develop Power BI reporting solutions for business stakeholders.
  • Must be able to independently translate complex business questions into SQL-driven insights, KPI frameworks, and executive-ready Power BI dashboards.
What You Will Be Doing
  • Business Logic & Data Modeling: Write advanced SQL within Databricks to apply complex business rules, transform raw data, and build structured datasets optimized for reporting
  • Visualization & Reporting: Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI to track KPIs and support data-driven decision-making.
  • Insight Generation: Analyze large datasets to uncover trends, define and maintain KPI calculations and reporting standards, summarize key findings concisely, and present actionable insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional business teams to gather and document requirements, define business metrics, and translate business questions into analytical and reporting solutions.
  • Issue Resolution & Engineering Liaison: Proactively monitor data quality, perform validation and reconciliation of reporting outputs, clearly document anomalies or discrepancies, and collaborate with the Data Engineering team to troubleshoot pipeline or data issues.
Who You Are
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 1-3 years of experience using SQL to analyze data, build business logic, define KPIs, and develop Power BI reporting solutions for business stakeholders.
  • Foundational experience with data analysis and programming (e.g., Python or similar).
  • Hands-on experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools, particularly Power BI.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to validate results, communicate findings clearly, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical engineering teams.
Preferred Skills
  • Direct experience working within Databricks or similar cloud-based data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery).
  • Understanding of data warehouse concepts, data models, and ETL/ELT processes, with the ability to trace data lineage and communicate effectively with data engineers.
  • Experience supporting marketing, CRM, ecommerce, customer analytics, or digital analytics initiatives is a plus. Familiarity with customer data platforms, audience segmentation, campaign measurement, and tools such as GA4, ActionIQ, Qualtrics, or similar platforms is preferred.

job.title: Remote Investment Management Recruiter (RPO)
job.description:
Remote Investment Management Recruiter (RPO)
Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced RPO Investment Management Recruiter in the Philadelphia suburbs to support the recruitment of specialized financial services talent across Asset Management, Alternative Investments, Fund Accounting, Fund Administration, and Investment Operations. This role will partner closely with hiring managers and business leaders to identify, attract, and hire top talent for professional through executive-level positions within investment management organizations.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of the investment management industry, including hedge funds, private equity, mutual funds, fund administration, and investment operations. Success in this role requires the ability to build talent pipelines, consult with stakeholders, and deliver high-quality candidates in a client-focused environment.

Salary Range: $80,000 to $120,000

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from intake through offer acceptance.
  • Partner with hiring managers to develop recruiting and sourcing strategies.
  • Recruit for positions within Fund Accounting, Fund Administration, Investment Operations, Finance, Accounting, Risk, Compliance, and Leadership functions.
  • Build talent pipelines across Asset Management, Alternative Investments, Hedge Funds, Private Equity, and Financial Services.
  • Utilize LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools to identify passive candidates.
  • Conduct candidate screening, assessment, and interview coordination.
  • Provide hiring managers with market intelligence regarding talent availability and compensation trends.
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate and client experience.
  • Maintain accurate candidate activity and hiring data within ATS platforms.
  • Consistently meet recruiting metrics and service-level expectations.

Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, HR, or related a plus
  • 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience.
  • Experience recruiting within Financial Services, Investment Management, Asset Management, Capital Markets, or Alternative Investments.
  • Strong sourcing skills and experience identifying passive candidates.

job.title: Procurement Program Manager (Hybrid to Secaucus, NJ OR Georgetown, TX)
job.description:
Send updated resumes to Tymir Black
Tymir.Black@yoh.com
https://www.linkedin.com/in/tymir-black-035914111/

This role is eligible for a flexible hybrid work arrangement following the successful completion of the initial 90-day onboarding period. Following the onboarding period, employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of three (3) days per week, with the specific in office schedule determined by the manager based on business and team needs. Must be from cloud, hardware solutions,automotive,electrical, manufacturing type of industry. We are currently seeking a Platform Procurement Program Manager to be based out of our Secaucus, NJ office or Georgetown, TX. The Platform Procurement Program Manager is an individual contributor who will be responsible for end-to-end supply-demand optimization.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage procurement of server PCBAs, electronic components, and related materials from qualified suppliers.
  • Issue and manage purchase orders, including pricing, quantities, delivery dates, and commercial terms.
  • Monitor supplier commitments and proactively address shortages, delays, and supply constraints.
  • Work closely with Material Planning, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to align purchasing with production requirements.
  • Review MRP/ERP requirements and convert demand into timely purchase orders.
  • Maintain appropriate inventory levels while minimizing excess and obsolete materials.
  • Support supplier selection, qualification, cost negotiations, and performance management.
  • Negotiate lead times, MOQ, payment terms, and other commercial conditions.
  • Track PCBA component availability and identify potential long-lead-time and allocation risks.
  • Coordinate engineering changes, BOM updates, and part substitutions with suppliers and internal teams.
  • Ensure purchased materials meet specifications, quality requirements, and approved vendor lists.
  • Support resolution of supplier quality issues, material discrepancies, and delivery problems.
  • Develop and maintain supplier relationships and participate in supplier performance reviews.
  • Analyze purchasing data, including cost, lead time, supplier performance, and delivery metrics.
  • Maintain accurate purchasing records and ensure compliance with company procurement policies.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Operations, or a related field preferred.
  • 3+ years of purchasing/procurement experience in electronics, PCBA, servers, networking equipment, or a related manufacturing environment.
  • Understanding of PCBAs, electronic components, BOMs, and electronics manufacturing processes.
  • Experience working with ERP/MRP systems and purchasing workflows.
  • Ability to manage multiple suppliers, priorities, and production requirements simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally.

job.title: Manufacturing Technician / Cyclotron Operator
job.description:
Yoh is hiring Manufacturing Technicians / Cyclotron Operators for our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing client in Maryland Heights, Missouri.

This is an onsite, contract-to-hire opportunity with multiple openings. The team is moving quickly and is looking for candidates with hands-on electronics, mechatronics, automation, military electronics, industrial electronics, electro-mechanical troubleshooting, biomedical equipment, field service, controls, or complex technical equipment troubleshooting experience. Prior cyclotron or radiopharmaceutical experience is not required. Training is provided. Candidates must have strong hands-on technical aptitude, troubleshooting ability, reliability, and the ability to learn highly specialized equipment systems in a regulated manufacturing environment. Candidates with general electrical, mechanical, maintenance, manufacturing, or field service backgrounds may be considered if they also have direct experience troubleshooting electrical/electronic systems, automation, controls, circuit-level issues, diagnostic equipment, or complex electro-mechanical equipment.

Pay Rate: $25/hr

Schedule:
  • This is a 24/7/365 operation.
  • Current schedule is 12-hour shifts, 7 days on / 7 days off.
  • Current rotation starts Tuesday and runs through Monday.
  • Quarterly rotation between day shift and night shift required.
  • Overtime pay applies as part of this schedule.

Essential Job Functions:
  • Perform troubleshooting for cyclotron operations and support equipment.
  • Perform routine maintenance and repairs of cyclotrons and support equipment.
  • Support advanced maintenance and repair activities under general direction.
  • Perform scheduled start-ups and shutdowns of cyclotrons.
  • Perform target loading, installation, and transport activities.
  • Operate and monitor cyclotrons and support systems during target irradiation.
  • Monitor cyclotrons and support systems during standby conditions.
  • Document cyclotron performance, operations data, maintenance activities, and repair work.
  • Work closely with Cyclotron Chemistry and production teams to support daily production activities.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable regulatory and quality standards, including FDA, cGMP, NRC, ISO, USP, and related requirements.

Education / Experience:
  • Two-year degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Automation, Electrical Technology, Biomedical Equipment Technology, or a related technical field preferred.
  • Equivalent electronics, automation, military electronics, field service, or hands-on technical training may be considered.
  • Hands-on electronics, mechatronics, automation, controls, industrial electronics, biomedical equipment, electro-mechanical troubleshooting, field service, or complex technical equipment troubleshooting experience required.
  • Experience using diagnostic tools, meters, schematics, service manuals, troubleshooting procedures, or test equipment preferred.
  • Experience with circuit boards, power supplies, sensors, relays, motors, control systems, automation systems, electrical cabinets, or complex equipment diagnostics preferred.
  • Experience with PLCs, logic circuits, VFDs, RF systems, high-voltage equipment, analog/digital circuits, vacuum systems, pneumatics, hydraulics, or manufacturing equipment is a plus.
  • Experience with component-level electronics troubleshooting, soldering, bench testing, or circuit board repair is strongly preferred but not required.
  • Experience working around ionizing radiation sources is a plus but not required.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical systems across multiple equipment areas.
  • Ability to follow detailed procedures, document work accurately, and complete extensive on-the-job and compliance training.
  • Strong reliability, communication, safety awareness, and team orientation required.

Strong Fit Backgrounds May Include:
  • Electronics Technician
  • Mechatronics Technician
  • Automation Technician
  • Controls Technician
  • Electromechanical Technician
  • Avionics Technician
  • Military Electronics Technician
  • RF / Radar / Communications Technician
  • Biomedical Equipment Technician
  • Semiconductor Equipment Technician
  • Industrial Electronics Technician
  • Complex Field Service Technician
  • Technical Test Technician
  • CNC Equipment Repair Technician
  • EV / Automotive Electrical Diagnostic Technician

job.description:
Monday through Friday
8 am to 5 pm
$27/hr 
Benefits Offered including health insurance
Contract role through Yoh Services at a client site
This job requires strong REVIT skills.  
Must have a valid driver's license.
Background check required


Job Description: Entry-Level Drafter / Engineering Support General Overview The Entry-Level Drafter performs drafting and basic engineering support activities under close supervision. This position develops foundational competencies through structured work assignments and receives instruction, guidance, and direction from supervisors, managers, and experienced colleagues.
The role may focus on drafting, engineering support, or a combination of both.
Primary Responsibilities
  • Perform field observations as assigned.
  • Prepare and update as‑built drawings based on field edits.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, construction drawings, and other technical documentation.
  • Use computer‑aided design (CAD) software to prepare detailed engineering drawings, maps, and graphs from provided materials, including previous drawings, sketches, layouts, and standard references.
  • Clearly document revisions and file drawings according to standard procedures.
  • Assist in drafting solicitation documents using established procedures, formats, and templates to support procurement and contract activities.
  • Support field and office research related to:
    • Field measurements
    • Historical engineering drawings
    • Equipment databases
    • Microfilm
    • Inventory records
    • Electronic document management system (EDMS) records
    • Other technical documentation
  • Contribute to the design of equipment and layouts and support development of equipment ratings and facility statistics.
  • Prepare basic specifications, materials lists, and fixed capital unit (FCU) lists.
  • Assist with creating work orders and requisition entries.
  • Perform data entry in the departmental engineering database.
  • Prepare basic reports related to projects, work plans, equipment, assets, and budgets; assist with more complex reporting as needed.
  • Operate office and drafting equipment such as plotters, printers, copiers, and scanners.
  • Collect engineering information by traveling independently to various company locations (such as substations, facilities, or plants).
The responsibilities above represent essential job functions but are not an exhaustive list. Employees may be required to perform additional job‑related duties as assigned.
Minimum Qualifications
  • One or more years of experience interpreting technical drawings/documents and performing technical analysis or CAD drafting.
  • A degree in computer‑aided design or a related field may substitute for equivalent experience, per company guidelines.
  • A valid driver’s license is required for travel to various company locations.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Knowledge of general engineering principles.
  • Knowledge of CAD principles, standards, and techniques.
  • Knowledge of electronic document management systems (EDMS).
  • Knowledge of work management systems.
  • Basic proficiency in CAD software.
  • Ability to read and interpret diagrams, prints, and technical information.
  • Basic proficiency in office productivity software (email, word processing, spreadsheets).
  • Skill in analyzing and solving technical problems.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to operate plotters, printers, copiers, and scanners.
  • Ability to perform accurate data entry.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Work Environment
  • Work may be performed in an office, industrial setting, electrical substation, or plant environment.
  • Exposure to noise may occur.
  • Outdoor work may involve exposure to various or extreme weather conditions.
Physical Demands
  • Frequent finger/hand manipulation when using a keyboard and mouse.
  • Occasional climbing, crawling, crouching, or other non‑sitting positions for field duties (less than 20% of the time).
  • Occasional standing or walking during field work (less than 20% of the time).

job.title: Registered Veterinary Technician (Animal Research)
job.description:
We are seeking a Registered Veterinary Technician (Animal Research) to support animal health, welfare, and research programs within a laboratory animal research environment in San Francisco.  The position will provide hands-on support for veterinary and research activities involving primarily rodents, with potential exposure to other animal species. Candidates must be flexible to travel between San Francisco facilities as needed using an employer-provided shuttle.

Location: San Francisco, CA
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM
Work Arrangement: Onsite

Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Recent Vet Tech/RVT graduates, veterinary assistants, laboratory research assistants, and candidates with science-related backgrounds are encouraged to apply
  • Anesthesia experience
  • Previous laboratory, biomedical research, lab management, or animal husbandry experience 
  • Strong hands-on, documentation, communication, and organizational skills
  • Comfortable working with rodents and potentially larger animal species
  • Ability to follow SOPs, technical procedures, and established research protocols
  • Flexibility to work between multiple San Francisco facilities
  • Must be interested in potentially converting to a permanent position following the contract period
Responsibilities
  • Conduct animal health surveillance for rodents and other assigned species
  • Assist with veterinary assessments and animal health procedures
  • Support rodent sentinel health and monitoring programs
  • Perform and assist with necropsy and other diagnostic or clinical diagnostic techniques
  • Communicate laboratory and animal health information to researchers
  • Draft and maintain SOPs and related documentation
  • Provide training and support to laboratory staff
  • Support veterinarians and research teams with animal health and research projects
  • Assist with administrative responsibilities and general program support as needed
  • Maintain accurate documentation while following established quality, safety, and confidentiality requirements
Important Biosecurity Requirement Due to disease-contamination and biosecurity requirements associated with this position, employees cannot keep rodents as pets at home while working in this role.

job.title: Software Technical Program Manager – Powertrain
job.description:
Software Technical Program Manager – Powertrain
 
As Technical Program Manager, you will use your technical expertise to holistically drive complex problems to completion. You will work with the team to scope work, plan requirements, identify risks, estimate budgets, and clearly communicate ongoing progress.
Seeking an experienced Software Technical Program Manager (TPM) for Powertrain and Motion Controls. The TPM will be responsible for driving the team to meet their committed deliverables as well as working with the engineers, technical leads, and managers across the broader organization to assess risk, communicate status, and drive closure to key issues. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in automotive powertrain systems and motion controls, excellent project management skills, and experience working with highly cross-functional teams. This environment is not for everyone but will enrich the best talent with the opportunity to perform some of the best work of their careers. 

Responsibilities:
As a technical program manager, you will be a force multiplier and enable a world-class team of engineers to execute with quality and under aggressive development timelines.
You will be responsible for the following domains: powertrain and motion controls.
Your responsibilities include the following:
  • Coordinate with various controls, systems, and integration engineers to establish feature delivery roadmaps, define key deliverable delivery dates, and tie deliverables to engineering milestones.
  • Work Right-to-Left to ensure that the vehicle and motor torque controls development plans meet end-user needs, support hardware and system DV test plans, and meet engineering program milestones.
  • Coordinate with vehicle program management on prototype vehicle and test asset allocation. Ensure engineers have the resources that they need, at the time that they need it, to complete their testing and validation.
  • Run sprint planning sessions and help organize the engineering task workflow.
  • Track sprint action items and progress towards engineering deliverables. Report status to engineering management and escalate concerns when necessary.
  • Work with engineering management to assess team workload management and vocalize resource gaps.
  • Assist engineering to prioritize work tasks and ensure team progress.
  • Set the overall sprint timeline, identify and resolve roadblocks.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
  • Minimum of 5 years program management experience, with focus on automotive powertrain systems software development, verification and validation, or quality assurance
  • Product launch experience with a vehicle OEM in systems, software, or testing
  • Experience with automotive powertrain systems is required
  • Experience working with vehicle motion controls
  • Experience working with vehicle diagnostics
  • Experience with Agile Methodology, CI/CD is required
  • Proven track record of successfully managing complex projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
