job.title: Corporate Paralegal (Energy Industry Experience)-HYBRID
job.description:
Corporate Paralegal (Energy Industry Experience) needed for a HYBRID contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Audubon, PA.
  • Pay Rate: $35-45/hr
  • HYBRID-onsite occasionally/as-needed
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • The Paralegal will support  legal & compliance efforts by preparing documents and filings, provide support for activities related to drafting, processing, updating and filing tariff and tariff related agreements; provide support for all activities surrounding or relative to the drafting and processing of agreements and other legal documents as well as the coordination of assignments and workflow for attorneys. Additionally, the Paralegal will conduct legal and factual research; execute filings; facilitate legal and compliance matters; and act as a liaison among various internal departments as well as outside agencies.
  • Provide legal support for counsel in the stakeholder process, and in litigation and regulatory proceedings both at the state and federal levels.
  • Assist in FERC filings by organizing relevant governing agreement and tariff controlling document sections, assisting counsel in drafting filing letters.
  • Service Agreement Duties: Able to have overall responsibility for the administration, processing and maintenance of Service Agreements including the tracking of effective and expiration dates, and coordinate with both internal and external clients to maintain overall regulatory compliance. able to review pro forma documents and agreements for conformity. If non-conforming, prepare draft FERC filing for PJM counsel indicating reason for non-conformity to PJM standard agreement.  Able to prepare final document, file with Commission filing and oversee any service requirements for filing.
  • Tariff Duties: Ability to oversee the tariff maintenance process and administer the eTariff database to grant levels of access to company personnel as needed. Administer and maintain the eTariff software system while working closely with designated back-up to provide daily coverage.

Required:
  • 2+ years relevant paralegal experience in corporate legal department, governmental agency, or public utility company in an energy/electricity/FERC-related role or similar experience in another regulatory/compliance driven environment.
  • Paralegal certificate or 4+ years of demonstrated relevant experience
  • Possess in depth knowledge of the FERC and the manner in which regulated entities prepare and make filings to update or revise their tariff documents.
What’s In It For You?
  • This is a unique opportunity to support our client; one of the region’s largest utility companies. Medical benefits and 401K are available.

job.title: Sr. Research Associate- ESI Flow Cytometry
job.description:
Research Associate - ESI Flow Cytometry
Primary Duties: The Yoh resource is expected to apply expertise across several practical skills including flow cytometry and cell sorting in support of the Client’s Vaccines R&D Global Immunology function. The role is a lab-based research scientist who will be participating in various teams to support preclinical and early clinical evaluation of vaccine candidates against various respiratory viruses. Knowledge of immunoassay instruments, including flow cytometer analyzers, high-speed sorter, centrifuges, multi-mode plate readers and plate washers will be required. Individual will be performing laboratory work including flow cytometry and immunoassays, recording data in specified formats and/or recording detailed day-to-day work in electronic laboratory notebook. Responsibilities will include reagent preparation, lab housekeeping and flow cytometry analyzers and cell sorters maintenance. Applicant must be capable of working both independently and as part of a structured team.

 Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Support experimental assay design, optimization, and execute multi-parameter flow cytometry panels (beyond 20 colors) for comprehensive T cell and B cell subset identification
  • Execute multi-cytokine  Intracellular Cytokine Staining (ICS) assays (IFN-?, TNF-?, IL-2, IL-4, IL-17, etc.) following antigen-specific stimulationOperate and maintain flow cytometers (conventional and spectral platforms) with adherence to quality control protocols
  • Execute high-speed, high-purity cell sorting using Sony or similar instrumentation for isolation of antigen-specific T cell and B cell populations or other cell subsets of interest.
  • Optimize sort gates and collection strategies to maximize cell recovery and purity
  • Troubleshoot sort performance issues including clogging, deflection plate alignment, and collection efficiency
  • Analyze flow cytometry data using industry-standard software (OMIQ)
  • Apply appropriate gating strategies following established SOPs and scientific best practices
  • Analyze and summarize experimental outcomes, record experimental procedures and raw and analyzed data in electronic laboratory notebook.
  • Conduct experiments and prepare powerpoint slides for internal presentations as required.
  • Write standard operating procedures (SOPs), and documents for methods, instruments, or work processes as required.
  • Collaborate as needed with internal partners in other functional areas, external vendors, and external scientific partners.
  • Comply with the company safety policies and minimize risk to self, others, and the environment, consistent with the community and industry standards.

Education and Experience Requirements:
  • BS with 4+ years or MS with 2+ years relevant experience. Degree should be in Immunology, Biotechnology, Virology, Biochemistry or related field.
  • Hands-on expertise with multi-parameter flow cytometry (minimum 10-color panels) and/or cell sorting .
  • Demonstrated experience with intracellular cytokine staining in preclinical and/ or human PBMC samples and/or ability to execute sterile sorts, optimize sort gates, and troubleshoot sorter performance.

Key Skills, Abilities, and Competencies:
  • Proficiency in flow cytometry data analysis software (OMIQ preferred)
  • Working knowledge with Good Research Practice (GRP).
  • Ability to expresses one’s self clearly and concisely within team.
  • Good time management and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to work in agile team environment.
  • Attention to details.
  • Data review
  • Training
  • Scheduling
  • GDP
  • GRP, compliance requirements for clinical trial samples.

job.title: Senior Research Associate, Lipid Nanoparticle Formulation
job.description:
Yoh is seeking a hands-on Research Associate or Senior Research Associate to join our client’s Deliver Sciences team developing next-generation lipid nanoparticle delivery systems for nucleic acid-based therapeutics.

This is an opportunity to work on challenging formulation problems at the intersection of Lipid Nanoparticle engineering, nucleic acid delivery, process development, and translational research. The team is looking for someone who has meaningful industry experience developing LNPs and who can contribute to formulation design, optimization, scale-up, characterization, and troubleshooting.

The strongest candidates will bring practical experience understanding how changes in lipid composition, formulation parameters, and downstream processing influence particle properties, stability, biological performance, and in vivo behavior.

Location: South San Francisco, CA
Compensation: $42-$60/hour (based upon level and experience)
Type: Full Time (3+ month contract with potential for extension or conversion to permanent based on performance)

Responsibilities:
  • Design, prepare, and optimize LNP formulations for nucleic acid delivery.
  • Evaluate and optimize formulation parameters, lipid composition, particle properties, and process conditions.
  • Scale LNP formulations from research-scale experiments toward larger preclinical production needs.
  • Perform downstream processing and purification using techniques such as TFF, dialysis, ultracentrifugation, and sterile filtration.
  • Characterize LNPs using techniques such as DLS, chromatography, nucleic acid analysis, osmolality, MALS, ELISA, and fluorescence-based assays.
  • Investigate relationships between formulation composition, physicochemical properties, stability, potency, biodistribution, and tolerability.
  • Troubleshoot formulation and process-development challenges using strong scientific judgment and mechanistic reasoning.
  • Support development of robust, reproducible formulation and analytical workflows.
  • Collaborate with research, preclinical, and development teams to support program advancement.
  • Analyze experimental data, communicate conclusions, and recommend next steps.
  • Maintain accurate experimental documentation in an electronic laboratory notebook.

Qualifications:
Senior Research Associate
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, chemical engineering, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, or a related discipline.
  • At least 2 years of industry experience directly supporting LNP or targeted-LNP research and development.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with LNP formulation, optimization, and scale-up.
  • Experience developing or evaluating multiple LNP compositions rather than only executing established formulations.

Research Associate
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific discipline.
  • At least 1 year of industry experience working directly with LNP formulation or development.

Technical Experience:
Ideal candidates will have experience in several of the following areas:
  • Microfluidic or other LNP mixing technologies
  • Optimization of lipid composition and formulation parameters
  • LNP scale-up and process development
  • TFF, dialysis, sterile filtration, or other downstream purification methods
  • DLS, particle size, PDI, and surface-charge analysis
  • Encapsulation-efficiency assays
  • RNA integrity and degradation analysis
  • Lipid characterization using HPLC, UPLC, LC-UV, LC-CAD, or related methods
  • Fragment analysis, capillary electrophoresis, MALS, or osmolality
  • LNP stability and degradation studies
  • Preclinical formulation support
  • Targeted LNPs, bioconjugation, surface modification, or ligand-based delivery approaches

job.title: Cash Management Operations Specialist
job.description:
Cash Management Operations Specialist
12+ month contract
Tempe, AZ/Fort Mill, SC (Hybrid)
 
Position Overview
The ideal candidate has 2–3 years of financial services or related industry experience, strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to balance transaction processing with inbound and outbound client/advisor interactions.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Process incoming and outgoing domestic and international wire transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Review and enter wire instructions into internal systems and identify foreign/international wire requirements.
  • Perform required AML, OFAC, anti-fraud, and compliance reviews as part of the transaction process.
  • Conduct due diligence to protect clients from fraudulent or unauthorized transactions.
  • Contact financial advisors and other stakeholders to clarify incomplete, incorrect, or potentially problematic transaction information.
  • Educate financial advisors on client sytems, processes, documentation, signatures, and requirements to help successfully complete client transactions.
  • Research and resolve compliance or banking-related questions, including issues that may result in holds or additional review by LPL or receiving banks.
  • Handle both processing work and inbound/outbound calls while maintaining productivity and accuracy.
  • Support NIGO activities and other cash management functions as needed.
  • Cross-train and provide support across other cash operations functions, including ACH, checks, and journals, based on business needs.
  • Participate in ad hoc projects and contribute ideas for process improvements and operational efficiencies.
  • Maintain a high level of professionalism when working with financial advisors and clients, including the ability to handle sensitive or escalated situations.
 
Required Qualifications
  • 2–3 years of experience in financial services, banking, brokerage, or a related industry.
  • Experience processing domestic wires; international wire experience is strongly preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established controls and procedures.
  • Ability to manage a high volume of transactional work while also handling phone-based inquiries.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Comfortable communicating with financial advisors and clients and providing process/system education.
  • Ability to ask appropriate security and verification questions and handle occasional de-escalation situations.
  • Strong problem-solving and investigative skills.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with team members.
  • Flexibility to cross-train and support other cash management functions as business needs change.
  • Beta / legacy banking systems, including platforms such as Thompson or AS/400.
  • LexisNexis or similar AML, OFAC, fraud, or identity-verification systems.
  • Softphone/contact center platforms, such as NICE or CXone.
  • Microsoft Office products.
  • Cloud-based document/storage platforms.
 
Ideal Candidate Profile
The strongest candidates will bring a combination of financial services experience, wire processing knowledge, operational accuracy, and customer-service skills. Candidates who have worked in banking or brokerage environments and have experience with domestic and international wires, AML/fraud processes, legacy banking systems, and call center/softphone environments are especially well aligned.
Candidates should be comfortable working in a structured, highly regulated environment where they must balance speed, accuracy, compliance, client protection, and advisor service.

job.title: QC Lab Supervisor
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring a hands-on Laboratory Supervisor to oversee daily quality-control laboratory activities within a polymer compounding manufacturing environment. The Laboratory Supervisor will perform and coordinate testing of raw materials, in-process materials, and finished products to ensure compliance with established specifications and quality standards. This position works closely with Quality, Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to investigate product-quality issues, support corrective actions, maintain laboratory equipment and documentation, and ensure testing is performed accurately, safely, and in accordance with established procedures and ISO quality requirements.

Location: Elkton, MD 
Schedule: M-F 7-3:30 
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Perform quality-control laboratory testing on raw materials, in-process materials, and finished polymer products.
  • Perform testing including:
    • Tensile testing
    • Compression testing
    • Rheology
    • Viscosity
    • Thermal analysis
    • Chemical extractions
    • Titrations
  • Operate laboratory instruments and equipment in accordance with established procedures and test methods.
  • Perform routine instrument calibrations and verify equipment performance.
  • Follow established laboratory procedures, specifications, work instructions, and quality-system requirements.
  • Review test results for accuracy and identify abnormal or out-of-specification results.
  • Maintain accurate laboratory records, test results, calibration records, and quality documentation.
  • Train laboratory associates on QC procedures, testing methods, equipment operation, documentation, and safety requirements.
  • Work with Quality Associates and Engineers to investigate product-quality issues and support corrective actions.
  • Assist with root-cause investigations and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Provide laboratory testing and analysis to support Manufacturing and Quality teams.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory environment.
  • Follow all company safety policies, laboratory procedures, and applicable ISO quality-system requirements.
  • Assist with maintaining and improving laboratory procedures and testing processes.
Required Qualifications
  • Minimum 2 years of quality-control laboratory or related manufacturing laboratory experience.
  • Experience working in an ISO-regulated quality environment and familiarity with ISO quality-system requirements.
  • Some college coursework required; degree in Chemistry, Polymer Science, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field preferred.
  • Experience performing laboratory testing and working with laboratory instruments.
  • Ability to follow established testing procedures and accurately document results.
  • Basic math skills, including the ability to perform calculations, measurements, percentages, unit conversions, and interpret numerical test results.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate recordkeeping.
  • Ability to recognize abnormal or out-of-specification test results.
  • Ability to train and provide guidance to laboratory associates.
  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.

job.title: Nurse Practitioner or PA-C – Occupational Health
job.description:
Occupational Health Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant needed for a temp contract opportunity with Yoh’s manufacturing client located in Rothschild, WI. Flexible scheduling for 1 to 5 days a week!
The clinic offers occupational and preventative care for employees. You will be the only provider onsite, working alongside an Athletic Trainer. The position is focused on the protection of individuals from occupational and environmental hazards, illness and injury prevention, and health promotion. Job is anticipating to be temporary for about three months, with possibility for extension.
--> SHIFTS: Open availability for one to five days a week, between Monday and Friday. Preferred hours are 8:00am to 4:30pm, but can be flexible.

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Active/unrestricted Nurse Practitioner (ANP/FNP) or Physician Assistant (PA-C) license in state of Wisconsin
  • Minimum of (3) years' experience at a provider level
  • Previous experience in: Occupational/Employee Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Corrections, Primary Care, Internal Medicine, Orthopedics, Family Practice, or Critical Care type setting
  • Must be confident with drawing blood

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Assessment, triage, treatment, and education for employee health concerns
  • Medical surveillance: hearing conservation (audiometry exams), spirometry, drug testing, phlebotomy, etc.
  • Perform onsite physical assessments (pre-placement, return-to-work, fitness-for-duty) and coordinate treatment planning
  • Ambulatory care such as treating sore throats, ear aches, rashes, pink eye, etc.
  • Provide onsite testing for strep pharyngitis, UTI, influenza, hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia
  • Work collaboratively to recognize environmental hazards and/or stresses in or from the workplace that may cause sickness, impaired health, or discomfort among the workers; create preventative measures that ensure the health and safety of employees
  • Provide support and case management for both work-related and non-work-related conditions for the purposes of reducing illness and absenteeism
  • Provide proactive and mobile engagement with the workforce from a prevention standpoint; seek out interactions with employees and build relationships
  • Respond to medical emergencies onsite and provide emergency medical care as-needed

What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Nationally Certified (ANCC or AANP) or NCCP
  • Current BLS
  • Trained in spirometry (NIOSH Certified)
  • Audiometry testing certified (CAOHC/COHC)
  • Certified Drug Test Collector/Certified DOT Specimen Collector
  • Computer skills with previous experience using EMR and MS Office products
  • Interpersonal skills necessary to interview, teach and counsel patients and interact with multidisciplinary team members (EHS, HR, Medical Director)
  • Must be able to meet the physical demands of onsite work needs; ability to lift, push or pull up to 50 pounds, frequent standing, walking, sitting, squatting

What’s In It For You?
  • Grow your expertise in occupational medicine, injury prevention, ergonomics, and workplace wellness
  • Quality-focused clinical environment with dedicated time to educate, coach, and support patients
  • Great work-life balance with no nights, holidays, or weekends
  • Unique, interesting, and rewarding work environment getting to make a real impact on both individual well-being and workplace culture. You're not just treating illness - you're preventing it, promoting healthier work environments, and helping employees stay safe!
  • Weekly direct deposit every Friday!


KNOW A GREAT HEALTHCARE PRO LOOKING FOR WORK? REFER THEM TODAY!

*Yoh Healthcare specializes in occupational/employee health and we place healthcare professionals on jobs nationwide with well-known Fortune 500 companies. Feel free to reach out to hear about the latest Medical Assistant, Nurse, Nurse Practitioner, and Physician Assistant openings!


Recruiter: Leah Tesfai

job.title: Python CPE Network Automation Engineer
job.description:
Python CPE Network Automation Engineer
Seeking a Junior to Entry/Mid-Level Python Network Automation Engineer with 3–5 years of experience to support automated testing of routers, access points, extenders, gateways, and other CPE devices.

Scope:
• Develop Python and Pytest automation for CPE validation.
• Automate device interactions using SSH, REST APIs, cURL, and CLI tools.
• Generate and analyze traffic using iPerf3, Scapy, Wireshark, and Tshark.
• Test throughput, packet loss, latency, roaming, and connectivity.
• Configure Linux test hosts, switches, VLANs, and testbed infrastructure.
• Automate provisioning, firmware flashing, reboots, and configuration changes.
• Integrate tests into Git-based CI/CD pipelines.
• Analyze results, troubleshoot failures, capture packet traces, and document defects.

Required:
• 3–5 years of experience in Python, test automation, network automation, or a related field.
• Proficiency with Python 3, Pytest or unittest, and Bash scripting.
• Working knowledge of Linux administration.
• Familiarity with Paramiko, Netmiko, Requests, Pexpect, or similar libraries.
• Understanding of IP addressing, subnetting, DHCP, DNS, NAT, VLANs, and routing.
• Basic knowledge of WiFi standards, SSIDs, authentication, and performance metrics.
• Experience with Wireshark or tcpdump.
• Experience using Git.
• Strong troubleshooting and communication skills.

Pluses:
• Experience with TR-069, TR-369/USP, OpenSync, or EasyMesh.
• Experience with ByteBlower, OctoScope, Candela, or LANforge.
• Experience testing routers, access points, extenders, or gateways.
• Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field.
• Experience with Pytest fixtures, test parameterization, logging, and subprocess management.

job.title: Senior Revenue Cycle Specialist
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Senior Revenue Cycle Specialist for our healthcare client. In this role, you will be responsible for resolving complex billing and reimbursement issues while maximizing revenue recovery through expert claims analysis, denial management, and payment resolution. The Senior Revenue Cycle Specialist will collaborate with insurance carriers, patients, leadership, and cross-functional teams to ensure timely reimbursement, identify process improvements, and support overall revenue cycle performanc. Experience in Anatomic Pathology or Diagnostic Laboratory billing is required.

Industry:Diagnostics
Location: Onsite / Hybrid (Based on Client Need)

Job Functions
  • Investigate, resolve, and collect payment on complex healthcare billing and reimbursement transactions.
  • Research and resolve unpaid claims, billing discrepancies, denials, and customer complaints to ensure timely and accurate reimbursement.
  • Contact insurance carriers, patients, and other stakeholders to resolve account issues and maximize payment.
  • Review insurance and patient account correspondence to identify outstanding issues and determine appropriate corrective actions.
  • Analyze billing trends and identify recurring reimbursement issues, recommending process improvements to reduce denials and improve collections.
  • Collaborate with leadership and cross-functional teams to develop solutions that improve revenue cycle performance and operational efficiency.
  • Review billing documentation to ensure compliance with payer requirements and regulatory guidelines.
  • Communicate effectively with insurance companies, patients, and internal leadership regarding account status, payment issues, and resolution strategies.
  • Develop and maintain expertise in payer fee schedules, reimbursement methodologies, and denial management.
  • Apply advanced knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payer policies to maximize reimbursement opportunities.
  • Monitor and work aging reports to resolve outstanding accounts receivable and reduce claim aging.
  • Support complex revenue cycle projects and initiatives requiring advanced reimbursement knowledge.
  • Assist with special projects and perform additional duties as assigned.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience in a complex healthcare billing and reimbursement environment.
  • Advanced knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance reimbursement processes.
  • Experience with insurance accounts receivable, denial management, and claims resolution.
  • Experience in Anatomic Pathology or Diagnostic Laboratory billing is required.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare billing regulations, payer policies, and reimbursement methodologies.
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex billing issues independently.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with patients, insurance carriers, clients, leadership, and internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to identify trends, recommend process improvements, and contribute to operational efficiencies.
  • Self-motivated with strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated professionalism, accountability, and commitment to delivering exceptional customer service.

job.title: Senior Speech and Language Specialist
job.description:
Yoh Heathcare has a direct hire opportunity for a Senior Speech and Language Specialist to joint our client in New Brunswick, NJ

Overview
As a Senior Speech and Language Specialist, you'll play a vital role in assessing and supporting students with diverse communication, feeding, and social needs. Working directly with children, adolescents, and young adults, you'll develop and implement tailored interventions that promote independence and social engagement. This position offers an enriching environment where your expertise can inspire growth and transform lives, all within a supportive academic community.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive evaluations of students' speech, language, feeding, and social skills.
  • Analyze diagnostic tests, observations, and input from families and educators to inform personalized treatment plans.
  • Develop, implement, and adjust therapeutic interventions, providing both direct and indirect therapy in individual and small group settings.
  • Monitor student progress meticulously, ensuring interventions are effective and aligned with their educational goals.
  • Participate proactively in IEP meetings and parent conferences, fostering strong collaboration among families, teachers, and Child Study Teams.
  • Train and consult with staff and families to ensure consistency and integration of goals across settings.
  • Support behavioral programs and engage in physically active activities, including crisis management when necessary.
Must-Have Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Speech-Language Pathology or an equivalent field.
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience, especially with students with autism.
  • Current New Jersey Speech-Language Specialist certification or eligibility.
  • NJ Department of Education Speech Language Specialist Standard Certificate.
  • Valid NJ State Licensure in Speech Pathology.
  • Comfort working fully on-site in a busy, active educational environment.
Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) and Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC).
  • Strong school-based clinical background.
  • ASHA Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) or Clinical Fellow (CF).
What's In it for you?
  • Medical, prescription drug, and dental coverage
  • Paid vacation, holidays, and various leave programs
  • Competitive retirement benefits, including defined contribution plans and voluntary tax-deferred savings options
  • Employee and dependent educational benefits (when applicable)
  • Life insurance coverage
  • Employee discount programs

job.title: Materials Coordinator - Las Vegas - Weekend/Part Time/Graveyard
job.description:
Materials Coordinator - Las Vegas/Part Time Weekend/Graveyard Shift

Days/Shift Hours: 
Saturday and Sunday, 12-hour shifts.
6PM-6AM.

Scope:
• Handle the following – Receive, unpack, check & verify merchandise/product ensuring accuracy.
• As needed take receiving exceptions.
• Utilize handheld RF tools to receive merchandise/products into WMS.
• Conduct the following – Stock checks, part # verification, Cycle Count, support physical inventory.
• Consolidate loads as required – Pack, Re-Pack, wrap product for shipping.
• Label parts during put away, picking or shipping process.
• Pick parts for order fulfillment, shipments, scrap requests, etc.
• Ensure orders/shipping materials are accompanied with proper delivery docs: Revised BOL, Manual tag, Packing slip, etc.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures & safety guidelines.
• Perform organization tasks to maintain a clean/safe work environment.
• Cross train to learn other warehouse functions.
• Fill requisitions, work orders, or requests for materials, tools, or stock items & distribute items to production workers or assembly line.
• Always maintain accuracy, provide required reports, measurements, and logs to KPI guidelines.
• Expertise utilizing a warehouse ERP inventory system, Excel, shipping, receiving, safety management, materials handling, data entry, reporting, etc.

Required:
• Experience in the automotive industry in some fashion. Examples are Associates in automotive parts specialist, wholesale parts at dealerships, parts to service, body shop work, military, large automobile manufacturers, etc.
• Experienced in positions such as – parts advisor, parts specialist, inventory technician, materials handlers, parts coordinator, etc.
• Experience with a DMS (Dealer Management System) – CDK, Reynolds and Reynolds, Oracle JDE, Lightspeed, etc. (SAP experience would be great but not required).
• Experience and comfortability working around technicians.
• Experience and ability working with pallet jacks - Forklifts are not required.
• Experience with basic supply chain skills.
• Experience putting together spreadsheets and tables.
• Willing to put in extra work during down times by organizing the shop, stacking tires, disposing of tires, picking up deliveries, etc.
• Must be comfortable working as a team.

job.title: Fleet Compliance Documentation Management
job.description:
Fleet Compliance and Materials Coordinator
The AV Compliance Fleet team is seeking a highly organized and reliable specialist to support vehicle registration, compliance documentation, materials coordination, and fleet operations in Mountain View. This six-month assignment requires work from the Mountain View office five days per week, with frequent travel to the Industry Business Center and FedEx locations.

Scope:
• Prepare and assemble vehicle registration packets and supporting documentation.
• Transport registration materials to the Industry Business Center for processing.
• Retrieve completed documents, permits, and license plates.
• Log, organize, and track all materials and registration activity.
• Package and ship completed materials to designated offices.
• Maintain accurate records, trackers, and status updates.
• Coordinate deadlines and follow-ups across fleet, compliance, and operations teams.
• Support additional documentation, materials coordination, and fleet compliance activities.
• Use Google Workspace tools, including Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Docs.
• Safeguard all documents, permits, license plates, and related materials.
• Travel frequently between Mountain View, the Industry Business Center, and FedEx locations.

Required:
• Experience in project coordination, materials coordination, compliance, fleet operations, document control, or a related field.
• Exceptional organization, attention to detail, reliability, and trustworthiness.
• Experience managing documents, deadlines, trackers, and multiple priorities.
• Proficiency with Google Workspace.
• Strong communication and follow-up skills.
• Ability to work independently and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
• Valid driver’s license and ability to travel locally.
• Ability to work 30–40 hours per week for six months.

Pluses:
• Vehicle registration, DMV, fleet compliance, or permit experience.
• Experience with shipping, FedEx, inventory, or materials intake.
• Experience working with government agencies or external processing centers.
• Automotive, autonomous vehicle, transportation, or mobility industry experience.
• Prior senior materials coordination, operations coordination, or project support experience.

We have several long term contract opportunities for a Semiconductor Electronics Manufacturing Tech  Location: Austin, TX (Onsite)
Employment Type: 18-Month Contract with Potential for Direct Hire

Sign-On Bonus: $1,000

Night/Swing: 10%

Position Overview We are seeking a motivated Engineering Technician to join our team in Austin, TX. This role supports the testing, maintenance, troubleshooting, and qualification of advanced semiconductor equipment in both research and production environments. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical troubleshooting skills, a commitment to safety, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced setting.

  • Perform testing, maintenance, and repair of Ion Implanters and RF Plasma Systems
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot equipment malfunctions to minimize downtime
  • Support engineers and scientists in both R&D and manufacturing operations
  • Conduct preventive maintenance and maintain accurate service documentation
  • Assist with the installation, setup, and qualification of new semiconductor equipment
  • Follow established safety procedures and operational guidelines

  • Associate degree, technical certification, or equivalent training in Electronics, Robotics, Engineering Technology, or a related field
  • 2 to 4 years of relevant technical or engineering support experience
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, diagrams, and technical documentation
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated commitment to workplace safety and operational excellence
  • Flexibility to support varying schedules or shifts as business needs require

job.description:
Human Resources- Sourcer/Recruiter ( Corporate Recruiter/Professional Recruiter) 

We are seeking an experienced Contract Sourcer / Recruiter to support hiring needs across multiple business groups.

Job Description: 

Duration: 6 months contract 
Location: Hybrid in NY preferred, Open to  Remote EST 
Pay Rate: $40-$45 hourly W2 


Key Responsibilities:

Recruiting & Sourcing
• Develop and execute sourcing strategies using direct outreach, referrals, social platforms, and talent search tools.
• Screen and assess candidates, moving them through the process with strong communication and follow through.
• Provide market insights on talent availability, competition, and sourcing challenges.

Candidate & Stakeholder Engagement
• Partner closely with TA and hiring managers to align on search strategy and progress.
• Deliver an engaging, high quality candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
• Collaborate with Talent Partners and Compensation teams to support competitive offer development.

Tools, Data & Process
• Maintain accurate and compliant candidate data within Workday Recruiting (preferred) or other ATS systems.
• Use recruiting metrics to track pipeline health and provide regular updates to stakeholders.
• Support consistent recruiting processes and adherence to standards.

Pipeline & Network Development
• Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
• Develop strong external networks within relevant functional and industry markets.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent experience.
• 7+ years of professional level recruiting experience; financial services or insurance industry experience strongly preferred.
• Strong sourcing skills, including advanced search, passive candidate outreach, and talent market research.
• Proven experience recruiting across multiple functions and geographies in fast paced corporate or search firm environments.
• Excellent communication and relationship building skills with the ability to influence and guide hiring leaders.
• Strong assessment capabilities with sound judgment around candidate fit and hiring recommendations.
• Highly organized, able to manage multiple requisitions, shifting priorities, and tight timelines.
• Proficient with ATS platforms; Workday Recruiting strongly preferred.
• Comfortable using analytics, dashboards, and reporting to monitor pipelines and inform decisions.
• Self- driven, adaptable, and able to operate independently with minimal guidance.

job.title: Audio Test Engineer
job.description:
Audio Test Engineer
Looking for an audio test engineer who can support a consumer HW lab focused on wearable technologies.

Required:
• 5+ years of experience working in audio testing of consumer products in an R&D environment.
• Solid understanding of test methodologies of device subsystems.
• Experience running electroacoustic measurements using a variety of tools – Audio Precision, Soundcheck, or similar.
• Experience of using basic electronic measurements tools - multimeter and oscilloscope.
• Experience with fast-paced prototyping and validation.
• Experience with basic signal processing tools like Audacity.
• End-to-end knowledge of audio signal chains for consumer electronics.
• Experience with acoustic transducers & signal processing fundamentals.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and drive testing with little guidance.
• Create test plans for new products and features ensuring there is adequate test coverage.
• Troubleshoot any problems down to the root cause and provide bug reports.
• Experience with acoustic audio testing on HW – (speakers and microphones).
• Formulate test strategies, design test cases, create automated test scripts for testing new prototypes.
• Experience testing audio product acoustics.

Pluses:
• Experience with Python,  C/C++, and Linux Operating System.

---> Job is expected to start ASAP and full-time coverage needed until around December 7th to cover a leave of absence.

Duties will consist of first-aid, basic walk-in care (minor acute care like colds, rashes, pink eye, etc.), assisting with surveillance exams, responding to medical emergencies, and a lot of computer work. job.title: UAS Hardware Integration Technician
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, 12-month contract opportunity for a UAS Hardware Integration Technician to join our Autonomous Technology client in San Diego, CA. This position is ideal for an experienced, hands-on technician who enjoys building, integrating, testing, and troubleshooting electrical and electromechanical systems supporting unmanned and autonomous aircraft.

This is a fully onsite position, and candidates must be within a commutable distance of the San Diego facility.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: UAS Hardware Integration Technician
Compensation: $50.00–$60.00/hour, depending on experience
Type: 12-Month Contract; potential to extend or convert 
Location: San Diego, CA; Onsite
Eligibility: Due to the nature of the work and applicable export-control requirements, candidates must qualify as a U.S. Person under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR).

Responsibilities
  • Build, install, test, and maintain electrical and electromechanical hardware used across unmanned aircraft, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) environments, and ground-based test equipment.
  • Integrate aircraft computing hardware, flight controllers, sensors, actuators, communications equipment, payloads, and electrical power components into functional test and flight configurations.
  • Assemble and support low-voltage DC electrical systems, including power distribution, circuit protection, grounding, shielding, load management, and power verification.
  • Fabricate and inspect electrical cables and wire harnesses, including connector assembly, pinning, crimping, soldering, termination, labeling, routing, strain relief, and continuity checks.
  • Interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, connector pinouts, interface documentation, and equipment specifications to support system assembly and troubleshooting.
  • Diagnose electrical, communications, and electromechanical issues through signal tracing, point-to-point testing, fault isolation, and component-level evaluation.
  • Utilize oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, power supplies, electronic loads, logic analyzers, and other laboratory equipment to validate system performance.
  • Configure and troubleshoot common aircraft and test-system communications interfaces, which may include CAN, Ethernet, RS-232/422/485, and MIL-STD-1553.
  • Maintain test and aircraft hardware through inspections, repairs, preventive maintenance, calibration coordination, configuration management, and technical documentation.
  • Evaluate and source hardware components and test equipment based on performance, environmental, cost, and availability requirements.
  • Maintain bills of materials, hardware records, approved component alternatives, inventory information, and as-built system documentation.
  • Provide hands-on technical support during laboratory testing, ground testing, and flight-test activities.
Qualifications
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building, integrating, troubleshooting, or repairing UAS platforms, HIL systems, robotics, aerospace hardware, or similar electromechanical systems.
  • Strong understanding of UAS or robotic hardware, including flight controllers, onboard computers, sensors, actuators, payloads, communications hardware, and ground systems.
  • Experience working with low-voltage DC electrical systems, power distribution, circuit protection, grounding, bonding, shielding, and load management.
  • Proficiency with cable and wire-harness fabrication techniques, including crimping, soldering, connector assembly, termination, routing, labeling, and continuity testing.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, connector pinouts, interface drawings, and technical specifications.
  • Hands-on troubleshooting experience using electrical and electronic test equipment such as DMMs, oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, and logic analyzers.
  • Strong documentation, organization, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively across engineering and testing teams.
  • Must meet applicable ITAR U.S. Person requirements for access to export-controlled technical information.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting autonomous aircraft, robotics, or other integrated electromechanical platforms.
  • Knowledge of analog, digital, PWM, discrete, CAN, serial, and Ethernet interfaces.
  • Familiarity with UAS and embedded-computing technologies such as PX4, ArduPilot, QGroundControl, Mission Planner, MAVLink, NVIDIA Jetson, Linux, or ROS/ROS 2.
  • Experience building or maintaining HIL systems, test fixtures, breakout boxes, simulation hardware, or automated test equipment.
  • Familiarity with mechanical CAD, additive manufacturing, and fabrication of brackets, enclosures, or other supporting hardware.
  • Knowledge of aerospace or electronics workmanship standards is a plus.

job.title: Plant Manager -Sioux Falls, SD
job.description:
Send updated resumes to Tymir Black
Tymir.Black@yoh.com
https://www.linkedin.com/in/tymir-black-035914111/

Globally trusted leader in manufacturing innovative instrumentation solutions for the Process Measurement, Automation, Control, and HVAC markets. With very strong brand recognition and high levels of customer loyalty, the Client has a reputation for providing customized solutions that meet and exceed customer needs. Our team of engineering experts helps our customers select technical and often configured product solutions for their unique applications.
We now seek a Plant Manager to be responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and day-to-day operation of the Sioux Falls manufacturing facility. This role provides leadership across manufacturing, safety, quality, materials, maintenance, and continuous improvement to ensure the site consistently delivers outstanding service to customers while meeting business objectives.
As Plant Manager, you will be accountable for creating a safe, engaged, and high-performing work environment where employees are empowered to continuously improve processes, solve problems, and deliver operational excellence. Working closely with corporate functional leaders and other manufacturing sites, this position develops and executes site strategies that improve safety, quality, delivery, productivity, inventory performance, and cost while supporting future business growth.
As the senior leader for the facility, the Plant Manager serves as a visible champion of values, develops talent, builds strong cross-functional partnerships, and fosters a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Key Accountabilities
  • Provide overall leadership and management for all manufacturing operations at the Sioux Falls facility.
  • Foster a culture where safety is the highest priority by ensuring compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and proactive safety initiatives.
  • Lead and develop team members through coaching, performance management, recognition, and employee development.
  • Drive operational excellence by achieving performance targets for safety, quality, delivery, productivity, inventory, and cost.
  • Establish clear operational priorities and ensure production schedules are executed efficiently while meeting customer commitments.
  • Monitor plant performance through key performance indicators (KPIs) and implement corrective actions to improve results.
  • Champion Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives to eliminate waste, improve processes, and increase operational efficiency.
  • Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Customer Service, Human Resources, and Finance to resolve operational challenges and support business objectives.
  • Lead workforce planning activities, including staffing, scheduling, training, and succession planning, to ensure the organization has the capability to meet current and future business needs.
  • Develop and manage the plant operating budget, including labor, overtime, inventory, capital expenditures, and operating expenses.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements, environmental standards, and company policies.
  • Support new product introductions, process improvements, and capital investment projects.
  • Promote employee engagement through regular communication, visibility on the production floor, and recognition of team accomplishments.
  • Identify operational risks and develop mitigation plans to minimize business disruption.
  • Share best practices and collaborate with leaders across other Client manufacturing locations to improve enterprise performance.
Experience Required
  • 7+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
  • 3+ years leading a manufacturing operation or major functional area.
  • Experience in a low-volume/high-mix manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Experience with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Lean Manufacturing certification and/or Six Sigma Green Belt or higher.
  • ISO 9001 manufacturing experience.
  • Experience supporting capital improvement projects and facility expansions.
Education RequiredBachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing, Business, or a related discipline required. Equivalent manufacturing leadership experience may be considered.
Knowledge, Skills & AbilitiesLeadership:
  • Demonstrated ability to build engaged, accountable, and high-performing teams.
  • Strong coaching, mentoring, and employee development skills.
  • Ability to lead change while maintaining employee engagement.
  • Promotes a positive, inclusive, and collaborative work environment.
Operational Excellence:
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, production planning, inventory management, quality systems, and maintenance.
  • Experience driving measurable improvements in safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost.
  • Working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles; Six Sigma certification or experience is preferred.
Financial Acumen:
  • Experience managing plant budgets and controlling operating expenses.
  • Understanding of labor productivity, inventory management, and manufacturing cost drivers.
Technical Skills:
  • Experience using ERP systems and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to analyze operational data and use metrics to drive decision-making.
Communication Skills:
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with production employees, corporate leadership, customers, and suppliers.
  • Skilled at facilitating problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration.
TravelDomestic travel required at times (approximately 10%).

job.title: Materials Coordinator - San Antonio/AM (Wed-Sat, 7AM-6PM Shift).
job.description:
Materials Coordinator - San Antonio/AM (Wed-Sat, 7AM-6PM Shift).

Scope:

• Handle the following – Receive, unpack, check & verify merchandise/product ensuring accuracy.

• SW tools like SAP, Reynolds and Reynolds, Lightspeed, etc..

• Utilize handheld RF tools to receive merchandise/products into WMS.

• Conduct the following – Stock checks, part # verification, Cycle Count, support physical inventory.

• Consolidate loads as required – Pack, Re-Pack, wrap product for shipping.

• Label parts during put away, picking or shipping process.

• Pick parts for order fulfillment, shipments, scrap requests, etc.

• Ensure orders/shipping materials are accompanied with proper delivery docs: Revised BOL, Manual tag, Packing slip, etc.

• Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures & safety guidelines.

• Perform organization tasks to maintain a clean/safe work environment.

• Cross train to learn other warehouse functions.

• Fill requisitions, work orders, or requests for materials, tools, or stock items & distribute items to production workers or assembly line.

• Always maintain accuracy, provide required reports, measurements and logs to KPI guidelines.

• Expertise utilizing a warehouse ERP inventory system, Excel, shipping, receiving, safety management, materials handling, data entry, reporting, etc.

 

Required:

• Experience in the automotive industry in some fashion. Examples are Associates in automotive tech, wholesale parts at dealerships, parts to service, body shop work, military, large automobile manufacturers, etc.

• Experience and comfortability working around technicians.

• Experience and ability working with pallet jacks - Forklifts are not required.

• Experience with basic supply chain skills.

• Experience putting together spreadsheets and tables.

• Willing to put in extra work during down times by organizing the shop, stacking tires, disposing of tires, picking up deliveries, etc.

• Must be comfortable working as a team.

job.title: Structural Engineer
job.description:
Staff Structural Engineer  

Join our dynamic team as a Staff Structural Engineer and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of transmission tower infrastructure! In this engaging position, you will lead multiple phases of structural design, analysis, and project documentation for a diverse portfolio of transmission tower projects. Your expertise will directly influence innovative solutions in the energy sector, working on everything from conceptual design to detailed construction drawings. If you’re passionate about structural engineering and eager to work on impactful infrastructure projects, this opportunity offers a perfect blend of challenge and growth.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Structural Engineering or related from an ABET-accredited program, with 3+ years of experience; or successful FE exam completion with 3+ years’ experience; or Master’s Degree with 2+ years’ experience
  • Proficiency in structural analysis and modeling software such as RISA-3D, ETABS, SAFE, and BIM tools like Revit and Tekla
  • Strong knowledge of design codes, specifications, and engineering techniques
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, and organizational abilities
  • Ability to work methodically, analyze complex data, and collaborate effectively with teams
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Engineers in Training (EIT) certification
  • Experience with PLS-Tower modeling, FEM structure modeling, and reinforcement design
  • Knowledge of retrofit or new construction projects for transmission towers
  • Familiarity with project management and proposal development processes
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Structural Engineering or related field from an ABET-accredited institution
  • 2-3 years of relevant structural engineering experience, particularly in transmission towers or similar structures
  • Existing EIT certification is advantageous
Other Requirements:

  • Willingness to travel up to 10% for project site visits and meetings
  • Ability to obtain and maintain necessary certifications and work authorization
Ready to make an impact in a challenging and rewarding environment? Apply now to become a key contributor to innovative infrastructure projects that power our communities!

job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a  Production Technician in Rockville, MD.  The Production Technician will support the veterinary diagnostic manufacturing processes. General responsibilities include assembling, filling, labeling, and kitting small light-weight products in a manufacturing laboratory environment. The position will also assist with order picking, packing and warehousing.

Title: Production Technician
Location: Rockville, MD
Shift: M-F 2:30pm -11pm 


Duties and Responsibilities:
Generate calibration for manufactured lots of disposable cartridges.
Conducts routine and non-routine analysis, including but not limited to biochemical and chemical analysis of raw materials, in-process items, and finished products according to established operating procedures
Experience working in a regulated environment (FDA, Quality Systems, ISO 13485:2016).
Calibrates and maintains lab and analytical equipment.
Generates and/or review’s data for compliance to specifications and reports abnormalities.
Good understanding of blook-based products, lab operations and protocols.

Education, Licensure, and/or Experience
  • A minimum of two years IVD / medical device industry experience and/or a minimum of one to two years in laboratory quality control, preferred.
  • Experience working withing a GMP environment
  • Strong written and oral communication skills; must be able to deliver complex technical reports and communicate effectively with management, partners and technical audiences.

job.description:
Commercial Operations Analyst
12+ month contract
Plano, TX (Hybrid 4 days in office)
 
  • Need someone with an Accounting Background and not Mortgage. 
  • Need to be oriented, open to do Data entry related tasks and has exposure with MS Office tools.
  • Someone comes with Finance or legal background will be helpful as this person will be dealing with Loan documents.
  • Any exposure with Commercial Lending - Captive Finance lending or Dealership will be very helpful (Not mandatory).

What you’ll be doing. Daily Task includes:

job.title: Compliance Materials and Document Logistics Coordinator
job.description:
Compliance Materials and Document Logistics Coordinator
We are seeking a detail-oriented coordinator to support materials intake, document printing, filing, and delivery activities. This role will organize incoming vehicle compliance materials, maintain accurate records, prepare documents for distribution, and coordinate deliveries to Waymo depots and offices, FedEx, and other locations as needed.
 
Scope:
• Receive, inspect, and organize incoming materials and documentation.
• Print, prepare, label, and file documents according to established procedures.
• Maintain accurate physical and digital filing systems.
• Track materials, documents, shipments, and delivery status.
• Update electronic trackers and share communications to reflect the latest materials status.
• Prepare packages and materials for depot delivery, including locations such as Waymo's depots.
• Coordinate FedEx shipments and other deliveries as required.
• Deliver or distribute materials to depots and internal stakeholders.
• Maintain an organized work area and ensure materials are stored appropriately.
• Identify missing, damaged, or incorrect materials and escalate issues.
• Support general administrative and materials coordination tasks.
 
Required:
• Experience with materials intake, document control, filing, shipping, or logistics support.
• Strong organization and attention to detail.
• Ability to accurately print, label, sort, and maintain records.
• Familiarity with FedEx or similar shipping platforms.
• Ability to follow procedures and manage multiple requests.
• Basic computer skills, including email, spreadsheets, printing, and document management.
• Reliable transportation or ability to support local deliveries, if required.
 
Pluses:
• Experience supporting depot, warehouse, laboratory, or operations environments.
• Familiarity with inventory or document-tracking systems.

job.title: Music Industry, Solutions Coordinator - Hybrid in NYC
job.description:
Solutions Coordinator within the music industry! 

- Hybrid onsite in NYC
- 6 month contract 
- $25/hr on W2

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponorship. No C2C!

Our company is seeking a Coordinator, Solutions to join our dynamic Enterprise team. In this role, you will work closely with various businesses across Sony Music supporting them and their artists and labels within The Orchard’s supply chain and systems, overseeing key elements of the client experience, and synthesizing interactions across departments. You will be responsible for providing a centralized, solutions-based voice in support of these businesses as they work within The Orchard ecosystem and will supervise the comprehensive client onboarding process, focusing on a positive first experience and ongoing operational questions and concerns. This is a highly responsible role that requires proactive problem-solving skills, a keen eye for detail, and a love for all types of music.
 
What You’ll Do:
  • Serve as a representative of The Orchard’s administrative teams (including legal, finance, and operations) to both Sony Music business units and their artists and labels, addressing issues, gathering feedback, and advocating for Sony Music business unit needs within the organization.
  • Act as point of contact for questions pertaining to operational functions across the organization, serving as a focal point of information and defining internal processes and procedures.
  • Understand how to troubleshoot problems effectively and identify the right teams to interact with in order to get reliable solutions and answers.
  • Advise on digital product supply chain and operations, and manage complex digital release set-ups in accordance with client and campaign specified needs (QC, timed releases, rights management, etc.)
  • Assist with the setup and day-to-day management of distribution and publishing agreements across business units, incl. advance payments, tracking of new deliveries and terminations.
  • Focus on clear, solution-based responses to internal and external queries regarding client questions.
  • Ability to handle high volume inbound needs from clients and ensure they are being addressed in a timely manner.
  • Assist in the training and continued education of Sony Music team members working within the Orchard systems, across all applications.
 
Who You Are:
  • Multi-tasker with supreme attention to detail, follow-through and effective prioritization.
  • Patient and empathetic.
  • Effective communicator on phone, email, and in person.
  • Resourceful, problem solver, and takes initiative - an expert and motivated troubleshooter.
  • Spanish language skills preferred, but not required.

job.title: Shipping Associate
job.description:
Yoh is looking for a Shipping Associate to join our biotech manufacturing client in Pleasanton, CA.

This is a great opportunity for someone with approximately 1–2 years of order picking, fulfillment, warehouse, or related experience who is dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Prior biotech or pharmaceutical experience is not required.

Candidates with experience picking customer or warehouse orders in manufacturing, distribution, retail fulfillment, e-commerce, or similar environments are encouraged to apply.

Industry: Biotech / Manufacturing
Location: Pleasanton, CA
Schedule: 8:00 AM–4:30 PM, with availability for overtime as needed
Compensation: $22–$26/hour DOE
Type: 6-month contract

Responsibilities
  • Pick and prepare materials and orders accurately for internal and external customers
  • Use RF scanners or similar handheld devices to locate, scan, and confirm materials
  • Receive, inspect, count, label, and put away incoming materials
  • Maintain accurate inventory locations and material records
  • Assist with packing ambient and temperature-sensitive materials as needed
  • Process basic inventory transactions in the company ERP/WMS system
  • Support cycle counts and general warehouse activities
  • Help maintain an organized, safe, and efficient work area
  • Work collaboratively with the shipping, production, and warehouse teams

Qualifications
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Approximately 1–2 years of order picking, fulfillment, warehouse, shipping, or similar experience
  • Hands-on experience using an RF scanner, handheld scanner, or similar order-picking system preferred
  • Experience with Oracle or another ERP/WMS system is a plus, but not required
  • Biotech, pharmaceutical, or manufacturing experience is a plus, but not required
  • Strong attendance, reliability, and attention to detail
  • Ability to follow instructions and work independently once trained
  • Comfortable working on your feet for extended periods and performing normal warehouse material-handling activities
  • Willingness to work overtime or occasional weekends when business needs require
  • Comfortable working for periods of time in cold-room/freezer environments when required

Experience with dry ice or temperature-sensitive shipping is a plus, but not required.

Any pay ranges displayed are estimates that may have been provided by job boards. Actual pay is determined based on experience, technical expertise, and other qualifications. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

job.title: Senior Quality Control Chemist Technician
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Senior Quality Control Technician for our medical device manufacturing client in St. Paul, MN. In this role, you will be responsible for performing quality control inspections, laboratory testing, and product acceptance activities for sterile and non-sterile medical devices. The Senior Quality Control Technician will ensure products meet approved specifications, procedures, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory standards while supporting manufacturing, laboratory, and quality operations.
Industry: Medical Device Manufacturing
Location: St. Paul, MN
Compensation: $28/hr
Type:Direct Hire 

Job Functions·
· Perform incoming, in-process, final, and finished product QC inspections to verify conformance to specifications, customer requirements, and quality system requirements.
· Perform accurate measurements and document inspection and testing results with a high level of attention to detail.
· Ensure inspections and testing activities are completed in accordance with production schedules and established priorities.
· Review manufacturing records, sterile processing documentation, test results, certifications, labeling, and related paperwork for compliance with specifications and quality system requirements.
· Support Warehouse associates to ensure materials are properly handled and stored according to specifications and quality system requirements.
· Collect, prepare, and submit samples to internal and external laboratories.
· Prepare sterilization documentation and analyze sterilization and biological indicator results.
· Perform UV-Vis, FTIR, and basic wet chemistry testing and analyze results against established specifications.
· Prepare and mix chemical formulations for Production and Manufacturing use.
· Perform environmental monitoring activities, including temperature and humidity monitoring and controlled environment testing.
· Identify, document, segregate, and quarantine nonconforming materials to prevent unintended use.
· Assist with investigations involving products or processes suspected of being nonconforming.
· Coordinate Material Review Board activities and support timely disposition of nonconforming materials.
· Communicate with applicable stakeholders regarding materials awaiting MRB review, action, or disposition.
· Maintain controlled access to QA Hold and Quarantine areas.
· Inspect returned goods and ensure nonconforming materials are appropriately segregated.
· Maintain the equipment calibration program to ensure production, test, and measurement equipment is calibrated by required due dates.
· Verify equipment is appropriately identified with calibration status and remove equipment from service when calibration is expired or out of specification.
· Verify preventive maintenance and equipment qualification activities are completed as required.
· Assist with maintaining Quality Assurance work instructions in accordance with current regulations, standards, and quality system requirements.

Education,
· Licensure and/or Experience· Associate degree or higher in a STEM-related discipline required.
· 3+ years of experience in quality control and inspection within a medical device manufacturing environment.
· Experience preparing technical reports, analyses, and documentation using Microsoft Office.
· Ability to interpret blueprints, technical documentation, specifications, and procedures.
· Working knowledge of analytical chemistry.
· Applied knowledge of quality control, inspection methodologies, and test and measurement instrumentation.
· Experience using measurement and inspection instruments including gauges, micrometers, calipers, indicators, comparators, and microscopes.
· Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce precise measurements, documentation, and quality records.
· Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with auditors, suppliers, management, and cross-functional teams.
· Excellent hand-eye coordination and visual acuity, including color vision, close vision, and the ability to identify fine details under magnification.

Preferred Qualifications·
·  Two-year technical degree.
· Training or certification related to ISO 13485 and FDA quality systems.
· Experience with sterilization, microbiology, and chemistry.
· Knowledge of Good Laboratory Practices.
· Strong manual dexterity.

Physical Job Requirements·
· Regularly required to stand, walk, sit, and use hands to manipulate, handle, or operate objects, tools, controls, and office equipment.
· Frequently required to communicate verbally and hear.
· Occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
· Specific vision requirements include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
· Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

job.title: Equipment Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is seeking an experienced Equipment Maintenance Technician to support our biopharmaceutical customer in the Greater Philadelphia Region. This individual will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and regulatory compliance of GMP manufacturing and laboratory equipment.

The Equipment Maintenance Technician will be responsible for performing preventative and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, installations, and equipment upgrades across GMP manufacturing equipment, laboratory


Location: Bristol, PA 
Pay: $80,000 - 105,000 DOE
Type: Diret Hire  
Shift: Monday - Friday, 8AM - 5PM 
 

Responsibilities
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical, mechanical, instrumentation, and control systems line diagrams and prints 
  • Familiarity with servicing of equipment consisting of boilers, chillers, air compressors, deionized water generation, HVAC, piping distribution systems, generators, GMP suite maintenance, and building maintenance/upkeep 
  • Support the daily Facilities and Engineering work flow through escorting and supervising contractors/vendors, performing equipment moves, handling equipment deliveries, transferring equipment/materials between offsite storage, and other tasks as assigned 
  • Perform corrective maintenance and emergency repairs to minimize equipment downtime. 
  • Follow Good Documentation Practices (GDP) and cGMP requirements when documenting maintenance activities. 
  • Support equipment purchases such as uncrating, moving, installing, and connecting required plant utilities to the point of use 
  • Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and process equipment failures. 
  • Work may include systems repairs/modifications encompassing HVAC, VFD’s, piping/plumbing, lighting, flooring, drywall, grounds, painting, and other areas that are not noted 
  • Ensure all maintenance activities are performed safely and in accordance with OSHA, environmental, and company safety requirements. 
  • Support shutdown activities, equipment relocations, facility projects, and capital improvement initiatives. 
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to support manufacturing and facility operations outside normal business hours. 
  • Maintain F&E owned areas and ability to perform work in accordance with site expectations and pharmaceutical industry standards 


Qualifications
  • 1-3 years minimum experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, research, or equivalent highly regulated environment. 
  • Supported maintenance activities within utility areas, labs, and classified cleanrooms with following gowning procedures and safety protocols 
  • Supporting electrical/mechanical/facility installation projects 
  • Experience with BMS/EMS systems
  • Experience using CMMS systems such as Blue Mountain, Maximo, Qualer, or equivalent 
  • Strong electrical and mechanical capabilities/aptitude 
  • Work collaboratively and productively across multiple site departments 
  • Associate degree in Mechanical Technology, Electrical technology, Mechatronics, or related technical discipline

job.title: Systems Integration Engineer
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Systems Integration Engineer in Houston or Austin, TX. The Systems Integration Engineer will lead the mechanical, electrical, optical, and fluidic packaging of our proprietary analytical technologies into ruggedized, field-deployable products. major near-term focus for this position will be leading the systems integration for a new project measuring water quality parameters (produced water, flowback, and injection water) in harsh hydraulic fracturing environments, alongside our existing gas and liquid hydrocarbon applications. This role requires an interdisciplinary engineer who thrives on 3D CAD design, custom sampling systems, and hands-on field deployment.
 
Title: Systems Integration Engineer
Duration: DH
Location: Houston or Austin, TX
Shift: M-F 8-5pm

The Systems Integration Engineer will have direct responsibility for the following:
• Act as the technical lead for evaluating, sourcing, and integrating diverse third-party sensors (e.g., pH, conductivity, turbidity, pressure) into our core platform to fulfill unique customer measurement requests.
Design and specify custom sample conditioning systems (SCS) for both liquid and gas hydrocarbon/water streams. This includes integrating pressure regulation, active temperature control (heating/cooling), filtration loops, flow control, and automated grab-sampling systems.
• Own the layout, wiring, and thermal management of industrial, optional air-conditioned enclosures. Safely package complex internal hardware stacks, including spectrometers, fiber-optic routing, power supplies, embedded computers, ethernet switches, cellular modems, and PLCs.
• Evaluate and select appropriate wetted materials (e.g., 316SS, Hastelloy, Monel, PTFE) to ensure long-term system reliability when handling highly corrosive process streams or high-salinity oilfield water.
• Create, manage, and maintain complete engineering documentation packages using 3D and 2D CAD (SolidWorks). Deliverables include detailed mechanical manufacturing drawings, sheet metal design, piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), electrical schematics, bill of materials (BOMs), and custom installation/user/service manuals.
• Travel to customer sites to support installation, commissioning, site-acceptance testing (SAT), and hands-on troubleshooting of integrated systems in the field.
• Interface with fabrication partners, machine shops, and enclosure vendors. Supervise prototyping phases, conduct design reviews, and establish quality control/testing protocols for production-ready units.

The successful candidate will demonstrate the following competencies:
• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
• 5+ years of hands-on experience in product design, systems integration, or custom panel design – ideally within the process analytical, oil and gas, or water treatment industries.
• Proficient in 3D CAD software (SolidWorks preferred) with deep knowledge of geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) and standard drafting practices.
• Familiarity with industrial hardware integration, including DC power distribution, PLCs, ethernet switches, cell modems, and industrial PCs.
• Proven experience designing NEMA 4X/IP66 industrial enclosures, including active thermal management calculations (heat load, solar gain, cooling sizing).
• Solid understanding of designing for Class I, Division 2 (C1D2) environments, including explosion-proof wiring and purge/pressurization systems.
• Willingness and capability to work in industrial field environments for deployment, commissioning, and technical troubleshooting.

Preferred Qualifications
• Direct experience with water chemistry or water management systems in hydraulic fracturing (fracking) operations.
• Familiarity with spectroscopy, laser safety protocols, or optoelectronic sub-systems.
• Hands-on prototyping skills (building test fixtures, light assembly, or fluidic plumbing).
• Experience of product design to meet strict regulatory and safety standards, ensuring compliance with Class I, Division 2 (C1D2) or Zone 2 requirements using methods such as physical isolation, explosion-proof components, or purge and pressurization systems.
Position Requirements
This is a full-time position based out of Houston, Austin, or Remote with standard business hours of 8:00am – 5:00pm, Monday through Friday. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required based on business needs.
