job.title: Cosmetic R&D Chemist
job.description:
Our client, a Cosmetic Manufacturer that specializes in personal care products located in Southern California, a hub for the beauty industry, is actively looking to add a Cosmetic R&D Chemist to their team:

Industry: Cosmetics
Location: Los Angeles, CA
Type: Direct Hire
Shift: Monday-Friday: 8:00am-5:00pm

KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: 
  • Develop new formulas and reverse engineered formula based on customer’s briefs and price target.
  • Reformulate and improve existing formulas.
  • Follow new trends closely with new products launches, ingredients and new concept such as “free from” claims.
  • Be familiar with the formulation restrictions using these claims.
  • Be familiar with cosmetic ingredient especially their function, delivery system, interaction depending of media/base.
  • Meet with suppliers and keep product files (clinical and regulatory).
  • Work on Innovation, create new textures, concepts, actives to keep our R&D with cutting edge formulation.
  • Help creating marketing sheet to present to our customers in innovation seminars.
  • Request raw material pricing and input in our pricing matrix.
  • Evaluation/Selection/Advice regarding testing; Claims, Safety, Microbiology.
  • Assist Regulatory department requesting all the necessary ingredient information.
  • Be flexible with project priorities as they vary from time to time and manage a large workload under tight timeline.
  • Be able to make decisions to troubleshoot production or compounding. Improve and/or revise manufacturing/filling process if needed.
  • Work closely with our chemists to help on challenging projects or when needed.
  • Work closely with our Quality department to improve knowledge about new formulas, establishing standards.
  • Maintain the laboratory clean and organized, respecting GLP’s.
 
QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Bachelor of Science or higher degree in chemistry or related field.
  • Color formulation experience.
  • Creative thinking, technical writing and organizational skills.
  • At least 6 years and more of industry experience on the bench formulating.
  • Knowledge of cosmetic/personal care raw materials, functionality, and interactions.
  • Understanding of emulsion and surfactant technology as well as general formulation techniques.
  • Must be familiar with regulation for US market and other countries for globally approved formulas, especially for the natural and organic market (NSF, USDA/NOP, NPA).
#IND-SPG

job.title: Mid-Level Vehicle Systems Technician – Car-on-Bench Support
job.description:
Mid-Level Systems Technician
Seeking a technician to support a vehicle systems program focused on documentation, testing, troubleshooting, and general system support. This role emphasizes electrical systems, wire harnesses, and system-level software rather than traditional mechanical repair. Candidates from automotive, aerospace, medical devices, robotics, or similar technical fields are encouraged to apply, and automotive experience is not required.

Scope:
• Perform hands-on inspection, testing, and troubleshooting of electrical and electromechanical systems.
• Read, interpret, and troubleshoot wire harnesses, wiring diagrams, schematics, and pinouts.
• Use OEM or system-level tools to read diagnostics, logs, and system status and support root cause analysis.
• Navigate documentation and database systems to locate procedures and record results.
• Support system validation activities and assist with issue resolution in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Required:
• Technician experience in automotive, aerospace, medical devices, robotics, or similar technical fields (automotive experience not required).
• Experience working in a lab or shop environment, including tool and inventory management.
• Comfortable working in a team environment; this is not a solo position.
• Proficiency with hand tools and electrical test equipment (multimeters, continuity testers, oscilloscopes, power supplies, etc.).
• Experience using diagnostic, logging, flashing, or network analysis tools to troubleshoot hardware and software systems.
• Ability to read and follow schematics, wiring diagrams, manuals, and technical procedures.
• Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.

Pluses:
• Experience troubleshooting vehicle or embedded system software.
• Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, or Ethernet.
• Experience with sensors, calibration, or system validation testing.

job.title: Commercial Operations Analyst
job.description:
Commercial Lending Operations Specialist

About the Opportunity:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Commercial Lending Operations Specialist to support a financial services organization’s loan operations team. This position is ideal for someone with an accounting, finance, legal, or lending-related background who enjoys working with documentation, data, and multiple stakeholders.
The ideal candidate is organized, highly accurate, comfortable working with loan-related documentation, and willing to take on hands-on administrative and data entry responsibilities. Candidates with commercial lending, construction lending, captive finance, or dealership finance exposure are especially encouraged to apply, although this experience is not required.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Support the preparation, review, and processing of commercial loan documentation.
  • Assist with loan boarding, system updates, and accurate data entry into lending platforms
  • Coordinate with borrowers, legal counsel, commercial loan officers, operations, and other internal teams to support loan closings and funding
  • Verify insurance requirements and ensure necessary documentation is received and maintained
  • Assist with updating loan risk ratings, system flags, and other required loan information
  • Support construction lending activities, including reviewing reports and documentation from third-party construction monitors, contractors, and title companies
  • Assist with the review and processing of construction loan draws, disbursements, and revolving credit activity
  • Help monitor service levels and follow up with internal and external parties to keep transactions moving
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation while ensuring work is completed in accordance with established procedures.
  • Take on additional operational and administrative responsibilities as business needs require.
What We're Looking For

Required:
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent college education
  • Background in Accounting, Finance, Legal, Lending, or a related field
  • Approximately 1–3+ years of relevant professional experience; more experienced candidates are also welcome
  • Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy and follow-through
  • Comfortable performing data entry and working with detailed documentation
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with different teams and stakeholders
  • Willingness to learn new systems, processes, and lending procedures
Nice to Have
  • Experience with commercial lending or commercial real estate lending
  • Exposure to construction loans or construction lending operations
  • Captive finance or dealership finance experience
  • Familiarity with loan servicing or loan origination systems
  • Experience working with legal, compliance, risk, treasury, or finance teams
Work Environment

This is a highly collaborative, onsite position requiring approximately 4 days in the office, with additional onsite time as business needs dictate. Candidates should be local and comfortable commuting to the office when required.
The ideal candidate is someone who takes pride in producing thorough, accurate, high-quality work and is comfortable balancing detailed administrative responsibilities with coordination across multiple teams.

job.title: Cyber Security Architect
job.description:
Cyber Security Architect
12 month contract
Fort Mill, SC (Hybrid 2-3 days a week)
 
Cyber Security Architect focused on API Security Reviews
 
Job Overview:
Our Information Security team is seeking an exceptional Security Architect to engage in API project efforts in Cloud, On-prem and Data security architectures. As the Security Architect at our firm, you will work side by side with our Development, Operations, Business units, and Enterprise Architecture teams to ensure our environment is secured and monitored. The right person for this role will have a broad technical cloud security background with a focus on security design, detection, prevention, and response to security threats.
 
Responsibilities:
  • Secure APIs by implementing robust access control mechanisms, OAuth, JWT, and configuring API gateway security to ensure authenticated and authorized access.
  • Develop reusable security design patterns addressing common cybersecurity challenges, ensuring consistency and best practices across diverse technology stacks and business domains.
  • Craft clear, actionable security standards and policies, aligning them with industry best practices and regulatory requirements while ensuring adaptability to emerging technologies.
  • Lead the design and innovation of security architectures, integrating advanced technologies to protect against evolving threats while enabling business agility and growth.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders to align security initiatives with business objectives, ensuring broad support and integration at all levels.
  • Expertise in cybersecurity frameworks, network security, cloud security, identity management, and encryption, with proficiency in implementing zero-trust architectures and secure DevOps practices across diverse IT environments.
  • Threat modeling, risk assessment, and vulnerability management, coupled with experience in SIEM implementation, log analysis, and incident response in complex enterprise settings.
  • Conduct thorough threat analysis using intelligence and analytics to identify and mitigate potential security risks proactively, reducing business impact.
  • Implement and oversee a risk management framework, balancing security investments with business needs to protect assets while supporting growth and innovation.
  • Securing machine learning models against adversarial attacks, ensuring data privacy in AI training sets, and implementing ethical AI principles in security applications.

job.title: Senior Manager, Solutions Sales – IT & Engineering
job.description:
Senior Manager, Solutions Sales – IT & Engineering

Location: Fully Remote; preference for candidates in or around Los Angeles, California
Department: Sales / Business Development
Job Type: Full-Time
Compensation: $120,000–$140,000 base salary; $300,000+ total target compensation

About the Opportunity
Yoh is seeking a Senior Manager, Solutions Sales to drive growth across our IT and Engineering consulting, professional services, project delivery, and workforce solutions portfolio.

This is a senior, consultative sales role focused on expanding relationships with existing clients, developing new business opportunities beyond traditional staff augmentation, and acquiring net-new clients nationally and globally. Los Angeles will be the primary market focus, but the role will not be limited to a defined geographic territory.

The successful candidate will serve as a strategic advisor to clients, helping them address complex technology, engineering, transformation, and workforce challenges through Yoh’s portfolio of solutions.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own and execute a strategic business development plan for Yoh’s IT and Engineering solutions portfolio.
  • Expand existing client relationships by introducing consulting, professional services, project delivery, managed solutions, and workforce solutions.
  • Develop and close net-new client relationships across Los Angeles, nationally, and globally.
  • Identify complex business challenges and translate them into customized, value-based solutions.

job.title: Electrical Design Engineer -LI-ion Battery Management
job.description:
Electrical Design Engineer - LI-ion Battery Management

Are you passionate about advancing battery technology and driving innovation in aerospace applications? Join our dynamic team as an Electrical Design Engineer specializing in Lithium-ion Battery Management Systems (BMS). In this critical role, you'll be at the forefront of designing cutting-edge digital control, analog, and mixed-signal solutions for aviation batteries, impacting the future of sustainable flight and aerospace safety.

Role Overview:
As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will develop and refine BMS hardware from concept through certification, working on everything from voltage sensing to cell balancing and system integration. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to bring complex hardware and embedded software solutions to life, ensuring performance, reliability, and compliance in a high-stakes environment. Your expertise will contribute directly to safer, more efficient aerospace energy storage solutions.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • Minimum of 5 years experience designing lithium-ion battery management systems (BMS)
  • Proven experience in analog and mixed-signal circuit design and PCB schematic creation
  • Strong knowledge of cell sensing, protection, isolation, and balancing circuits for lithium batteries
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and results-driven focus
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to troubleshoot and validate hardware prototypes effectively
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience designing to environmental and EMI standards such as RTCA DO-160, MIL-STD-810/461, or RTCA DO-311
  • Familiarity with LiFePO4 chemistry and battery safety standards
  • Knowledge of DFM & DFT principles
  • Experience supporting embedded microcontroller software and certification processes
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (Master's preferred)
  • 5+ years designing BMS for aviation or similar high-reliability industries
  • Demonstrated success in product lifecycle management, from initial design to field application
Other Requirements:

  • On-site work in Wichita, KS
  • Willingness to work in a collaborative environment involving hardware, software, and mechanical teams
  • Good communication skills essential for team coordination
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any necessary security or certification clearances
Take your career to the next level by innovating in the rapidly evolving field of aviation battery technology. Apply now to become a vital part of our pioneering team—your expertise will shape the future of electric flight!

job.title: Enterprise Marketing Specialist
job.description:
Enterprise Marketing Specialist
12 month contract
Fort Mill, SC (Hybrid)
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Support the planning, creation, and execution of demand generation campaigns across multiple marketing channels.
  • Develop and deploy email nurture campaigns that support lead generation and advisor engagement goals.
  • Coordinate campaign assets, timelines, approvals, and launch activities.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to support demand generation initiatives, pilot programs, and marketing campaigns.
  • Ensure campaigns are executed accurately and on schedule.
  • Assist with audience segmentation and campaign targeting efforts.
  • Monitor campaign execution to ensure consistency with brand standards and business objectives.
 
Content Development
  • Create and adapt marketing assets, including: Social media posts, Carousel posts, Infographics, Short-form videos and video reels, Checklists, Guides, E-books, Lead magnets, Landing page content, Email communication
  • Repurpose existing content into multiple formats to maximize reach and engagement
  • Support content customization and personalization initiatives for advisor audiences
  • Assist in maintaining content calendars and campaign schedules
  • Apply best practices for demand generation, lead capture, and audience engagement.
 
Compliance Review & Approval Management
  • Prepare and submit marketing materials for compliance review and approval.
  • Coordinate revisions resulting from compliance feedback.
  • Maintain records and documentation related to marketing approvals.
  • Ensure all materials adhere to brand standards, regulatory requirements, and compliance guidelines.
  • Manage timelines and communications throughout the review process to support timely campaign execution.
 
AI Content Enablement
  • Utilize AI tools to improve content development efficiency and campaign execution.
  • Develop, test, and refine prompts for content creation, personalization, and campaign support.
  • Build and maintain a centralized prompt library that can be leveraged across the marketing team.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows through AI-assisted processes.
  • Document repeatable AI-enabled workflows and best practices.
  • Serve as an advocate for responsible AI adoption and continuous improvement within the marketing team.
 
Campaign Measurement & Optimization
  • Tracking campaign performance and engagement metrics.
  • Monitoring lead generation results and conversion trends.
  • Supporting reporting on marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
  • Analyzing performance across email campaigns, lead magnets, content initiatives, and demand generation programs.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve campaign performance.
  • Providing recommendations based on data and campaign insights.
  • Supporting the development of reporting and dashboards for leadership.
 
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Digital Marketing, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting demand generation, content marketing, digital marketing, campaign management, or marketing operations.
  • Experience developing and executing email marketing campaigns, nurture programs, and lead generation initiatives.
  • Experience creating marketing content across multiple formats, including social media posts, infographics, guides, e-books, checklists, landing pages, and email campaigns.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written communication, copywriting, editing, and proofreading skills.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, WriterAI, or similar tools to support content creation, research, or workflow efficiency.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret marketing data and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners and stakeholders.
  • Experience building and optimizing email nurture programs and customer journeys.
  • Experience working with financial services marketing platforms such as AdvisorStream, FMG, Snappy Kraken or similar technologies.
  • Experience utilizing lead tracking processes.
  • Experience with reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Google Analytics, or Salesforce reporting.
  • Experience creating campaign performance reports and presenting insights to stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of lead generation, audience segmentation, campaign testing, and conversion optimization best practices.
  • Experience developing prompt libraries, AI workflows, or AI-assisted marketing processes.
  • Experience supporting marketing efforts within regulated industries that require formal approval and compliance review processes.
  • Experience leveraging campaign performance data to recommend business improvements.

job.title: Clinical Appeals Coordinators
job.description:
Remote-Clinical Appeals Coordinator (RN) needed for a contract  opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Philadelphia or surrounding PA area. (Candidates must reside in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, or Delaware)

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 7:30 AM-4:00 PM or 8:00 AM-4:30 PM, with occasional rotating Saturday and holiday coverage.

Position Summary
We are seeking experienced Registered Nurses to join our Clinical Appeals team. In this role, you will support the review and resolution of clinical appeals by applying clinical judgment, utilization management knowledge, benefit interpretation, and evidence-based review criteria. This position plays a key role in ensuring appeals are processed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with regulatory standards.

Top Skills Should You Possess:
  • RN
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Review and manage clinical appeals from intake through final resolution.
  • Evaluate medical records, benefit information, prior authorizations, denial rationale, and supporting clinical documentation.
  • Apply clinical nursing knowledge and utilization management principles to support appeal determinations.
  • Coordinate with Medical Directors, physician reviewers, and cross-functional teams on complex cases.
  • Prepare case summaries and ensure all appeal documentation is complete and audit-ready.
  • Support member and provider communications related to appeal outcomes.
  • Monitor appeal timelines to ensure compliance with state, federal, and accreditation requirements.
  • Identify trends, process improvements, and quality enhancement opportunities.
  • Participate in training, audits, calibration sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Active Registered Nurse (RN) license; Pennsylvania RN license (or compact license that includes PA eligibility) required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of clinical nursing experience.
  • Experience in one or more of the following:
    • Utilization Management
    • Prior Authorization
    • Concurrent or Retrospective Review
    • Case Management
    • Appeals and Grievances
    • Managed Care Operations
  • Strong knowledge of medical necessity review, benefit interpretation, and clinical documentation.
  • Ability to review medical records and apply evidence-based criteria.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong critical thinking, analytical, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and healthcare management systems.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN).
  • Health plan or managed care experience.
  • Experience with NCQA standards and accreditation requirements.
  • Familiarity with InterQual, MCG, CMS guidelines, and medical policy review.
  • Experience supporting Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial, or ACA appeals.
  • Audit, quality review, or regulatory compliance experience.
 
What’s In It for You?
  • Weekends and holidays off
  • Join Yoh’s extensive talent community that will provide you with access to Yoh’s vast network of opportunities.
  • Direct deposit & weekly epayroll

job.title: VP - Business Operations & Strategy
job.description:
VP - Business Operations & Strategy

Are you a visionary leader with a passion for transforming complex business operations and driving strategic growth? Join our client as the Vice President of Business Operations & Strategy and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our dynamic, rapidly scaling vacation rental platform. You will lead enterprise transformation initiatives, oversee high-impact M&A integrations, and deliver measurable results that fuel our mission to build the world’s best vacation rental company.

About the Role
As a key member of our executive team you will spearhead strategic initiatives across markets, brands, and functions. Your expertise will enable seamless integrations, operational improvements, and innovative solutions, all while collaborating with senior stakeholders to unlock value and accelerate growth. This is your chance to influence a company backed by seasoned investors and led by leaders with deep roots in hospitality, travel, and technology.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred
  • 5-8+ years in management consulting, strategy & transformation, or high-intensity business environments
  • Proven ability to structure complex problems, influence senior stakeholders, and lead initiatives end-to-end
  • Experience with M&A integration, multi-unit operations, or platform environments is advantageous
  • Exceptional analytical skills, with proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
  • Strong executive communication and storytelling capabilities
  • Comfortable operating autonomously in fast-paced, ambiguous settings
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools for strategic work is a plus
Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Prior exposure to hospitality, travel, or private equity sectors
  • Fluency in deploying innovative operating models and process improvements
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with disciplined execution
Preferred Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required; an MBA or similar qualification is highly preferred
  • Minimum of 5 years in strategy, management consulting, or operational leadership roles
  • Experience driving enterprise-wide transformation initiatives
Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to travel approximately 25-35% to support integration and strategic initiatives
  • Passion for building and scaling innovative platforms with high ownership and impact mindset
If you’re ready to lead transformative change at an exciting, fast-growing company and want to make a meaningful impact in the travel and hospitality industry, we invite you to apply now. Embark on a career journey that combines strategic vision with operational excellence—your next big opportunity awaits!

job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-term Compound Laboratory Lab Supervisor opportunity with a trusted, long-term client located in Cambridge, MA.
 
This position is part of a major pharmaceutical company, and requires a Bachelors of Science in chemistry, biology, or a related scientific field. Schedule is full-time M-F (7am-8am start time, 8 hour shift) and may require flexibility to work some evenings and overtime due to projects.
 
Key Responsibilities:
 
Operations Management and Team Leadership
  • Supervise and coordinate the daily operations of the compound library laboratory as described in the scope of work
  • Coordinate training for laboratory staff on SOPs, systems, and safety protocols
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance team culture
 
Compliance & Documentation
  • Implement, maintain, and update standard operating procedures (SOPs)
  • Ensure proper documentation and data integrity across all compound library activities

Stakeholder Engagement
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and research teams to understand and fulfill compound library needs
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for operational issues

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biology, or a related scientific field (Master's degree preferred)
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in laboratory operations or compound library
  • Minimum 2+ years of supervisory or leadership experience
  • Strong knowledge of sample management principles and best practices
  • Experience with laboratory information management systems (LIMS)
  • Experience with liquid handling equipment (Echo Acoustic Liquid Handler)
  • Proficiency in inventory management and tracking systems
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently and make sound operational decisions
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and laboratory software applications
  • Experience in a pharmaceutical or biotech research environment
  • Knowledge of drug discovery processes and compound library workflows
  • Experience with automated compound storage systems
  • Familiarity Cenevo MOSAIC software
  • DOT and IATA trained

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Quality Engineer for our client. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting product and manufacturing quality through inspection and testing strategies, defect analysis, statistical analysis, documentation control, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Quality Engineer will work closely with Development, Product, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to ensure products and processes meet company, customer, and industry quality standards. This position requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify quality issues, develop effective solutions, and drive improvements in a regulated environment.

Industry: Medical Device 
Location: Redondo Beach, CA
Compensation: $99k-104k/yr


Job Functions
  • Review and thoroughly understand product functional and design specifications.
  • Develop and implement methods and procedures for inspecting, testing, and evaluating the precision and accuracy of products and production equipment.
  • Design or specify inspection and testing mechanisms and equipment.
  • Conduct Quality Assurance testing to ensure products meet established requirements.
  • Perform statistical analysis to evaluate products or materials that do not meet required standards and specifications.
  • Conduct defect analysis utilizing statistical quality and process analytical methods.
  • Prepare and maintain Quality reports and support documentation control systems.
  • Review returned materials and verify customer complaints, developing action plans to address identified discrepancies.
  • Communicate with customers regarding Quality issues and resolutions as required.
  • Partner with operators and technicians to identify and resolve day-to-day Quality Assurance issues.
  • Prioritize and manage multiple projects while working within design specifications and budget requirements.
  • Maintain knowledge of evolving Quality Assurance codes, regulations, and industry standards.
  • Document test cases and interpret technical and business objectives.
  • Work closely with Development and Product teams to support Quality initiatives.
  • Identify software bugs and support appropriate testing and resolution activities.
  • Recommend changes and improvements to enhance overall product quality.
  • Ensure products comply with company and applicable industry Quality standards.
  • Develop and implement systems that promote conformity and accuracy throughout the production process.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions for identified Quality and product issues.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering required; Master's degree in Engineering preferred.
  • Professional certifications or 10+ years of equivalent work experience may be considered.
  • Previous experience working in a Quality Assurance environment required.
  • Knowledge of ISO 13485 and applicable EU standards.
  • MDR experience is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Quality Assurance and testing tools.
  • Knowledge of SQL and scripting.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify issues and develop effective solutions.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Physical Job Requirements
  • Full-time, onsite work environment.
  • Regular use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other standard office and technical equipment.
  • Ability to work within manufacturing, Quality, and product development environments as required.
  • Must be able to review detailed technical documentation, specifications, test results, and Quality records for extended periods.

job.title: Appeals Specialists-Hybrid
job.description:
Hybrid-Appeals Specialist needed for a contract  opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Philadelphia, PA.

Schedule: Tuesday-Wednesday-Thursday onsite 7:30 AM-4:00 PM or 8:00 AM-4:30 PM

Overview
We’re hiring multiple Appeals Specialists to independently investigate, document, and process member and provider appeals across assigned lines of business in accordance with applicable federal/state requirements, accreditation standards, and internal policies. This role is responsible for building complete, audit-ready case files, rendering administrative determinations within delegated authority, preparing compliant correspondence, and driving timely effectuations.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage assigned appeals from receipt through investigation, determination, notification, effectuation, and closure while meeting all turnaround times.
  • Validate appeal details (request, classification, authority, timeframe, eligibility/benefits, claim/authorization history, denial rationale, and documentation).
  • Research and reconcile discrepancies across denial letters, claims, authorizations, and case-system information; escalate misrouted/unclear cases.
  • Interpret applicable benefits and governing documentation (EOC/SPD/benefit booklets), claims/EOBs, policies, and regulatory guidance.
  • Build complete case files and write clear case notes, narratives, and decision rationales.
  • Prepare external review packages when required and track outcomes.
  • Draft and validate acknowledgment/RFI/dismissal/determination letters using approved templates and required language.
  • Initiate and monitor effectuations/claim adjustments; track and escalate delays.
  • Communicate with members, authorized representatives, providers, vendors, and internal partners by phone and in writing.
  • Manage daily inventory, prioritize expedited/aging cases, and meet quality/timeliness expectations.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, population health, or related field.
  • 3+ years of healthcare operations experience required.
  • Medicare experience
  • Utilization Management or Appeals/Grievances experience preferred.
  • Working knowledge of plan products, benefits, and claims procedures.
  • Strong research, documentation, and written communication skills.
  • Ability to handle complex issues and collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Must have your own laptop and monitor

job.title: Fiber Field Technician
job.description:
Fiber Field Technician

Join a dynamic team and play a vital role in the installation, maintenance, and monitoring of cutting-edge fiber optic networks in the IL Rockford, Dekalb, Rochelle, Peru and Lasalle areas. As a Fiber Field Technician, you will be the frontline hero ensuring seamless connectivity, supporting both wholesale and enterprise customers. This role offers competitive pay, shift premiums, on-call pay, company vehicle, and the opportunity to make a tangible impact in the telecommunications industry.

Required Skills:

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in a telecommunications environment or equivalent technical training
  • Expertise in DS3/DS1, SONET/DWDM installation and maintenance
  • Strong understanding of IP/MPLS fundamentals
  • Proficiency with test equipment such as OTDR, OSA, DS1/3, and Ethernet testing tools
  • Ability to analyze, monitor, and resolve network issues promptly
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record
  • Self-motivated with strong decision-making skills
  • Excellent PC skills and strong oral and written communication
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Cisco or Alcatel Lucent IP certifications
  • Experience with VOIP switching and maintenance
  • Fiber optics splicing and maintenance knowledge
  • SS7/STP support experience
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • College or technical degree in related field or equivalent experience
Other Requirements:

  • Willingness to work day, evening, night shifts, overtime, call-ins, weekends, and holidays as needed
  • Ability to work in demanding environments and multi-task effectively
Ready to be a key contributor in a fast-paced telecommunications setting? If you’re driven, skilled, and eager to advance your career, we want to hear from you—apply today and help us keep the world connected!


Preferred Locations:  Rockford, Dekalb, Rochelle, Dixon area

job.description:
Onsite Intermediate Financial Analyst needed for a 12-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Santa Clara, California.


Shifts Available: Mon-Fri Day shift


Pay Rate:$40-$45 per hour


The Big Picture – Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to quickly adapt to change

What You Will Be Doing:
  • Must have skills : FP&A, Budgeting and Forecast, Reporting, Experience with tools like Tableau, Anaplan, SAP, SAP BPC, Experience with building financial models in Excel.
  • This role will support financial and planning activities, including managing budget cycles, allocations analyses, spending analyses and systems inputs and aligning with Corporate Functions FP&A teams. 
  • The person coming into this role will collaborate across the Finance organization.
  • The ideal candidate needs to be comfortable with working both up and down the chain of command, using data to develop & create actionable & useful analytics, enhancing financial reporting capabilities, and completing deliverables related to regular business cycles.
  • Own various cost improvement performance tracks reporting
  • Drive financial modeling and analysis to support expense and capital management for GWI
  • Utilize AI and enterprise tools to develop and maintain a cost tracking framework that is transparent, auditable, and consistently applied across geographies and business segments.
  • Support the quarterly forecast and annual operating plan (AOP) processes by handling the process of getting forecasts loaded into forecasting systems of record.
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reporting packages for senior Finance and GWI leadership, including actuals vs. plan variance commentary.
  • Maintain and improve rolling forecast models that reflect both top-down guidance constraints and bottom-up operational inputs.
  • Lead the effort in streamlining management reporting and centralizing information and analytics
  • Exceptional ability to distill complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations

What You Need to Bring to the Table: 
 
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field with 2-5 years’ experience.
  • Strong understanding of forecasting, budgeting, financial planning, and variance analysis. 
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with financial modeling, large datasets and process automation.
  • Experience with financial systems and reporting tools such as Tableau, Anaplan, SAP, SAP BPC - Familiarity with AI-enabled finance tools and advanced analytics is an advantage
  • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and global environment

Bonus Points! Otherwise Known As Preferred Qualifications:
 
  • Education: Bachelor's Degree

job.title: Senior Solution Architect, Cloud, DevSecOps & Platform Engineering
job.description:
Solution Architect (AWS & Azure)
Direct Hire
Irving, TX (Hybrid)
 
Key Responsibilities
Architecture & Technical Strategy
  • Define and own the target-state architecture for cloud, infrastructure, and platform engineering environments across AWS and Azure.
  • Design scalable, resilient, and secure reference architectures for networking, storage, identity, and container/orchestration platforms.
  • Establish architecture standards, patterns, and guardrails for infrastructure-as-code, cloud landing zones, and platform services.
  • Evaluate emerging cloud, infrastructure, and platform technologies and provide recommendations to modernize the technology stack.
  • Lead architecture reviews and governance forums to ensure solutions align with enterprise standards and long-term strategy.
  • Architect and guide the evolution of CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices across the organization, leveraging tools such as Azure DevOps, Harness, and GitLab.
  • Define the architecture for embedding security into the software development lifecycle, including SAST, DAST, and vulnerability management tooling.
  • Partner with platform engineering teams to design self-service infrastructure, automation, and developer enablement capabilities.
  • Champion policy-as-code, secure configuration management, and compliance automation across cloud and platform environments.
  • Define architecture and standards for observability and monitoring using tools such as New Relic, Dynatrace, and Datadog.
  • Guide the design of monitoring, alerting, and incident response frameworks to improve reliability and reduce time to detect and resolve issues.
  • Champion site reliability engineering (SRE) principles, including SLIs/SLOs and proactive capacity and performance planning, across architecture decisions.
  • Build, lead, mentor, and develop a team of architects and engineers, fostering technical growth and career development.
  • Set team goals, manage performance, and create a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with infrastructure, security, application development, and business stakeholders to align architecture decisions with business priorities.
  • Communicate architecture strategy, trade-offs, and risk clearly to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Manage vendor relationships and evaluate third-party tools and platforms that support the architecture roadmap.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field required.
  • AWS and/or Azure architecture certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) strongly preferred.
  • Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, Security+) and/or Kubernetes certifications a plus.
  • 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure, or platform engineering, including 3+ years in a people leadership or management role.
  • Deep hands-on expertise designing and implementing solutions on AWS and Azure, including compute, networking, storage, and identity services.
  • Proven experience architecting DevSecOps pipelines using Azure DevOps, Harness, and/or GitLab, including embedded SAST and DAST security scanning.
  • Strong experience with observability platforms such as New Relic, Dynatrace, and/or Datadog.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation) and container/orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and managing technical teams, including hiring, performance management, and career development.
  • Proven track record influencing enterprise architecture decisions and driving alignment across cross-functional and executive stakeholders.  
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and people management skills.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Deep understanding of DevSecOps principles, secure SDLC, and cloud security best practices.
  • Ability to balance strategic architecture vision with hands-on technical depth.
  • Ability to influence and drive alignment across engineering, security, and business stakeholders.
  • Business acumen in technology transformation and cloud cost management

job.title: Specifications Engineer
job.description:
Spec Engineer Team: Product Engineering — SDLC 2.0 Agentic Development
Reports To: Director of Product and Platform Engineering
Position Summary The Spec Engineer owns the completeness, precision, and living accuracy of the specifications that drive autonomous, agent-executed builds. This role is the translation layer between business intent and machine-executable instruction: where traditional development tolerated ambiguity because a human developer would ask a clarifying question mid-build, agentic development requires that ambiguity be resolved before code generation begins. The Spec Engineer exists to close that gap.

Key Responsibilities
  • Interrogate ambiguity before it reaches implementation — actively surface unresolved questions (edge cases, behavioral choices, rate limits, failure modes) back to the business rather than allowing agents to silently assume an answer.
  • Write goal-oriented specifications: PRD-style statements of intent so agents optimize for the correct target, expanded with SRS-style precision so agents generate correct, testable code.
  • Maintain each spec as a version-controlled living artifact, updated continuously as decisions are made or discovered during the build — the spec is ground truth, never a stale point-in-time document.
  • Own the plan-review checkpoint: no code generation proceeds until a human has reviewed, edited, and approved the agent's plan file.
  • Curate the canonical standards library — the data-model standard, business-rules catalog, and coding standards — so that every spec references shared standards rather than re-describing them.
  • Partner with Architects and Platform Engineers during the plan-approval handoff to ensure the approved spec decomposes cleanly into an executable task graph.
  • Facilitate structured requirements sessions with business stakeholders, converting conversational intent into unambiguous, versioned specification language.
Required Qualifications
  • 3+ years in business analysis, systems analysis, or technical requirements engineering, ideally in an enterprise or regulated environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to write clear, structured technical documentation (PRD, SRS, or equivalent) and to distinguish intent-level requirements from implementation-level precision.
  • Working knowledge of data modeling and business-rule documentation conventions.
  • Comfort working in a version-controlled repository (GitHub or equivalent) and treating documentation as code.
  • Familiarity with Cloud platforms like AWS, and containerization models like Kubernetes
  • Strong stakeholder-facing communication skills — able to press executives and SMEs for decisions on edge cases without stalling delivery.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Prior exposure to spec-driven development workflows or tools (e.g., Claude Code, AWS Kiro, GitHub Spec-kit).
  • Familiarity with Python and Typescript
  • Background in software design or architecture sufficient to anticipate implementation ambiguity before it becomes a defect.
  • Familiarity with the property and casualty insurance terminology, e-commerce, and professional licensure and education (e.g., licensing/compliance data models, Oracle-backed transactional systems

job.description:
Test Technician

About the Role:

As a Manufacturing Test Technician, you’ll work directly on the ?ight hardware that goes to space, testing components, PCBA’s, subsystems, and fully integrated satellites. You will partner with technicians and engineers who care about quality, precision, and mission success. This role is well-suited for someone who is detail-oriented, methodical, and consistent in their approach to work, with a track record of reading and following instructions carefully, taking pride in clean and organized workmanship, and communicating early when more context or clari?cation is needed. You’ll work in a lab and cleanroom environment where production can move quickly, timelines constantly shift based on launch schedules and program priorities, and the quality you bring to each build directly supports Planet’s mission to deliver reliable data from space.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Support engineering in improving functional testing of sub-systems and components as well as system level testing

  • Troubleshoot test failures with test engineers
  • Own subassembly debug plan development
  • Develop and improve work instruction guides
  • Apply continuous improvement methodologies (Lean/Six Sigma)

What Makes You Stand Out:
  • Experience successfully managing complex, interdisciplinary manufacturing processes
  • Experience with testing complex vehicles in the aerospace or automotive industry
  • Ability to learn new engineering concepts quickly
  • Ability to implement continuous improvement processes
  • Experience with command-line interface on Linux desktop

job.title: Senior Identity Access Management Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: Senior IAM Engineer
Location: Holmdel, NJ- Hybrid( 3 days onsite)
Type: Full time 
Salary: $140000- $160000/yr 


The Senior IAM Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and handling identity and access management (IAM) solutions to ensure the security and efficiency of the organization's IT infrastructure. This role involves working closely with various groups to understand their IAM needs and providing expert guidance on standard methodologies and solutions.
 
You Will:

  • Design and implement IAM solutions, including identity governance, access management, and privileged access management.
  • Develop and maintain IAM policies, procedures, and standards to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
  • Collaborate with IT and security teams to integrate IAM solutions with existing systems and applications.
  • Conduct regular audits and assessments of IAM systems to identify and mitigate potential security risks.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for IAM-related issues.
  • Stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies in IAM and recommend improvements to existing systems and processes.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior IAM engineers and other team members.

You Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in IAM engineering or a related field.
  • Strong knowledge of IAM concepts, technologies, and standard processes.
  • Experience with IAM platforms, including Okta, PingFederate, SailPoint, CyberArk, and Microsoft Azure AD/Entra ID.
  • Experience with reverse proxy solutions, including Okta Access Gateway and Microsoft App Proxy.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or similar are a plus.
  • Passion for problem-solving and continuous curiosity to learn.
  • Understanding of security control concepts and their application in IAM.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.

You Are:
  • Experience with cloud-based IAM solutions and integrations.
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and standards related to IAM, such as GDPR, HIPAA, and SOX.
  • Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and AWS.
  • Experience with scripting and automation tools to streamline IAM processes.

job.title: Staff Engineer, Software - Autonomous Aircraft Integration
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, contract opportunity for a Staff Software Engineer – Autonomous Aircraft Integration to join our advanced autonomous technology client. This position is ideal for a senior engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of software, embedded hardware, and aircraft systems and is comfortable supporting both laboratory integration and live flight-test activities.

The engineer will play a key role in bringing autonomous capabilities from development into operational aircraft environments, including integrating software with onboard computing, sensors, avionics, and vehicle interfaces. This is a hands-on position that requires strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to support systems in fast-paced field and flight-test environments.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other technology opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Staff Software Engineer – Autonomous Aircraft Integration
Location: Washington, DC; Boston, MA; or San Diego, CA (Onsite)
Type: Contract
Compensation: $95.00–$135.00/hour, depending on experience
Clearance: Must be eligible to obtain a U.S. Government Secret security clearance. Clearance eligibility requirements may include U.S. citizenship.

Responsibilities
  • Lead integration and deployment of autonomous software capabilities onto unmanned aircraft and related flight platforms.
  • Integrate software with onboard computing, sensors, avionics, communications, and vehicle control interfaces.
  • Configure, build, and validate integrated systems in preparation for flight testing and operational demonstrations.
  • Provide hands-on technical support during flight-test events, including system startup, readiness verification, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
  • Diagnose complex hardware/software integration problems across embedded computing and autonomy environments.
  • Support collection, processing, and evaluation of flight-test data to identify system issues and opportunities for performance improvements.
  • Partner with software, autonomy, guidance/navigation/control, systems engineering, and test teams throughout integration and validation activities.
  • Develop scripts, utilities, and processes that improve system testing, deployment, diagnostics, logging, and integration efficiency.
  • Contribute to system verification, technical documentation, airworthiness, certification, and other applicable compliance activities.
  • Travel to company, customer, and flight-test locations as required to support integration and operational events.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.
  • Typically 7+ years of relevant professional experience with a bachelor's degree, 5+ years with a master's degree, or comparable advanced education and experience.
  • Strong programming experience with C++ and Python.
  • Hands-on experience developing, integrating, or troubleshooting embedded and real-time systems.
  • Strong working knowledge of Linux, including command-line tools, shell scripting, system configuration, and diagnostics.
  • Understanding of sensor integration, sensor fusion, and distributed or robotics middleware technologies such as ROS or DDS.
  • Experience supporting live system demonstrations, flight tests, field exercises, or other real-world integration events.
  • Familiarity with modeling and simulation environments used to test or validate complex aerospace or defense systems.
  • Strong systems-level troubleshooting skills across software and hardware interfaces.
  • Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate across multidisciplinary engineering and test organizations.
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 30–40%.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Previous experience integrating or testing unmanned aerial systems (UAS/UAVs) or other autonomous vehicles.
  • Experience with autonomy architectures, flight-control software, avionics, or guidance, navigation, and control (GNC) systems.
  • Hands-on knowledge of electronics, sensor interfaces, avionics integration, or aircraft system bring-up.
  • Experience building automation for testing, system health monitoring, data logging, or post-test analysis.
  • Previous experience supporting Department of Defense customers, demonstrations, or technical reviews.
  • Familiarity with UCI and OMS standards or similar defense system integration frameworks.
  • Experience with aerospace simulation and validation tools such as AFSIM, NGTS, or comparable platforms.

job.title: Senior Software Test and Automation Engineer
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, contract opportunity for a Senior Software Test & Automation Engineer to join our Autonomous Technology client. This opportunity is ideal for candidates within commutable distance of San Diego, CA or Dallas, TX who are comfortable working in an onsite environment.

This engineer will support the testing and validation of advanced autonomous systems by developing automated test frameworks, building validation tools, and executing system-level verification across simulated and hardware-based environments. The role will partner closely with software, systems, integration, and test teams to improve test coverage, identify system issues, and ensure software is ready for deployment.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Senior Software Test & Automation Engineer
Location: San Diego, CA or Dallas, TX (Onsite)
Compensation: $65.00–$85.00/hour depending on experience
Type: Contract
Eligibility: Must be authorized to work in the United States. Additional U.S. Person eligibility requirements may apply based on access to export-controlled technology.

Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated testing frameworks, validation tools, and supporting infrastructure for complex autonomous software systems.
  • Develop and execute verification strategies across simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), Vehicle-in-the-Loop (VIL), and other representative test environments.
  • Create automated regression, integration, functional, and performance testing to improve software reliability and release confidence.
  • Build Python-based automation, test harnesses, and data analysis tools to increase testing efficiency and repeatability.
  • Review test results, troubleshoot software and system integration issues, and participate in root-cause investigations.
  • Develop metrics, reporting tools, and dashboards that provide visibility into software quality, performance, and deployment readiness.
  • Incorporate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to provide continuous validation and timely feedback to engineering teams.
  • Partner with software, systems, integration, and test engineering teams to establish validation strategies, test requirements, and readiness criteria.
  • Continuously improve automation coverage, test infrastructure, and verification processes for advanced autonomous platforms.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 4+ years of experience in software testing, test automation, verification and validation, or related engineering work involving robotics, autonomous systems, aerospace, or similarly complex systems.
  • Strong Python programming skills with experience developing automation, testing, or data analysis solutions.
  • Hands-on experience creating automated test frameworks, test harnesses, or validation infrastructure.
  • Experience working within Linux-based development environments.
  • Experience testing software using simulation, SIL, HIL, VIL, or comparable hardware-integrated environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex software and system-level integration problems.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated or continuous testing practices.
  • Solid understanding of software verification, regression testing, integration testing, and quality methodologies.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in cross-functional engineering environments.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with autonomous vehicles, robotics, unmanned aircraft, or other safety-critical systems.
  • Familiarity with flight-control platforms such as ArduPilot or PX4.
  • Experience supporting fixed-wing or multirotor unmanned aerial systems.
  • Knowledge of flight controllers, radios, communications equipment, or related embedded hardware.
  • Previous experience within aerospace, defense, aviation, or autonomous technology environments.

This clinic offers occupational and preventative care only for employees onsite. You will typically be the only medical professional onsite. Primarily there for first-aid, basic walk-in care (minor acute care like colds, rashes, pink eye, etc.) and in case of an emergency.
--> Shifts needed so far, 7am to 3:30pm: Thursday November 5th and Friday November 6th with three shifts sometime prior to starting, for orientation/training.
 

Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in state of California 
  • Minimum (3) years' experience as a Registered Nurse
  • Preferred experience in: Occupational Health, Employee Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Primary Care, Family Medicine, School Nursing, or Corrections type setting
  • Recent clinical experience and strong first-aid skills

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Provide wellness materials/information

job.title: Senior Staff Engineer, Autonomy Behaviors
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Staff Engineer, Autonomy Behaviors to join our advanced technology client supporting the development and deployment of next-generation autonomous systems. This senior-level engineering role will focus on designing sophisticated autonomy capabilities for unmanned platforms operating in complex, real-world environments.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience in robotics, autonomous systems, motion planning, decision-making, and high-performance software development, with the ability to translate advanced algorithms into deployable capabilities. This is a highly technical, hands-on position that will work across software, simulation, hardware, and flight-test teams.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other engineering opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Senior Staff Engineer, Autonomy Behaviors
Location: Washington, D.C.; Boston, MA; San Diego, CA; or San Mateo, CA
Work Environment: Onsite
Type: Contract
Compensation: $120-170/hr DOE 
Clearance: Must be eligible to obtain a U.S. Government Secret security clearance

Responsibilities
  • Design and develop advanced autonomy algorithms that enable unmanned aircraft and other robotic platforms to execute complex missions with limited human intervention.
  • Build high-performance software supporting autonomous planning, decision-making, mission behaviors, and execution in dynamic operating environments.
  • Develop and validate behavior architectures supporting capabilities such as multi-agent coordination, reconnaissance, tactical decision-making, survivability, and mission execution.
  • Combine traditional autonomy and controls techniques with modern machine learning approaches to develop robust and adaptable autonomous behaviors.
  • Apply concepts including motion planning, optimization, aircraft dynamics, trajectory generation, information fusion, and decision-making to operational autonomy challenges.
  • Partner closely with perception, planning, simulation, systems, hardware, and flight-test engineering teams to integrate autonomy software onto real-world platforms.
  • Use simulation environments and mission-level testing to evaluate algorithms prior to deployment and identify opportunities for performance improvement.
  • Analyze system telemetry, mission logs, and test results to troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and improve autonomy performance.
  • Support integration activities, flight demonstrations, field testing, and other operational validation events.
  • Research and prototype emerging autonomy technologies while contributing technical direction to future capabilities and product roadmaps.
  • Adapt autonomy solutions to meet evolving program requirements, customer needs, and operational environments.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance across complex autonomy initiatives while promoting sound engineering practices and reusable technical approaches.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be considered.
  • Typically 10+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree, 9+ years with a Master's degree, or 7+ years with a PhD.
  • Advanced programming skills in C++ and Python.
  • Experience developing software for real-time or performance-sensitive systems, including familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS).
  • Significant hands-on experience with robotics or autonomous systems, particularly in areas such as motion planning, behavior modeling, autonomous decision-making, controls, or mission autonomy.
  • Strong experience developing algorithms for unmanned systems, with particular emphasis on aerial platforms.
  • Experience using modeling and simulation environments for autonomy development, testing, and validation; familiarity with tools such as AFSIM or NGTS is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of software integration concepts, interfaces, system architecture, and testing within complex multidisciplinary systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and optimize system-level performance.
  • Strong communication skills and experience collaborating across multidisciplinary engineering organizations.
  • Ability to travel approximately 10–15% for integration activities, customer engagements, testing, and demonstrations.
  • Must meet applicable U.S. Government requirements to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience incorporating machine learning or reinforcement learning into autonomous systems.
  • Background developing collaborative autonomy, swarm behaviors, multi-agent coordination, or distributed decision-making systems.
  • Experience developing tactical autonomy capabilities for U.S. Government or defense-related programs.
  • Exposure to autonomous behaviors spanning multiple operational domains, including air, ground, or maritime platforms.
  • Hands-on participation in flight testing, live demonstrations, field exercises, or operational system integration.
  • Familiarity with UCI and OMS standards.

job.title: Microsoft 365/Exchange Engineer
job.description:
Job Title:Microsoft 365/Exchange Engineer 
Location: Charlotte, NC
Type: Hybrid- 3 days onsite
Terms: Full Time


Position summary:
Our client is seeking a highly skilled and self-driven Microsoft 365 Communication Systems Engineer to join our Corporate Platform Engineering team. This role emphasizes Exchange administration (on-prem and cloud), Microsoft Teams management, and M365 governance, with strong knowledge of Purview retention policies and Defender for Cloud. The ideal candidate will be a well-rounded M365/Entra/Azure engineer who can troubleshoot complex issues, drive adoption of integrated SaaS solutions (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow in Teams), and maintain a secure, compliant environment.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
Exchange Administration
  • Manage and maintain Exchange Online and on-prem Exchange environments, including mail flow, hybrid configurations, and security hardening.
  • Implement and maintain Exchange Online Protection (EOP) and Microsoft Defender for Office 365 policies, including anti-spam, anti-phishing, Safe Links, and Safe Attachments.
  • Troubleshoot mail delivery, transport rules, and compliance issues.
  • Manage mail routing, transport rules, connectors, accepted domains, DKIM, DMARC, SPF, and hybrid mail flow configurations.
  • Administer shared mailboxes, resource mailboxes, distribution groups, Microsoft 365 Groups, and mail-enabled security groups.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting of mail flow, hybrid connectivity, directory synchronization, transport services, message trace analysis, and client connectivity issues.
 
Microsoft Teams Management
  • Configure and maintain Teams governance, policies, lifecycle management, external access, guest access, and collaboration settings.
  • Drive adoption of Teams integrations with SaaS platforms like Jira and ServiceNow.
  • Support Teams Phone, Auto Attendants, and Call Queues where applicable.
  • Support Teams Rooms and meeting experience enhancements.
 
Compliance & Security
  • Partner with Information Security teams to support Microsoft Purview retention, compliance, and information governance initiatives across Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint Online.
  • Provide technical guidance, troubleshooting, and platform expertise related to retention policies, compliance configurations, data lifecycle management, and Microsoft 365 workloads.
  • Participate in security reviews, audits, and remediation efforts supporting regulatory and
  • Job Title: M365 Engineer (Communications) Department: Operations & Technology Reports to: Director, Corporate Platform Engineering FLSA Status: Exempt Classification: Contract to hire
  • industry standards.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams on Microsoft 365 security initiatives, providing expertise on Exchange Online, Teams, Entra ID, and related collaboration technologies.
  • Assist with Entra ID administration as needed, including enterprise application integration, SaaS application authentication, Single Sign-On (SSO), and Conditional Access policy support.
 
Core Infrastructure Skill
  • Perform basic engineering tasks: Active Directory, Group Policy, schema updates, and certificate renewals.
  • Utilize monitoring tools for proactive issue detection and resolution.
  • Automate tasks using PowerShell for M365 and Azure environments.
 
Operational Requirements
  • Execute after-hours changes as needed under strict Change Management processes.
  • Document configurations, troubleshooting steps, and knowledge transfer materials.
  • Collaborate across teams to efficiently identify issues, resolve problems, and continuously improve platform stability and user experience.
 
Qualifications
  • Deep expertise in Exchange Online and on-prem Exchange administration.
  • Experience troubleshooting mail flow, hybrid Exchange environments, transport services, connectors, and message delivery issues.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Teams governance, lifecycle management, and SaaS integrations (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow).
  • Experience supporting and troubleshooting Microsoft Purview compliance, retention, and information governance solutions.
  • Familiarity with Exchange Online Protection (EOP), Microsoft Defender for Office 365, and email security best practices.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Single Sign-On (SSO), Conditional Access, and hybrid identity solutions including Microsoft Entra Connect.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation and troubleshooting.
  • Solid understanding of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, certificate management, and hybrid identity architectures.
  • Experience with network and server administration fundamentals.
  • Knowledge of general disaster recovery validation methods and willingness to assist in testing efforts.
  • Comfortable working within a strict, heavily vetted Change Management process.
  • Ability to support security, audit, and risk control requirements within a regulated environment, with familiarity in common industry security frameworks.
  • Strong documentation skills for platform configurations and user instructions.
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and ability to take ownership of tasks from start to finish.
  • Exceptional communication and problem-solving skills; able to clearly articulate initiatives and solutions.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • Self-driven, proactive, and capable of adapting quickly to changing business and technology requirements.

job.title: Lab Operations Associate, Sample Management - Onsite, Cambridge, MA
job.description:
Lab Operations Associate, Sample Management, Onsite, Cambridge, MA
  Overview We are seeking a Lab Operations Associate to support Sample Management activities involving the receipt, storage, tracking, inventory, and shipment of clinical and nonclinical samples.

This individual will work in a fast-paced laboratory environment and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure samples are accurately processed, documented, stored, and transferred within required timelines. The role includes maintaining sample inventory within a Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) and coordinating domestic and international shipments.

Key Responsibilities
  • Support end-to-end tracking and logistics for clinical and nonclinical samples.
  • Perform sample management and archive activities including labeling, receipt, transfer, tracking, inventory, storage, shipping, and disposal.
  • Process and maintain sample information within LIMS.
  • Reconcile samples and shipments, identify discrepancies, and coordinate resolution of inventory or documentation issues.
  • Investigate and correct sample or inventory discrepancies within LIMS.
  • Collaborate with laboratory and operations teams to ensure samples are available for transfer and analysis.
  • Maintain accurate inventory of clinical and nonclinical samples, test materials, and reference materials.
  • Maintain SOPs, working procedures, and forms related to sample receipt, storage, and disposition.
  • Maintain inventory of laboratory consumables used by the Sample Management team.
  • Coordinate domestic and international shipments to external research partners.
  • Prepare required shipping documentation, including customs information, tariff requests, and declared values.
  • Coordinate with shipping vendors to maintain required temperatures and ensure safe delivery.
  • Track and monitor shipments from sample collection through receipt.
  • Complete assignments accurately and within established timelines while maintaining detailed documentation.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline required.
  • 3–5 years of relevant industry experience.
  • 3+ years of laboratory experience preferred.
  • Experience with LIMS applications and/or implementation preferred.
  • Experience with sample management, laboratory inventory, sample logistics, or similar laboratory operations strongly preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, team-based environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Word; Smartsheet experience helpful.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal procedures accurately.
  • Ability to lift approximately 50 lbs. and remain on your feet for extended periods.

job.title: Quality Inspector
job.description:
Quality Inspector 

Planet is seeking a disciplined Contract Quality Inspector to support our satellite manufacturing programs. This role is focused on the tactical execution of inspections across all stages of production, ensuring that every component and subassembly meets our rigorous aerospace standards. This is a high-volume, execution-oriented position for a technician who excels at identifying mechanical and electrical anomalies in a fast-paced environment. 

Impact You’ll Own 

  • Production Inspection: Perform detailed physical inspections of incoming parts and in-process subassemblies to ensure 100% compliance with drawings and specifications. This includes inspecting a wide variety of hardware, from batches of 100+ cable assemblies to complex solar panels and sensors. 

  • Mechanical and Electrical Verification: Utilize precision measurement tools (calipers, micrometers, drop gauges) to verify mechanical tolerances and perform visual inspections of electrical assemblies for solder and cabling defects. You will be responsible for ensuring threads are correct and fitment is exact for all metal parts and housings. 

  • Microscopic Inspection: Conduct high-detail inspections of PCBAs under a microscope to identify solder defects, component misalignment, or contamination. This requires a high level of focus and attention to detail. 

  • Non-Conformance Reporting: Meticulously record and report all quality anomalies using in-house software and Jira. You will be responsible for identifying non-conforming material and ensuring it is correctly tagged and moved to the MRB (Material Review Board) area. 

  • Laboratory Standards: Maintain an organized, ESD-safe, and FOD-free inspection area, adhering strictly to cleanroom protocols. 

  • Adaptability: Maintain extreme attention to detail while shifting between different types of hardware daily based on production priorities. 

What You Bring 

  • 5+ Years of Quality Inspection Experience: Proven background in a high-precision manufacturing environment, such as Aerospace, Medical Devices, or Defense. 

  • Technical Interpretation: Proficiency in reading and interpreting complex mechanical drawings, GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing), and electrical schematics. 

  • Precision Measurement Mastery: Expert-level experience with manual and digital measurement tools to verify sub-millimeter tolerances and thread specifications. 

  • Microscope Proficiency: Significant experience performing prolonged, detailed inspections under a microscope for fine-pitch electronics and delicate assemblies. 

  • Build-Cycle Familiarity: Experience working within a production line where your role is to inspect and move hardware forward efficiently. 

  • Software Proficiency: Comfort using Google Sheets, Jira, and proprietary tracking software to log high volumes of inspection data daily. 

  • Attention to Detail: An uncompromising eye for detail and the ability to communicate technical issues clearly and concisely to engineering teams. 

What Makes You Stand Out (Nice to have) 

  • IPC-A-610 or J-STD-001 Certification: Specific experience inspecting high-reliability solder joints and electronic assemblies. 

  • Experience with AS9100 or ISO 9001: Familiarity with the documentation rigor required for aerospace-grade quality management systems. 

  • Material Review Board (MRB) Experience: Practical experience with the physical and digital handling of non-conforming materials. 

  • Collaborative Mindset: The ability to act as a firm but professional gatekeeper of quality while maintaining strong working relationships with the assembly teams.
