job.title: Director, Workplace Technology Operations
job.description:
Director, Workplace Technology Operations - W2 only
This position is a permanent direct hire role with management responsibilities
Requirement for 3 days weekly onsite
Salary range $135-155K plus 20% bonus plus benefits + Management perks 

OVERVIEW Director, Workplace Technology Operations
Work Arrangement: Hybrid, 3 days onsite
Compensation: $148,000 to $158,000 base plus 20% bonus
Key Requirement: Must have experience managing a third-party MSP, ideally within a large enterprise environment.

POSITION SUMMARY
Lead enterprise workplace technology and End User Services delivered through an external MSP. This role oversees service desk, endpoint management, desktop engineering, collaboration tools, field support, employee onboarding and offboarding, and workplace technology modernization.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Own the workplace technology strategy, roadmap, service portfolio, and modernization priorities.

job.title: Paid Media Operations Specialist- Music Industry-OnSite
job.description:
Yoh has an immediate, 9 month contract opportunity, as an Paid Media Operations Specialist within the Entertainment and Music industry to join our client, Onsite, at their office in New York, New York
  • $30/hr. max hourly rate
  • Support paid media campaign operations by managing financial reconciliations, campaign readiness, data quality, and cross-functional coordination across Marketing, Media, and Finance teams.
  • 40 hours, Mon-Friday, Day time hours. Ability to work OT as necessary.
** To be considered, your current city and state must be clearly listed on your resume. Applications with incomplete location information may not be considered **

***Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship. Due to the client-site nature of this role, we are unable to support OPT or STEM OPT employment, including completion of Form I-983***

What You Will Be Doing
  • Working closely with Paid Media Strategists, Media Buyers, Finance/Accounting, and other cross-functional teams, this role will support campaign readiness, financial reconciliation, workflow management, and day-to-day paid media operations..
  • Support Paid Media financial operations, including monthly reconciliation, campaign spend validation, billing documentation, customer and vendor setup, discrepancy resolution, and coordination with Finance and Accounting.
  • Support Media Buyers with campaign readiness tasks, including audience creation, pixel validation, creative organization, tracking verification, and platform access.
  • Perform internal campaign reviews across baseline campaigns to ensure campaigns are set up accurately and required information is in place.
  • Review incoming Premium campaign requests for completeness and operational readiness ahead of daily team planning.
  • Validate campaign metadata, release information, payment methods, and required documentation, including Marketing Fund notes and Customer IDs.
  • Identify missing assets, links, approvals, or campaign information and coordinate with Marketing teams and other stakeholders to resolve gaps ahead of campaign planning and launch.
  • Maintain Airtable workflow accuracy by updating request statuses, validating records, monitoring operational exceptions, and ensuring campaigns progress through the workflow correctly.
  • Coordinate operational requests across Paid Media, Marketing, Finance/Accounting, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Help document and standardize operational processes, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce manual work.
  • Other duties as capacity allows
Who You Are
  • HS Diploma or GED required, college degree strongly preferred
  • 2+ years of experience in ad operations, paid media, marketing operations, finance/billing operations, or a similar operational role, ideally within digital advertising, media, or marketing.
  • Working knowledge of digital advertising platforms such as Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Google Ads, with an understanding of campaign setup, audiences, creative requirements, tracking, and basic campaign metrics. Hands-on campaign buying experience is a plus, but not required.
  • Experience supporting financial processes such as monthly reconciliation, spend validation, billing/accounting workflows, and budget tracking, with the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Experience managing workflows and data across tools such as Airtable, Excel/Google Sheets, CRM, or database platforms, with strong attention to data and process accuracy.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to identify missing information, assets, approvals, or operational exceptions and proactively coordinate solutions across teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workflows and deadlines while working effectively with Media, Marketing, Finance/Accounting, and other cross-functional partners in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Vehicle Competence Engineer
job.description:
Vehicle Competence Engineer Development Vehicles / Platform Bring-Up / Electrical Diagnostics Overview Seeking a hands-on Electrical Engineer to support platform bring-up and troubleshooting of prototype and development vehicles. The primary focus is electrical measurement, vehicle hardware diagnostics, and resolving issues involving wiring, ECUs, sensors, power distribution, and communication networks.

This is primarily an electrical troubleshooting role rather than a software development position. The ideal candidate has strong fundamentals in electrical engineering and measurement equipment, enjoys hands-on vehicle work, and is interested in expanding into software and automation over time.

Key Responsibilities
  • Support development vehicle and platform bring-up by diagnosing electrical, hardware, and communication issues.
  • Troubleshoot wiring harnesses, connectors, grounds, power distribution, ECUs, sensors, open/short circuits, voltage drops, intermittent faults, and abnormal current draw.
  • Perform hands-on measurements using oscilloscopes, multimeters, current probes/clamps, breakout boxes, and related electrical test equipment.
  • Read wiring diagrams, schematics, connector pinouts, and network topologies to isolate failures and determine root cause.
  • Diagnose CAN, LIN, FlexRay, and Automotive Ethernet issues using Vector CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape, or comparable automotive diagnostic tools.
  • Document findings, support repair verification, and collaborate with hardware, software, prototype, and vehicle engineering teams to resolve development issues.
Required Qualifications
  • Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering, or similar technical background.
  • 3+ years of hands-on automotive electrical, prototype vehicle, platform bring-up, validation, or diagnostic experience.
  • Strong experience with oscilloscopes, multimeters, current measurement, electrical troubleshooting, and laboratory/vehicle measurement equipment.
  • Experience diagnosing wiring harnesses, connectors, power/ground, ECUs, sensors, and vehicle electrical systems.
  • Understanding of CAN and Automotive Ethernet and familiarity with vehicle communication/diagnostic tools.
  • Strong troubleshooting mentality with the ability to independently investigate and isolate complex electrical problems.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with prototype or development vehicle bring-up, ADAS, autonomous vehicles, or automotive validation.
  • Familiarity with radar, LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, data loggers, 12V/48V systems, ECU flashing, or vehicle commissioning.
  • Interest in developing additional skills in Python, scripting, software diagnostics, and test automation.

job.title: Head of AI Platform Engineering - Execution Plane
job.description:
Head of AI Platform Engineering 


Job Details: 
Location: New York, NY (Hybrid/Onsite)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Compensation: $180-$240k base plus bonus 

We are seeking a highly experienced Head of AI Platform Engineering to lead the design, development, and operation of our AI execution platform. This leader will own the execution plane that powers enterprise AI and agentic AI workloads, including model gateways, agent runtimes, orchestration frameworks, tool invocation services, MCP servers, retrieval pipelines, and production AI operations.

This role combines deep technical leadership with people management and platform strategy. You will lead engineering teams responsible for building secure, scalable, and resilient AI infrastructure that enables enterprise-wide adoption of AI capabilities.

What You'll Do
  • Lead and develop engineering teams responsible for AI execution and runtime platforms.
  • Define and execute the roadmap for AI execution services including model gateways, agent runtimes, orchestration frameworks, tool gateways, and inference services.
  • Build scalable, reliable, and observable runtime systems that support production AI workloads.
  • Partner with architecture, security, data engineering, application development, and platform teams to establish reusable AI platform capabilities.
  • Drive engineering excellence through architecture reviews, testing practices, CI/CD automation, incident management, operational readiness, and service reliability objectives.
  • Ensure execution platforms meet enterprise security, governance, compliance, and audit requirements.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities for automation, AI adoption, and operational efficiency across the organization.
  • Establish best practices for deployment, monitoring, resiliency, and performance optimization of AI services.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven experience leading software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, and developing senior technical talent.
  • Strong hands-on experience designing and operating large-scale distributed systems and cloud-native platforms.
  • Experience leading teams responsible for AI/ML platforms, inference services, orchestration layers, runtime environments, or production AI operations.
  • Deep understanding of modern platform architecture, APIs, data access patterns, and enterprise integration strategies.
  • Experience building highly available and low-latency services with strong observability, resiliency, and operational controls.
  • Strong knowledge of CI/CD practices, infrastructure automation, testing frameworks, and production support models.
  • Understanding of enterprise security principles including identity management, auditability, secrets management, least-privilege access, and environment isolation.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence technical and business stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with agentic AI systems, LLM platforms, model gateways, agent runtimes, and orchestration frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services including Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EKS, DynamoDB, S3, IAM, and CloudWatch.
  • Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, embeddings, enterprise search, and knowledge management architectures.

job.title: Scientist III - Analytical Development
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Scientist III, Analytics – Product Development for our pharmaceutical client in Corona, CA. In this role, you will provide advanced analytical, quality, and laboratory support for pharmaceutical R&D programs focused on the development and approval of generic drug products for U.S. and international markets. The Scientist III will independently perform analytical testing, method development and validation, laboratory investigations, technical documentation, and regulatory support while collaborating with internal Product Development teams, CROs, and CMOs. The ideal candidate will bring extensive pharmaceutical R&D experience, strong analytical chemistry expertise, and a thorough understanding of FDA, ICH, cGMP, and cGLP requirements.

Industry: Pharmaceutical / Product Development
Location: Corona, CA
Compensation: 80k + ; based upon experience
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Independently perform analytical testing with limited or no supervision and communicate results to management within established timelines.
  • Perform testing of raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, and stability samples using compendial and non-compendial methods.
  • Perform analytical method development, evaluation, validation, and verification utilizing HPLC, GC, and other laboratory techniques.
  • Conduct analytical testing using wet chemistry, spectrometry, chromatography, physical testing, and other applicable techniques.
  • Operate analytical instrumentation including HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, balances, and other laboratory equipment.
  • Accurately document all laboratory testing in accordance with Good Documentation Practices, company policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Write, review, and execute analytical study plans, protocols, and reports.
  • Develop and review method development, method validation, and technology transfer protocols and reports.
  • Author technical documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies, guidance documents, validation protocols, and method transfer documentation.
  • Review laboratory notebooks, instrument logbooks, calculations, and data entries for accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
  • Conduct thorough laboratory investigations of Out-of-Specification (OOS), Out-of-Trend (OOT), and other aberrant analytical results.
  • Determine root causes of laboratory investigations, develop and implement appropriate Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs), and prepare investigation reports.
  • Review Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) documentation and related analytical documents for regulatory submissions.
  • Perform gap assessments of CMC and analytical documentation and provide recommended courses of action to management.
  • Support cGMP, cGLP, and safety audits conducted by FDA, OSHA, client companies, and other regulatory organizations.
  • Maintain familiarity and compliance with applicable FDA, ICH, and other regulatory guidelines and requirements.
  • Perform preventive maintenance, calibration, and qualification of laboratory equipment and analytical instruments.
  • Maintain laboratory Quality Systems related to samples, standards, reagents, equipment qualification, preventive maintenance, periodic calibration, stability chambers, and controlled-environment storage cabinets.
  • Collaborate with internal Product Development teams, CROs, and CMOs to establish timelines, understand analytical work requests, identify and resolve issues, and communicate results.
  • Support study design and ensure analytical development and technology transfer activities are completed in accordance with regulatory requirements and established timelines.
  • Provide effective and timely analytical support for R&D activities associated with the development and approval of generic drug products for U.S. and international markets.
  • Prepare sample and standard reconciliation reports and other analytical reports as required.
  • Support QC data management activities, including data review and control charting.
  • Utilize Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and related applications for data analysis, technical documentation, and communication.
  • Maintain strict adherence to laboratory compliance and safety programs.
  • Maintain a clean and safe laboratory environment, including proper cleaning and storage of laboratory equipment and glassware.
  • Perform additional laboratory activities and responsibilities as assigned by management.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biological Sciences, or a related scientific discipline required.
  • Minimum of five (5) to ten (10) years of relevant Pharmaceutical R&D experience with demonstrated accomplishments.
  • Strong expertise in analytical chemistry principles, methodologies, and laboratory techniques.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, wet chemistry, spectrometry, chromatography, and related analytical instrumentation.
  • Demonstrated experience with analytical method development, evaluation, validation, verification, and technology transfer.
  • Strong knowledge of laboratory Quality Systems, safety requirements, and laboratory support processes.
  • Thorough familiarity with FDA and ICH guidelines and other applicable pharmaceutical regulatory requirements.
  • Knowledge of cGMP and cGLP requirements within a pharmaceutical R&D environment.
  • Experience conducting and documenting OOS, OOT, and aberrant result investigations, including root cause analysis and CAPA.
  • Experience reviewing CMC and analytical documentation supporting regulatory submissions.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently write SOPs, policies, guidance documents, analytical study plans, protocols, and technical reports.
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical terminology, laboratory operations, and regulatory expectations.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external partners, including CROs and CMOs.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and complete assignments with limited supervision.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and similar applications.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical information systems, computers, office equipment, and related administrative procedures.
Physical Job Requirements
  • Pharmaceutical R&D laboratory and office environment.
  • Regularly required to perform hands-on analytical laboratory testing and operate analytical instrumentation and equipment.
  • Regular handling of laboratory samples, standards, reagents, chemicals, and glassware in accordance with established safety procedures.
  • Regular use of computers and related systems for data analysis, technical documentation, and communication.
  • Must be able to maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory workspace while adhering to laboratory safety and compliance requirements.
#IND-SPG

job.description:
Staff Program Manager contract role opportunity!
Within gaming industry!

Location: San Diego, CA OR San Mateo, CA - Hybrid schedule 
Duration: 6 month contract 
Pay Rate: $65-74/hr on W2 

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. NO C2C!!!

About the Opportunity:
We are seeking an experienced Staff Program Manager to join our Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) team. In this highly visible role, you will drive portfolio planning, operational execution, and cross-functional coordination across a complex organization. You will partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Finance, PMO, and executive stakeholders to ensure portfolio initiatives are planned, executed, and tracked effectively.

This position is ideal for a senior program management professional who thrives in fast-paced environments, excels at managing multiple priorities, and can independently drive cross-functional programs from planning through execution.
What You'll Do Portfolio Planning & Execution
  • Lead the execution and coordination of portfolio planning activities, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Finance, Program Management, and other stakeholders to support planning and delivery timelines.
  • Maintain integrated project plans, schedules, trackers, action logs, and planning documentation.
  • Monitor progress against key milestones and proactively identify risks, gaps, dependencies, and issues requiring escalation.
  • Coordinate the collection and validation of resource, budget, dependency, and program planning inputs.
  • Support leadership and portfolio review sessions by preparing materials, coordinating stakeholder feedback, tracking decisions, and ensuring follow-up actions are completed.
Portfolio Operations
  • Execute Strategic Portfolio Management processes and operating rhythms, including portfolio reviews, quarterly planning activities, governance meetings, and status reporting.
  • Communicate portfolio health, milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and action items to key stakeholders.
  • Maintain visibility into critical portfolio information and ensure plans, decisions, timelines, and reporting artifacts remain accurate and up to date.
  • Identify cross-program dependencies and facilitate alignment across teams to ensure successful delivery.
  • Support governance processes by managing required inputs, documentation, decision tracking, and action follow-through.
Program Management
  • Coordinate complex initiatives across multiple teams, creating clear workstreams, objectives, owners, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Facilitate planning sessions, working meetings, and portfolio reviews while capturing actions, decisions, and next steps.
  • Drive assigned projects and deliverables independently, leveraging strong judgment and problem-solving skills to navigate challenges.
  • Identify, assess, track, and escalate risks that could impact portfolio objectives.
  • Partner closely with Portfolio Operations leadership to execute strategic priorities and adapt quickly to changing business needs.
Required Qualifications
  • 10+ years of experience in Program Management, Portfolio Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
  • Proven success leading complex cross-functional programs and portfolio initiatives in large, matrixed organizations.
  • Advanced expertise in:
    • Portfolio planning and execution
    • Integrated program planning
    • Schedule and milestone management
    • Dependency management
    • Risk management
    • Stakeholder communication and coordination
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple high-priority initiatives with minimal oversight.
  • Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, Finance, PMO, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong experience supporting executive leadership reviews and coordinating deliverables for strategic decision-making.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, collaboration, and relationship-building abilities.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working within Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) organizations.
  • Experience supporting large-scale product, technology, or enterprise portfolios.
  • Familiarity with portfolio governance frameworks, quarterly planning processes, and executive reporting.
Why Join Us? You'll have the opportunity to influence portfolio strategy and execution across a broad range of initiatives while partnering with senior leaders and cross-functional teams. This role offers high visibility, meaningful impact, and the opportunity to help shape how strategic work is planned and delivered across the organization.

Apply today to be part of a collaborative team driving strategic initiatives and portfolio excellence.

job.title: AI Solutioning Consultant – Microsoft Copilot Studio - Boston or Philly
job.description:
AI Solutioning Consultant – Microsoft Copilot Studio Location: Boston, MA or Philadelphia, PA
Schedule: Hybrid — 3 days onsite per week
Conversion: Potential conversion opportunity
Work Authorization: U.S. Citizens or Green Card holders only - unable to sponsor now or in the future for this role
Interview Process: Two interviews; in-person interview possible

Position Overview Our client is seeking a hands-on AI Solutioning Consultant to join its AI Enablement team. This individual will design, build, test, and refine AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and the Microsoft Power Platform.

The consultant will work directly with business stakeholders to understand their needs, translate them into practical AI solutions, and support adoption within established governance and security standards.

This is a hands-on solution-building and consulting role. Project or program management experience is not required.

Responsibilities
  • Design, configure, and test AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio.
  • Build topics, prompts, actions, connectors, and workflows.
  • Use Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint, Teams, and other Microsoft tools.
  • Gather requirements and assess the feasibility of Copilot-based solutions.
  • Apply prompt engineering, prompt testing, grounding, and retrieval-augmented generation techniques.
  • Connect agents to approved enterprise data sources and knowledge repositories.
  • Troubleshoot and refine agents based on testing and stakeholder feedback.
  • Create documentation, reusable templates, and development standards.
  • Guide business users and citizen developers in building agents within approved guardrails.
  • Partner with platform, security, risk, compliance, and governance teams.
  • Help define success criteria and evaluate the effectiveness of delivered solutions.
Required Qualifications
  • Five or more years of experience in technical consulting, solutions engineering, business analysis, low-code development, automation, or a related field.
  • At least five years working with generative AI, machine learning, AI automation, or related technologies.
  • Hands-on experience building agents, bots, workflows, or automations in Microsoft Copilot Studio or Power Virtual Agents.
  • Experience with Microsoft Power Automate and working knowledge of Dataverse.
  • Knowledge of prompt engineering, prompt testing, grounding, RAG, and enterprise data sources.
  • Strong requirements-gathering and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Microsoft associate-level certification in a relevant field, with a verifiable credential ID.
  • U.S. Citizenship or Green Card status.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in financial services, asset management, banking, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience integrating Copilot Studio with Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Microsoft 365, Graph connectors, or enterprise systems.
  • Experience supporting citizen developers or business users.
  • Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI, data protection, and security practices.
  • Experience with GitHub Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, Claude, or similar enterprise AI tools.
Success in This Role The successful candidate will be able to take a business idea, determine whether Copilot Studio is an appropriate solution, build and thoroughly test a working agent, and guide it toward production use within established security and governance requirements.

job.description:
Senior Analyst – Asset Management
6+ month contract
Plano, TX (ONSITE) 
  • Must have bachelor’s in accounting and experience with SAP ERP.
  • 3+ years of experience with fixed asset accounting/lease accounting and 3-10 years of overall experience.
  • Must have Process improvement experience.
  • CPA and public accounting experience is a must have.
  • This role is currently an individual contributor position rather than a managerial or leadership role.

Requirements:
  • Support the organization's fixed asset accounting processes and procedures.
  • Maintain and update the fixed asset register.
  • Support various quarterly/annual asset confirmation activities.
  • Record and monitor asset acquisitions, transfers, and disposals.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant financial regulations and accounting standards.
  • Perform regular asset valuations and depreciation calculations.
  • Review and analyze fixed asset-related financial statements and reports.
  • Prepare and present detailed fixed asset reports for management and stakeholders.
  • Support budgeting and forecasting activities related to fixed assets.
  • Collaborate with departments to plan and budget for capital expenditures.
  • Coordinate with IT and administrative staff to ensure proper tagging and tracking of fixed assets.
  • Handle internal and external audit requests pertaining to fixed assets.
  • Investigate and resolve any discrepancies or issues related to fixed asset management.
  • Develop and implement process improvements for fixed asset management systems.
  • Ensure timely and accurate recording of asset acquisition, capitalization, and depreciation.
  • Administer and manage lease accounting and leased asset records.
  • Maintain documentation and records related to fixed asset management policies and procedures.
 
Qualifications/(Must Haves):
  • BS/BA in accounting, with 3-10 years of work experience in accounting.
  • Must have CPA and Public accounting experience.
  • Experience with SAP ERP system experience.
  • 3+ years of experience with fixed assets and/or lease accounting.
  • Strong Analytical skills with attention to detail and completeness.
  • Motivated and dependable self-started.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Solid time management skills, ability to handle multiple projects, meet deadlines, and function. independently in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Production & Assembly Technician
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Production & Assembly Technician in Austin, TX. The Production & Assembly Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and ensuring the quality of NIR analyzer control panels, flow cells, fiber optic cables, and associated products in accordance with established production procedures and customer specifications. This role involves performing electrical and optical testing, troubleshooting components, maintaining production equipment, and documenting quality control results. The candidate will have a minimum four years’ experience assembly and testing of electrical/mechanical/fluid transport systems

Title: Production & Assembly Technician
Location: Austin, TX
Shift: M-F 8-5pm(varies)

The Production and Assembly Technician will have direct responsibility for the following:
  • Follow production procedures, and assemble NIR analyzer control panels, flow cells and associated products to JP3 specifications and/or specific customer requirements
  • Run JP3 quality test on fiber optic cables and approve for shipping
  • Perform quality assurance testing to verify performance of components, parts and assembled units
  • Build and maintain production equipment/tools
  • Perform electrical acceptance and optical testing of final assemblies
  • Create, maintain and archive all QC documentation required for production
  • Ensure that all JP3 safety guidelines are always followed and maintain a clean and orderly environment
  • Must be able to use a multimeter and be comfortable working with 120VAC.
Candidate Requirements
  • Associates Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Technology, or equivalent experience
  • Minimum four years’ experience assembly and testing of electrical/mechanical/fluid transport systems
  • Attention to detail, with statistical and analytical thinking
  • Ability to read and understand electrical schematics
  • Effective written and oral communication skills
  • Working knowledge of MS Office applications, engineering software and database systems
  • Common-sense understanding to carry out written, oral, or diagrammed instructions
  • Comfortable with a fast-paced, results-driven, high-tech environment within a relaxed atmosphere.

job.title: Medical Assistant / Phlebotomist - Employee Health
job.description:
Medical Assistant/Phlebotomist needed for a temporary full-time contract opportunity at Yoh’s well-known non-profit client located in Duarte, CA.

This position is part of the Employee Health Department where they perform new hire screenings for employees of the medical center. You will be drawing titers for 8-16 new hires per day. During downtime, will support the front office. Must have MA Cert AND CPT or at minimum, CPT.
--> Shifts are Monday-Friday 8:30am - 5:00pm. Job is anticipating to run through at least November 1, 2026 with likely extension.
 

Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Medical Assistant Certificate/Diploma
  • Certified Phlebotomy Technician (CPT)
  • At least one year of medical front office experience as well as blood draw experience
  • EMR (Epic) experience
  • Positive attitude, excellent customer service skills, and must be a team player
  • Looking for a responsible, friendly, and helpful employee

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Mainly administrative support but will be filling in as the Phlebotomist whenever they need
  • Blood draws for approx. 8-16 new hires per day
  • Greet patients and check them in/out
  • Answer phones and schedule appointments when reception team is out
  • Maintain employee health records: setting up medical charts, pulling results, and entering them into chart
  • Prep charts for scanning and pull files
  • Enter labs into EMR (Epic)
  • Additional administrative responsibilities as-needed

What You Need to Bring to the Table:

  • Strong phlebotomy skills
  • Organizational skills and good at multi-tasking
  • Active CPR/BLS
  • (2) Step TB test or QuantiFERON Gold test
  • Immunization/titer records for MMR (Measles, Mumps, Rubella), Varicella, and Hep B series
  • Current Flu shot
 
What’s In It For You?

  • Gain experience working with a well-known center and work with a great group of people passionate about what they do!
  • Enjoy a work-life balance with no nights, holidays, or weekends
  • Competitive compensation with weekly direct deposit every Friday!

KNOW A GREAT HEALTHCARE PRO LOOKING FOR WORK? REFER THEM TODAY!

*Yoh Health Care specializes in occupational/employee health and we place health care professionals on jobs nationwide with well-known Fortune 500 companies. Feel free to reach out to hear about the latest Medical Assistant, Nurse, Nurse Practitioner, and Physician Assistant openings!

job.title: Scientist II, Analytical Product Development
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Scientist II, Analytics – Product Development for our pharmaceutical client in Corona, CA. In this role, you will provide analytical support for pharmaceutical product development programs, helping advance the development and approval of generic drug products for U.S. and international markets. The Scientist II will perform analytical testing, method development, validation and verification, laboratory equipment maintenance, technical documentation, and data review while collaborating with internal product development teams, CROs, and CMOs. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in analytical chemistry and hands-on experience with HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, and other pharmaceutical laboratory techniques.

Industry: Pharmaceutical / Product Development
Location: Corona, CA
Compensation: $65,000 - $75,000 per year; based upon experience
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Perform analytical testing of raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, and stability samples using compendial and non-compendial methods.
  • Perform method development, evaluation, validation, and verification using HPLC, GC, and other analytical laboratory techniques.
  • Utilize analytical techniques including wet chemistry, spectrometry, chromatography, and physical testing.
  • Perform testing using instrumentation including HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, balances, and other laboratory equipment.
  • Accurately document laboratory testing according to Good Documentation Practices (GDP), company procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Analyze testing results and communicate findings to management in a timely manner.
  • Write, review, and execute study plans, analytical protocols, validation protocols, technical transfer protocols, and associated reports.
  • Author technical documents including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), method validation protocols/reports, and method transfer protocols/reports.
  • Review laboratory documentation, including notebooks and instrument logbooks, for calculations, data entry accuracy, and regulatory compliance.
  • Perform preventive maintenance, calibration, qualification, and routine monitoring of laboratory equipment and analytical instruments.
  • Maintain laboratory Quality Systems related to samples, standards, reagents, equipment qualification, preventive maintenance, periodic calibration, stability chambers, and controlled-environment storage cabinets.
  • Prepare sample and standard reconciliation reports and other laboratory reports as required.
  • Assist with analytical data management, including data review and control charting.
  • Collaborate with internal product development teams, CROs, and CMOs to establish timelines, understand analytical work requests, resolve technical issues, and communicate results.
  • Support the creation of study designs, method development protocols and reports, and technology transfer protocols and reports.
  • Provide timely analytical support for R&D activities associated with the development and approval of generic pharmaceutical products for U.S. and international markets.
  • Utilize Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and related software for data analysis, technical documentation, and communication.
  • Maintain strict compliance with laboratory procedures and applicable compliance programs.
  • Maintain a clean and safe laboratory work environment, including proper cleaning and storage of laboratory equipment and glassware.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by management.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in a science-related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of three (3) to six (6) years of relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of one (1) year of experience in a relevant area of Pharmaceutical R&D.
  • Strong knowledge of basic analytical chemistry principles and techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with analytical instrumentation and techniques, including HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, wet chemistry, chromatography, and spectrometry.
  • Experience with analytical method development, validation, verification, and/or method transfer.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical R&D environments, terminology, procedures, and regulatory expectations.
  • Knowledge of Good Documentation Practices and laboratory compliance requirements.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing analytical protocols, reports, SOPs, and other technical documentation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and similar programs.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external partners, including CROs and CMOs.
  • Ability to organize and manage analytical activities while meeting established project timelines.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate laboratory documentation and data integrity.
#IND-SPG

job.title: Human Resources - Recruiter / Senior Technology Sourcing Recruiter - Remote
job.description:
Senior Technology Sourcing Recruiter (Remote - U.S.)
Location: Remote (Continental United States)
Pay Rate: $35-$42 hourly W2
Duration: 6 months contract 


Work Hours: Must be available during Eastern Time business hours

Are you passionate about finding and engaging top technology talent? We are seeking a Senior Technology Sourcing Recruiter to serve as a strategic talent advisor and sourcing expert focused on identifying exceptional professionals across Cloud, Software Engineering, Data & Analytics, Cybersecurity, Artificial Intelligence, DevOps, and Architecture disciplines.
In this role, you will drive proactive talent strategies, build high-quality candidate pipelines, and provide valuable market intelligence that supports long-term workforce planning. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced technology sourcing professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys uncovering hard-to-find talent.


What You'll Do:
• Develop and execute proactive sourcing strategies to identify top technology talent across Cloud, Software Engineering, Data, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, DevOps, and Architecture disciplines.
• Build and maintain robust talent pipelines for critical and future hiring needs, with a focus on both active and passive candidates.
• Conduct talent mapping and competitive intelligence research to identify target companies, key talent pools, and emerging technology skill sets.
• Partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and business leaders to understand workforce plans and establish sourcing strategies aligned to business priorities.
• Utilize advanced search techniques, social platforms, networking, referrals, and industry events to engage high-demand technical talent.
• Perform initial candidate outreach, engagement, and qualification conversations to assess technical background, career motivations, and alignment with business needs.
• Provide market intelligence on talent availability, compensation trends, competitor hiring activity, and emerging technology skills.
• Partner with Diversity Strategy teams to develop diverse candidate pipelines and expand access to underrepresented technology talent.
• Track and report sourcing activity, pipeline health, market insights, and candidate engagement metrics.
• Continuously evaluate and recommend innovative sourcing tools, technologies, and practices to improve talent identification efforts.

What You'll Bring:
• 8+ years of technology sourcing and recruiting experience, with a strong focus on attracting talent in Cloud Engineering, Software Development, Data & Analytics, Cybersecurity, AI/ML, and Architecture domains.
• Bachelor's degree required.
• Demonstrated success sourcing passive technology talent in highly competitive and niche markets.
• Expertise in talent mapping, competitive intelligence, market research, and advanced sourcing methodologies.
• Strong experience leveraging LinkedIn Recruiter, talent intelligence platforms, applicant tracking systems, and sourcing analytics.
• Deep understanding of technology skill sets, organizational structures, and talent trends across the technology landscape.
• Ability to build credibility and influence hiring leaders through data-driven talent insights and market expertise.
• Exceptional networking, relationship-building, and candidate engagement skills.

job.title: Systems Engineer
job.description:
System Engineer 
12+ month contract
Downtown Dallas, TX (Hybrid)
 
Core experience in Windows, Active Directory, Nutanix Prism Central, VMware vSphere and vRealize Suite, vRealize Automation (vRA), vRealize Orchestrator (vRO), Horizon View administration, and Linux in a global and heterogeneous environment


This position requires a resource with at least 8 years of experience in the given technology areas. The key competencies include subject matter expertise and system administrator experience with Microsoft Windows OS, VMWare, Linux OS and Nutanix Technologies.

Essential Skills and Competencies:
  • Manage and administer Windows (2012, 2016, 2019, 2022 and 2025) and Linux (RHEL 7.X, 8.X and 9.X) servers
  • Support and manage server virtualization, server provisioning, physical server maintenance, security compliance and the daily operation of the control system environments
  • Maintain the physical server lifecycle including provisioning, maintenance, and decommissioning of the hardware
  • Maintain the virtualized server environment via configuration, implementation, management and support activities
  • Maintain the Nutanix and VMware VDI environment via configuration, implementation, management and support activities
  • Maintain security baseline compliance via configuration, implementation, and remediation activities; report on compliance via routine compliance and audit tasks
  • Monitor the server infrastructure environment health status, service performance, and utilization; report on trends and anomalies
  • Implement and maintain continuous compliance to information security policies, North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP), and technical standards; report and provide remediation around non-compliances
  • Apply regular security patches and software updates using Microsoft SCCM and Redhat Satellite server
  • Provide tier-3 engineering support as well as business continuity support for control system infrastructure
  • Collaborates with application, network, security and functional team that support Control System tools and applications

Technical Skill Requirement
  • Core experience in Windows, Active Directory, Nutanix Prism Central, VMware vSphere and vRealize Suite, vRealize Automation (vRA), vRealize Orchestrator (vRO), Horizon View administration, and Linux in a global and heterogeneous environment
  • Good Understanding of Virtualization technology (Nutanix, Hyper-V and VMware)
  • Good hands-on experience in diagnostics and troubleshooting of above-mentioned technologies and product suites
  • Good understanding of highly available and disaster recovery environments
  • Experience in performance tuning of Nutanix, VMware servers and Virtual sessions and management of server resources for both physical as well as between virtual machines
  • Experience and expertise on Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, IIS, ADFS, Group Policies, and FTP & SFTP
  • Ability to implement AD infrastructure. Proficient in doing Recovery of AD Domain Controllers, DNS, WINS, DHCP servers
  • In-Depth knowledge of Domain Controller replication configurations
  • Good Exposure to Group Policies creation, their testing and implementation
  • Should have good knowledge and troubleshooting skills on MS clusters and load balancing
  • Strong in file and print server management; knowledge in Windows Security
  • Excellent in PowerShell scripting and task automation work with measurable outputs and operational efficiencies
  • Overall knowledge and understanding of data center environments, physical hardware placements, racking, cabling, etc.
  • Good at dealing with hardware and OEM vendors for support and troubleshooting purpose for hardware break fix and large platform/server upgrades/migration is required
  • Good at dealing and coordinating with multiple teams and stakeholders within the support structure, in order to run daily operations smoothly
  • Should have good working experience on RAID management and array controller
  • Should have expertise in backup products and expertise in protocol suite and command line utilities
  • Should have worked with OEM hardware (DELL/HP), and remote connectivity tools
  • Proficiency in system fault tolerance design, business continuity and disaster recovery planning
  • Prior experience working in Operations Technology or Control System environments is preferred

job.title: HR Manager- Compensation/ Payroll
job.description:
Job Title- HR Manager- Compensation/ Payroll 



Position Summary:
The HR Manager is responsible for administering key human resources functions, with primary accountability for benefits, multi-state payroll, compensation, and training. This role works closely with the VP of Human Resources and leadership to support a compliant, efficient, and employee-centered workplace by ensuring HR programs, processes, and day-to-day activities are carried out accurately and effectively. The ideal candidate brings strong operational HR experience, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a changing environment.

Job Details:

Location: 1-2 Days Onsite
Type : Full Time
Industry- Financial
Salary: $110K-$150K

Key Responsibilities

HR Operations:
  • Process payroll to ensure timely and accurate payroll administration, deductions, reconciliations, and compliance with applicable laws and internal controls.
  • Serve as a resource to employees and managers on HR policies, benefits, payroll, compensation, and workplace practices.
  • Prepare HR reports, audits, and analysis related to benefits, payroll, compensation, training, and other workforce metrics.
  • Manage HR systems and data to ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and timely reporting.
  • Administer employee benefits programs, including enrollment, changes, open enrollment coordination, vendor communication, and employee education.
  • Administer retirement plans, including 401(a), 403(b), and 457(b), by processing transactions, coordinating with vendors, and responding to employee questions.
  • Serve as the Local Plan Administrator by maintaining plan records, coordinating required actions, and supporting retirement plan administration activities.
Compensation and Data Insights Management:
  • Support compensation administration, including salary reviews, market pricing, job evaluations, pay changes, incentive administration, and maintenance of compensation data.
  • Tracks HR metrics and analyzes trends in compensation, turnover, and engagement to guide strategic decisions.
  • Supports VP of HR in the preparation of compensation-related materials, data, and supporting analysis for Executive Leadership and Compensation Committee meetings.
  • Support performance management activities, employee relations matters, and workplace investigations as needed, including documentation, follow-up, and coordination.
  • Assist with HR-related budget preparation by compiling data, tracking costs, and supporting the annual budgeting process.

Compliance
  • Maintain and update HR policies, procedures, records, and documentation in compliance with federal, state, and local employment requirements.
  • Support compliance activities, including required notices, filings, audits, and response to regulatory changes.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.
  • Prepare and provide HR data and documentation for Form 990, workers’ compensation audits, and other regulatory or audit requests.
Talent Management & Culture:
  • Coordinate full-cycle recruiting and onboarding activities, including posting jobs, scheduling interviews, preparing offer and onboarding materials, and supporting new hire setup.
  • Administer day-to-day talent management activities, including performance review administration, tracking development plans, supporting talent review meetings, and maintaining related documentation.
  • Work closely with managers to address day-to-day employee matters, reinforce workplace expectations, and support a positive and productive work environment.
  • Coordinate and support employee engagement, recognition, and retention activities, including communications, event planning, feedback collection, and follow-up actions.
  • Provide practical support to managers on employee development, team issues, and routine workplace concerns, and help ensure consistent follow-through on action items.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 7+ years of progressive human resources experience, including direct experience in benefits, payroll, compensation, and training and development.
  • Working knowledge of applicable federal, multi-state, and local employment laws and regulations.
  • Experience administering HRIS, payroll, and benefits systems.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities with accuracy and attention to detail.

job.title: RF Test Engineer
job.description:
RF Test Engineer
We are seeking an RF Test Engineer to support RF validation, design verification, and system-level testing of wireless devices. This hands-on role focuses on OTA and conducted RF testing, test setup and automation, data analysis, lab operations, and hardware rework within an RF development environment.

Scope:
• Perform RF system testing for design verification and system validation, including conducted and radiated testing for RF performance, interference, noise floor (RSSI), coexistence, throughput, and related wireless performance metrics.
• Execute OTA testing, including TRP, TIS, and aGPS measurements in both signaling and non-signaling modes using RF test chambers and call box equipment.
• Configure, operate, and troubleshoot RF test equipment, including anechoic chambers, call boxes, and internally developed test tools.
• Collect, analyze, and document test data using spreadsheets, databases, and Python scripts to generate reports and communicate results.
• Set up and maintain RF test environments, calibration schedules, laboratory equipment, and hardware development workspaces.
• Perform hardware rework, prototype modifications, and mock-up assembly to support RF validation and testing activities.
• Support debugging and root cause analysis of RF performance issues in collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams.

Required:
• Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Electronic Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 8+ years of experience with electrical troubleshooting, electrical assembly, and mechanical assembly.
• Experience operating OTA chambers from R&S, BlueTest, or GTS.
• Experience using RF call boxes from R&S, Keysight, or Anritsu.
• Experience working with RF passive and active components, including splitters, filters, amplifiers, and related hardware.
• Proficiency with Windows or ChromeOS environments.
• Experience using Google Docs, Google Sheets, or equivalent documentation and spreadsheet tools.
• Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and communication abilities.

Pluses:
• Experience performing RF desense testing, including noise profile, interference, and coexistence measurements.
• Experience developing RF hardware test setups for conducted measurements.
• Strong soldering and fine-pitch rework skills (0201 components).
• Experience building prototype hardware, mockups, or custom test fixtures.
• Experience with Python or other scripting languages for test automation and data analysis.
• Strong electrical debugging and troubleshooting skills.
• Advanced hardware rework experience.

job.title: SLA III
job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-term Genomic Medicine BioProcess Analytics SLA III (Analytical Technician) opportunity with a trusted client located in Waltham, MA. 

If you don't wish to receive these mails, just turn off "Job expiry email alerts" inside the user profile or system settings.


Genomic Medicine BioProcess Analytics SLA III (Analytical Technician)
Location: Waltham, MA

Position Overview/Department Description: 
The Genetic Medicine Unit CMC organization is responsible for the design and optimization of viral vector and cell therapy manufacturing processes and platforms. A key function of this group is to establish operational excellence in the manufacturing of emerging gene therapy products, supported by a diverse panel of analytical methods to provide process understanding and product characterization.

The BioProcess Analytics support group located in Waltham, MA is responsible for execution of analytical methods to support manufacturing and development activities, building process understanding, and supporting life cycle management from early to late-stage clinical entry.

The Research Associate (Analytical Technician) is responsible for executing and documenting test methods under control of established procedures. We are looking for a candidate that has experience in an analytical setting that can independently manage and execute their testing schedule supportive of genomic medicines process development. In addition, they should possess the skills to interpret and communicate their data with the appropriate development teams.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Execute test methods following established procedures and approved schedules.
  • Maintain all test documentation and assay databases for control monitoring.
  • Review test data to verify conformance to method suitability criteria and trending to assay control ranges.
  • Report any out-of-expectation results or test failures, and support test investigations and corrective action implementation.
  • Manage individual training plans and schedules, and documentation sign-off.
  • Manage and maintain all analytical cell cultures.
  • Support maintenance of facility infrastructure (e.g., equipment) and management of inventories for assay supplies, reagents, controls, and standards.
  • Comply with site HSE systems and biosafety level 2 controls.
  • Potential for occasional weekend and holiday work to support ongoing lab activities.
Basic Qualifications:
  • BS in biological sciences or related field with 0–2 years of relevant experience in the life sciences, biotechnology, or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Excellent organization and documentation skills, committed to internal documentation practices.
Preferred QualificationsExperience in the following analytical platforms, including but not limited to:
  • Separation technologies (e.g., SDS-PAGE, Capillary Electrophoresis, and HPLC)
  • Spectral assays (e.g., optical density, light scattering)
  • ELISA platforms
  • Chemistry methods (e.g., pH, Bradford)

job.title: Optical Technician
job.description:
Optical Technician 

Planet is seeking a highly skilled Contract Optical Technician to support the integration and testing of optical payloads for the Pelican satellite program. This role is focused on the tactical execution of telescope and camera assembly, alignment, and characterization. We are looking for a precision-oriented technician who excels in a cleanroom environment and has a proven track record of handling delicate flight optics and complex opto-mechanical assemblies. 

Impact You’ll Own 

  • Payload Integration and Assembly: Execute the high-precision assembly of telescopes and focal plane arrays, including the delicate bonding of optics using RTV and aerospace-grade epoxies. 

  • Optical Characterization: Perform ground-based testing of cameras and telescopes for image quality, MTF, and radiometric performance following established test procedures. 

  • Precision Metrology: Utilize and maintain optical test stations, including the use of interferometers, wavefront sensors, collimators, and integrating spheres to ensure payload performance. 

  • Fixture Assembly: Build and maintain opto-mechanical and electrical test fixtures to support the high-volume production and verification of Pelican payloads. 

  • Data Recording: Meticulously record test results and prepare data summaries for engineering review, ensuring all anomalies are captured and reported via Jira or in-house software. 

  • Component Handling: Proficiently handle, measure, and clean sensitive optical components according to strict cleanroom and laboratory safety protocols. 

  • Collaborative Debugging: Work closely with Manufacturing and Test Engineers to troubleshoot opto-mechanical or electrical failures identified during the build or test cycle. 

What You Bring 

  • Experience: Proven background in optics and optical assemblies, specifically within a high-precision manufacturing or aerospace environment. 

  • High-Reliability Bonding: Professional experience with the precision application of RTV and epoxies for mounting and securing optical elements. 

  • Alignment Expertise: Solid understanding of optical alignment techniques and the use of metrology equipment to verify image quality metrics. 

  • Laboratory Discipline: A methodical approach to following complex, detailed test procedures exactly as written, with no unauthorized deviations. 

  • Mechanical Aptitude: Proficiency with mechanical tools, fixtures, and the ability to read and interpret both mechanical and electrical drawings/schematics. 

  • Documentation Accuracy: Impeccable organizational skills with a focus on recording accurate, detailed test descriptions and data manipulation. 

  • Hardware Sensitivity: Extreme care when handling flight-critical optics and a deep understanding of ESD-safe and cleanroom best practices. 

What Makes You Stand Out 

  • Educational Background: Degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field. 

  • Spacecraft Payload Experience: Previous experience working on satellite telescopes, focal planes, or mission-critical camera systems. 

  • Advanced Debugging: Ability to perform root-cause analysis on complex opto-mechanical systems and electrical cable/harness assemblies. 

  • Software Familiarity: Basic experience with Python or lab automation tools to assist in data collection and test station operation. 

  • Soldering Proficiency: Experience with PCB soldering and the assembly of delicate electronics associated with optical sensors.

Semiconductor Manufacturing Technician needed for an 18-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Gloucester, Massachusetts.



Pay Rate: $23 to $28 per hour




Shifts Available:  1st Shift Monday-Thursday 5:30AM-4PM
                              2nd Shift-Monday-Thursday 3:45PM-2:15AM
                              3rd Shift-Sunday-Wednesday 7:30PM-6:15AM
                              4th Shift- Friday-Sunday 5:45AM-6:15PM

We have long-term contract opportunities for Manufacturing Electronic Technicians.

Pay Rate: $22.00 to $25.00/Hr.
Second Shift and Weekend Shifts offer shift differential.

job.title: Systems Engineer
job.description:
Senior Systems Engineer – L3 Infrastructure & AzurePosition
Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Systems Engineer to serve as a critical Level 3 escalation resource within the IT organization. This position will operate beyond the existing L1/L2 support structure, providing advanced troubleshooting, systems engineering, and infrastructure expertise for complex technical issues.
The role combines systems engineering, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps practices, with a strong emphasis on Microsoft Azure and Azure networking. In addition to resolving escalated issues, this individual will contribute to infrastructure improvements, automation initiatives, and broader engineering projects.
This is an opportunity for a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems while also helping improve the organization's overall infrastructure and support capabilities. The position is initially structured as a contract opportunity with the potential to transition into a direct-hire role as headcount becomes available.
Key Responsibilities
  • Serve as a Level 3 escalation point for complex infrastructure, systems, and cloud-related issues.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve advanced technical problems that cannot be addressed by L1/L2 support teams.
  • Provide expertise across Azure infrastructure and networking, including connectivity, virtual networks, security, and related services.
  • Support day-to-day infrastructure operations while contributing to larger technology and engineering initiatives.
  • Design, implement, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive infrastructure and operational processes.
  • Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts and other automation solutions where appropriate.
  • Partner with internal technology teams and external service providers to investigate and resolve escalated issues.
  • Assist with infrastructure projects, system improvements, migrations, and technology implementations.
  • Help document technical solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and escalation processes.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions rather than temporary fixes.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of internal L3 support capabilities and processes.
Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a related IT discipline.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, particularly Azure networking.
  • Experience supporting L3/Level 3 escalations and complex infrastructure issues.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise systems, infrastructure, networking, and cloud technologies.
  • Ability to balance operational support responsibilities with longer-term engineering and project work.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical issues.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience administering Microsoft 365 environments.
  • Previous experience working for or alongside a Managed Service Provider (MSP).
  • Experience developing or improving technical escalation and support processes.
  • PowerShell scripting and automation experience.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, or DevOps practices.
  • Practical programming or scripting experience applied to infrastructure and IT operations.
  • Experience working with external vendors or managed service partners.

job.title: Research Associate (Analytical Technician)
job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-Research Associate (Analytical Technician) opportunity with a trusted, long-term client located in Waltham, MA.
 
This position is part of a major pharmaceutical company, and requires a Bachelor’s degree in biological sciences. Schedule is full-time M-F (7am-8am start time, 8 hour shift) and may require flexibility to work some evenings and overtime due to projects.
 
Key Responsibilities:
  • Execute test methods following established procedures and approved schedules.
  • Maintain all test documentation and assay databases for control monitoring.
  • Review test data to verify conformance to method suitability criteria and trending to assay control ranges.
  • Report any out of expectation results or test failures, and support test investigations and corrective action implementation.
  • Manage individual training plans and schedules, and documentation sign off.
  • Manage and maintain all analytical cell cultures.
  • Support maintenance of facility infrastructure (e.g. equipment) and management of inventories for assay supplies, reagents, controls and standards.
  • Comply with site HSE systems and biosafety level 2 controls.
  • Potential for occasional weekend and holiday work to support ongoing lab activities.
 
Qualifications:
  • BS in biological sciences or related field with 0 – 2 years of relevant experience in the life sciences, biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Excellent organization and documentation skills, committed to internal documentation practices.
  • Experience in a QC or other analytical setting and executing assays to the control of established procedures.
  • Relevant experience in analytical testing of cell and gene therapy products, with preferred experience in analytical platforms associated with Adeno-Associated Virus and Adenovirus type agents, RNA, DNA, and LNP.
  • Experience with automation technology platforms (e.g. liquid handling platforms).
  • Experience and knowledge of working with biohazard infectious agents and biosafety level 2 controls.
  • Experience in the following analytical platforms including but not limited to  biological/cell-based assays(e.g infectivity, potency), molecular assays (e.g. PCR, NGS), separation technologies (e.g SDS PAGE, Capillary Electrophoresis), spectral assays (e.g. Optical density), ELISA platforms and chemistry methods (e.g. pH,  Bradford).

job.title: Financial Portfolio Management Manager
job.description:
Financial Portfolio Management Manager
12+ month contract
Downtown Dallas, TX (Hybrid 3-4 days a week and onsite interview)
 
Must have Financial Planning of Technology Department experience

Role Summary
Leads Technology Financial Portfolio Management services across the organization, overseeing financial planning, forecasting, investment management, governance, and financial operations. Responsible for ensuring financial transparency, funding alignment, compliance, and informed investment decisions that support Technology's strategic and operational objectives.


Key Responsibilities
  • Lead Technology CapEx, OpEx, and System Resiliency Plan (SRP) financial management activities.
  • Oversee annual budgets, monthly forecasts, long-range planning, and financial reporting.
  • Establish financial governance, controls, processes, and performance measures.
  • Partner with Technology leadership, AIS, Accounting, Finance, Strategy, and Portfolio Management teams.
  • Oversee CWIP management, asset capitalization, project placements in service, and asset retirements.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting principles, capitalization policies, SOX controls, and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead and develop Financial Portfolio Management Leads and Financial Services Analysts.
  • Confirm and abide by all procedures, policies and regulatory guidance.
  • Leverage and maintain applicable systems and tools as needed
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Deliverables
  • Annual Technology budget and monthly forecast packages.
  • Five-year Technology financial and investment plans.
  • Executive financial dashboards, reporting, and presentations.
  • Investment analysis and funding recommendations.
  • CWIP aging reports and in-service compliance reporting.
  • Asset retirement plans and financial impact assessments.
  • Financial governance processes, SOX documentation, and audit support materials.
  • Portfolio financial performance and variance analysis.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • MBA, CPA, CMA, or other relevant financial certification preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, accounting, or investment management.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience.
  • Experience managing CapEx, OpEx, investment portfolios, and long-range financial plans.
  • Experience supporting audits, SOX controls, financial governance, and compliance activities.
  • Experience presenting financial information to senior leadership and executives.
  • Financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • Understanding of utility accounting, capitalization policies, CWIP management, depreciation, and asset lifecycle management.
  • Experience supporting technology organizations, technology investments, or project portfolios.
  • Knowledge of demand planning, portfolio planning, and investment prioritization processes.
  • Strong financial modeling, analytics, and reporting capabilities.
  • Ability to translate complex financial data into executive-level insights and recommendations.
  • Experience with ERP, financial planning, portfolio management, and reporting tools.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to lead process improvements and establish scalable financial controls.

job.title: Senior Oracle Data Modeler
job.description:
Senior Oracle Data Modeler 
12+ month contract
Downtown Dallas (Hybrid w/ onsite interview)
 
  • Expert proficiency with Erwin Data Modeler (version 9.x or higher preferred) – including subject areas, model templates, and DDL generation.

Primary responsibilities of the Data Modeler include designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise-grade data models that support critical business initiatives, analytics, and operational systems. The ideal candidate is proficient in industry-standard data modeling tools (with hands-on expertise in erwin Data Modeler) and has deep experience with Oracle and SQL Server databases.  The candidate will also translate complex business requirements into robust, scalable, and normalized data models while ensuring alignment with data governance, performance, and integration standards.
 
Responsibilities
  • Design and develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models using erwin Data Modeler (required).
  • Generate, review, and optimize DDL (Data Definition Language) scripts for database objects (tables, views, indexes, constraints, partitions, etc.).
  • Perform forward and reverse engineering of data models from existing Oracle and SQL Server databases.
  • Collaborate with data architects, DBAs, ETL developers, and business stakeholders to gather and refine requirements.
  • Ensure data models adhere to normalization standards (3NF/BCNF), data integrity, and referential integrity.
  • Support dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas) for data warehousing and analytics use cases.
  • Conduct model reviews, impact analysis, and version control using erwin or comparable tools.
  • Participate in data governance initiatives, including metadata management, naming standards, and lineage documentation.
  • Optimize models for performance, scalability, and maintainability across large-scale environments.
  • Assist in database migrations, schema comparisons, and synchronization between environments (Dev/QA/Prod).
  • Assist in optimizing existing Data Solutions
  • Follow Oncor’s Data Governance Policy and Information Classification and Protection Policy.
  • Participate in design reviews and take guidance from the Data Architecture team members.
Qualifications
  • 3+ years of hands-on data modeling experience in enterprise environments.
  • Expert proficiency with Erwin Data Modeler (version 9.x or higher preferred) – including subject areas, model templates, and DDL generation.
  • Advanced SQL skills and deep understanding of Oracle (11g/12c/19c/21c) and Microsoft SQL Server (2016+).
  • Strong command of DDL – creating and modifying tables, indexes, constraints, sequences, synonyms, and materialized views.
  • Solid grasp of database internals: indexing strategies, partitioning, clustering, and query execution plans.
  • Experience with data modeling best practices: normalization, denormalization, surrogate keys, slowly changing dimensions (SCD), and data vault (a plus).
  • Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) and model comparison/diff tools.
  • Excellent communication skills – ability to document models clearly and present to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-Motivated, with an ability to multi-task
  • Capable of presenting to all levels of audiences
  • Works well in a team environment
  • Experience with Hadoop/MongoDB a plus

job.title: Intermediate Semiconductor Manufacturing Techncian-Billerica,MA
job.description:
Intermediate Semiconductor Manufacturing Technician needed for an 6-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Billerica, Massachusetts.


Pay Rate: $27 to $32 per hour



The Big Picture – Top Skills You Should Possess:
 

  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to quickly adapt to change


What You Will Be Doing:
  • As a Manufacturing Technician, you'll work hands-on in a cleanroom environment to build and test our multimillion-dollar display and wafer fabrication equipment 
  • You'll be responsible for building, repairing, and testing various types of equipment--including electrical, electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies, subassemblies, and components.
  • You will perform electro-mechanical assembly operations, troubleshooting, and repairs-- and perform audits to ensure necessary parts are available and inspected for defects.
  • Using test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors, and vacuum pumps you'll test assemblies, complete documentation, perform repairs, or install software to continuously improve our processes
  • Has developed proficiency in a range of processes or procedures through job-related training and considerable on-the-job experience.
  • Completes a variety of atypical assignments, as needed. Works within defined processes and procedures or methodologies and may help determine the appropriate approach for new assignments.
  • Completes work with a limited degree of supervision. Likely to act as an informal resource for colleagues with less experience.
  • Use work orders (including schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and instructions) to build, repair and/or test equipment of various kinds (electrical, electro-mechanical, vacuum, pneumatic assemblies, subassemblies and components)
  • Perform a wide variety of electro-mechanical assembly operations, troubleshooting and repairs
  • Receive parts and perform audits to ensure all necessary parts are available; inspect parts for defects; troubleshoot and improve processes
  • Use test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors and/or vacuum pumps to test assemblies, subassemblies and components
  • Complete required job documentation (data entry) about progress, work expense and labor details; perform computer programming, repair or software installs, as needed
  • Work independently with minimal supervision, and serve as an informal resource for junior colleagues

What You Need to Bring to the Table: 
  • An Associate’s degree
  • 2–4 years of semiconductor or display experience, or comparable industry or military experience
  • Related technical trainings and certifications
  • Solid analytical skills, and an ability to problem-solve using established operating procedures or scientific methods
  • Demonstrated capability to operate as a peer leader and trainer
  • Demonstrated proficiency for required semiconductor manufacturing concepts and processes
  • ASSEET
  • BSEET (DeVry, TSTC)


Bonus Points! Otherwise Known As Preferred Qualifications:
  • This is a physically demanding position that often requires standing for extended periods of time, walking, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, lifting, the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, the use of hand and power tools, and driving or operating heavy machinery including forklifts.
  • Additionally, because this position may involve working in a clean room, the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields may be required.
